function newSaleOperationKey() {
    saleOperationCounter += 1;
    return typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
        ? crypto.randomUUID()
        : `pos-${Date.now()}-${saleOperationCounter}`;
}

function escapePosText(value) {
    return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, function (character) {
        return ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' })[character];
    });
}

function addProductByBarcode(barcode) {
    barcode = barcode.trim();
    if (!barcode) return Promise.resolve(false);

    const existingRow = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr'))
        .find(row => String(row.dataset.barcode || '') === barcode);
    if (existingRow) {
        const qtyInput = existingRow.querySelector('.quantity-input');
        qtyInput.value = parseInt(qtyInput.value) + 1;
        updateProductQuantity(existingRow);
        return Promise.resolve(true);
    }
    return apiCall('getProductByBarcode', { barcode: barcode })
        .then(async data => {
            if (data.success) {
                const payload = data.data || data;
                const product = {
                    product_id: payload.product_id,
                    barcode: payload.barcode || barcode,
                    product_name: payload.product_name || payload.product_name_ar,
                    unit_price: Number(payload.sale_price || 0),
                    expiry_date: payload.expiry_date,
                    min_stock_level: payload.minimum_stock ?? payload.min_stock_level ?? 0,
                    quantity: payload.quantity,
                    current_stock: payload.current_stock ?? payload.stock_quantity ?? payload.quantity_on_hand ?? payload.available_quantity,
                    sale_type: data.sale_type,
                    invoice_type: data.invoice_type,
                    description: payload.description ?? ''
                };
                addProductToTable(product);
                const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr')).find(item => String(item.dataset.productId || '') === String(product.product_id));
                if (row) await resolveProductRowPrice(row);
                updateInvoiceSummary();
                showSuccessCheckmark();
                return true;
            } else {
                showToast(data.message || 'المنتج غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات', 'error');
                return false;
            }
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error('[Product] fetch error:', error);
            showToast('خطأ في جلب بيانات المنتج', 'error');
            return false;
        });
}

function showSuccessCheckmark() {
    let checkmark = document.getElementById('successCheckmark');
    if (!checkmark) {
        checkmark = document.createElement('div');
        checkmark.id = 'successCheckmark';
        checkmark.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>';
        document.body.appendChild(checkmark);
    }
    checkmark.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(() => { checkmark.style.display = 'none'; }, 1000);
}

function focusPosField(elementId, selectText = false) {
    const field = document.getElementById(elementId);
    if (!field) return;
    setTimeout(() => {
        try {
            field.focus({ preventScroll: false });
            if (selectText && typeof field.select === 'function') field.select();
        } catch (_) {
            try { field.focus(); } catch (_) {}
        }
    }, 80);
}

function openManualProductPicker() {
    openModal('manualProductPickerModal');
    focusPosField('manualProductSearch');
    const list = document.getElementById('manualProductList');
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted text-center">جارٍ تحميل المنتجات من SQLite...</div>';
    apiCall('getProducts', {})
        .then(data => {
            if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'تعذر تحميل المنتجات');
            manualProductCache = Array.isArray(data.data) ? data.data : [];
            renderManualProductPicker('');
        })
        .catch(error => {
            list.innerHTML = `<div class="error-state">${escapePosText(error.message || 'تعذر تحميل المنتجات')}</div>`;
        });
}

function renderManualProductPicker(query) {
    const list = document.getElementById('manualProductList');
    if (!list) return;
    const q = String(query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = manualProductCache.filter(product => {
        const name = String(product.product_name || product.product_name_ar || '').toLowerCase();
        const barcode = String(product.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
        return !q || name.includes(q) || barcode.includes(q);
    });
    if (!filtered.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">لا توجد منتجات مطابقة</div>';
        return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = filtered.slice(0, 300).map(product => `
        <button type="button" class="manual-product-option" data-product-id="${escapePosText(product.product_id || product.id)}">
            <strong>${escapePosText(product.product_name || product.product_name_ar || 'منتج')}</strong>
            <small>${escapePosText(product.barcode || 'لا يوجد باركود')}</small>
        </button>
    `).join('');
    list.querySelectorAll('.manual-product-option').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const product = manualProductCache.find(item => String(item.product_id || item.id) === String(button.dataset.productId));
            if (!product || !String(product.barcode || '').trim()) {
                showToast('المنتج المحدد لا يملك باركوداً محفوظاً في SQLite', 'error');
                return;
            }
            const input = document.getElementById('manualBarcodeInput');
            input.value = String(product.barcode).trim();
            closeModal('manualProductPickerModal');
            addProductByBarcode(input.value);
        });
    });
}

async function addProductManually() {
    const input = document.getElementById('manualBarcodeInput');
    const barcode = input.value.trim();
    if (!barcode) {
        showToast('يرجى إدخال باركود المنتج', 'error');
        return;
    }
    const added = await addProductByBarcode(barcode);
    input.value = '';
    if (!added) focusPosField('manualBarcodeInput');
}

function focusAndSelectProductQuantity(row) {
    const field = row && row.querySelector('.quantity-input');
    if (!field) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        try { field.focus({ preventScroll: false }); } catch (_) { field.focus(); }
        field.select();
    });
}

function addProductToTable(product) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('productsTableBody');
    const existingRow = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll('tr'))
        .find(row => String(row.dataset.productId || '') === String(product.product_id));
    if (existingRow) {
        const qtyInput = existingRow.querySelector('.quantity-input');
        qtyInput.value = parseInt(qtyInput.value || '0', 10) + 1;
        updateProductQuantity(existingRow);
        existingRow.classList.add('row-highlight');
        setTimeout(() => existingRow.classList.remove('row-highlight'), 1000);
        focusAndSelectProductQuantity(existingRow);
        return;
    }

    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    row.setAttribute('data-product-id', product.product_id);
    row.setAttribute('data-barcode', product.barcode);
    row.setAttribute('data-expiry-date', product.expiry_date || '');
    row.setAttribute('data-min-stock', product.min_stock_level ?? '');
    row.setAttribute('data-quantity', product.quantity ?? '');
    row.setAttribute('data-current-stock', product.current_stock ?? product.stock_quantity ?? product.quantity_on_hand ?? product.available_quantity ?? '');
    row.setAttribute('data-sale-type', product.sale_type || '');
    row.setAttribute('data-invoice-type', product.invoice_type || '');
    row.setAttribute('data-description', product.description ?? '');
    row.innerHTML = `
        <td><input type="number" class="form-control quantity-input" value="1" min="1" dir="ltr" inputmode="numeric"></td>
        <td class="product-name-large">${escapePosText(product.product_name)}</td>
        <td>${product.unit_price.toFixed(2)}</td>
        <td class="product-total">${product.unit_price.toFixed(2)}</td>
        <td>
            <div class="product-row-actions">
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary product-details-btn" title="تفاصيل المنتج" type="button" aria-label="تفاصيل المنتج"><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i></button>
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger remove-product-btn" title="حذف" type="button" aria-label="حذف المنتج"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
            </div>
        </td>
    `;
    tbody.appendChild(row);

    const qtyInput = row.querySelector('.quantity-input');
    qtyInput.addEventListener('change', () => updateProductQuantity(row));
    qtyInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            const paidField = document.getElementById('amountPaid');
            if (paidField) {
                try { paidField.focus({ preventScroll: false }); } catch (_) { paidField.focus(); }
                paidField.select();
            }
        }
    });
    row.querySelector('.remove-product-btn').addEventListener('click', () => removeProduct(row));
    row.querySelector('.product-details-btn').addEventListener('click', () => showProductDetails(product, row));
    row.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
        showDoubleClickActions(e, row, product);
    });
    row.classList.add('row-highlight');
    setTimeout(() => row.classList.remove('row-highlight'), 1000);
    focusAndSelectProductQuantity(row);
}

function showDoubleClickActions(event, row, product) {
    const existing = document.querySelector('.double-click-actions-backdrop');
    if (existing) existing.remove();

    const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'double-click-actions-backdrop';
    backdrop.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    backdrop.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');

    const actions = document.createElement('div');
    actions.className = 'double-click-actions';

    const detailsButton = document.createElement('button');
    detailsButton.type = 'button';
    detailsButton.className = 'double-click-btn double-click-details';
    detailsButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> تفاصيل';
    detailsButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
        backdrop.remove();
        showProductDetails(product, row);
    });

    const deleteButton = document.createElement('button');
    deleteButton.type = 'button';
    deleteButton.className = 'double-click-btn double-click-delete';
    deleteButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-trash"></i> حذف';
    deleteButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
        backdrop.remove();
        removeProduct(row);
    });

    const cancelButton = document.createElement('button');
    cancelButton.type = 'button';
    cancelButton.className = 'double-click-btn double-click-cancel';
    cancelButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times"></i> إلغاء';
    cancelButton.addEventListener('click', function () { backdrop.remove(); });

    actions.append(detailsButton, deleteButton, cancelButton);
    backdrop.appendChild(actions);
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target === backdrop) backdrop.remove();
    });
    const onKey = function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            backdrop.remove();
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
}

function showProductDetailsCanvas(product, row) {
    const content = document.getElementById('productDetailsContent');
    const rowValue = name => row ? String(row.getAttribute('data-' + name) || '') : '';

    // Use the products.quantity column as the authoritative current stock value.
    // Do not substitute current_stock/stock_quantity aliases: they may represent
    // another inventory measure or stale derived data.
    const rawQuantity = product.quantity ?? rowValue('quantity');
    const currentQuantity = rawQuantity === '' || rawQuantity === null || rawQuantity === undefined
        ? null : Number(rawQuantity);
    const quantityLabel = currentQuantity !== null && Number.isFinite(currentQuantity)
        ? currentQuantity.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
        : 'غير متاح';

    // Display description only; description_ar is intentionally excluded.
    const description = String(product.description ?? rowValue('description') ?? '');
    const minimumStock = product.min_stock_level ?? product.minimum_stock ?? rowValue('min-stock');
    content.innerHTML = `
        <p style="margin-bottom:8px;">اسم المنتج: <strong>${escapePosText(product.product_name || '')}</strong></p>
        <p style="margin-bottom:8px;">تاريخ الإنتهاء: ${escapePosText(product.expiry_date || 'غير محدد')}</p>
        <p style="margin-bottom:8px;">المخزون الحالي منه: ${escapePosText(quantityLabel)}</p>
        <p style="margin-bottom:8px;">مستوى المخزون الأدنى: ${escapePosText(minimumStock ?? 'غير محدد')}</p>
        <div class="product-description-full">
            <label class="form-label">الوصف (Description)</label>
            <div class="desc-value">${description.trim() ? escapePosText(description) : '<span class="text-muted">لا يوجد وصف مسجل لهذا المنتج</span>'}</div>
        </div>
    `;
    openModal('productDetailsCanvas');
}

function showProductDetails(product, row) {
    showProductDetailsCanvas(product, row || null);
}

function promotionRows(value) {
    const raw = value?.data ?? value;
    return Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (raw?.rows || raw?.data || []);
}

function normalizePromotionBoundary(value, isEnd = false) {
    const boundary = String(value || '').trim().replace('T', ' ');
    if (!boundary) return '';
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(boundary)) {
        return `${boundary} ${isEnd ? '23:59:59.999' : '00:00:00'}`;
    }
    return boundary;
}

function promotionIsValidAt(row, transactionTime) {
    const from = normalizePromotionBoundary(row?.valid_from, false);
    const to = normalizePromotionBoundary(row?.valid_to, true);
    const at = String(transactionTime || '').trim().replace('T', ' ');
    return (!from || from <= at) && (!to || to >= at);
}

function isPromotionActive(row) {
    if (!row) return false;
    const raw = row.is_active;
    if (raw === undefined || raw === null) return true;
    if (raw === true || raw === 'true' || raw === '1') return true;
    if (raw === false || raw === 'false' || raw === '0') return false;
    const n = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n === 1 : true;
}

function isPromotionDeleted(row) {
    if (!row) return true;
    const raw = row.is_deleted;
    if (raw === undefined || raw === null) return false;
    if (raw === true || raw === 'true' || raw === '1') return true;
    if (raw === false || raw === 'false' || raw === '0') return false;
    const n = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n === 1 : false;
}

async function loadActivePromotions() {
    const select = document.getElementById('occasionCode');
    if (!select || !window.AndroidInterface) return;
    try {
        const transactionTime = businessDayDateTime();
        const customerId = Number(document.getElementById('customerId')?.value || 0);
        const result = await apiCall('getActivePriceListsForPricing', {
            transaction_time: transactionTime,
            customer_id: customerId > 0 ? customerId : 0
        });
        if (result?.success === false) {
            throw new Error(result.message || result.error || 'تعذر قراءة قوائم الأسعار');
        }
        const active = promotionRows(result).filter(r =>
            r && isPromotionActive(r) && !isPromotionDeleted(r) &&
            promotionIsValidAt(r, transactionTime)
        );
        const occasionOptions = new Map();
        active.forEach(r => {
            const code = String(r.occasion_code || '').trim();
            if (code && !occasionOptions.has(code)) {
                occasionOptions.set(code, r.list_name_ar || r.list_name || r.list_code || code);
            }
        });
        const previousCode = String(select.value || '').trim();
        select.innerHTML = '<option value="">بدون عرض محدد</option>' + Array.from(occasionOptions.entries()).map(([code, label]) =>
            `<option value="${escapePosText(code)}">${escapePosText(label)}</option>`
        ).join('');
        if (previousCode && occasionOptions.has(previousCode)) select.value = previousCode;
        else if (occasionOptions.size === 1) select.value = occasionOptions.keys().next().value;
        applySelectedPromotion();
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Promotions] تعذر تحميل العروض النشطة:', e && e.message ? e.message : e);
    }
}

function applySelectedPromotion() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr').forEach(row => resolveProductRowPrice(row));
}

async function resolveProductRowPrice(row) {
    if (!row || !window.AndroidInterface) throw new Error('جسر Android غير متاح لحساب سعر البيع');
    const productId = Number(row.dataset.productId || 0);
    const qty = Number(row.querySelector('.quantity-input')?.value || 1);
    if (!Number.isInteger(productId) || productId <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(qty) || qty <= 0) throw new Error('معرّف المنتج أو كميته غير صالح');
    const requestId = String((Number(row.dataset.priceRequestId || 0) + 1));
    row.dataset.priceRequestId = requestId;
    row.dataset.priceResolved = '0';
    row.classList.add('price-resolving');
    try {
        const customerId = Number(document.getElementById('customerId')?.value || 0);
        const raw = await apiCall('getResolvedProductSalePrice', {
            product_id: productId,
            quantity: qty,
            customer_id: customerId > 0 ? customerId : 0,
            transaction_time: businessDayDateTime(),
            occasion_code: document.getElementById('occasionCode')?.value.trim() || null
        });
        const resolved = raw?.data || raw;
        if (raw?.success === false) throw new Error(raw.message || raw.error || 'تعذر احتساب السعر');
        if (String(row.dataset.priceRequestId) !== requestId) return false;
        const price = Number(resolved?.unit_price);
        if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) throw new Error('لم يرجع محرك التسعير سعراً صالحاً');
        row.querySelector('td:nth-child(3)').textContent = price.toFixed(4).replace(/0+$/,'').replace(/\.$/,'');
        row.dataset.priceSource = String(resolved?.source || '');
        row.dataset.priceSourceId = String(resolved?.source_id ?? '');
        row.dataset.priceResolved = '1';
        const total = price * qty;
        row.querySelector('.product-total').textContent = total.toFixed(2);
        updateInvoiceSummary();
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        if (String(row.dataset.priceRequestId) === requestId) {
            row.dataset.priceResolved = '0';
            showToast('تعذر احتساب السعر النهائي من قوائم الأسعار: ' + (error.message || 'خطأ غير معروف'), 'error');
        }
        return false;
    } finally {
        if (String(row.dataset.priceRequestId) === requestId) row.classList.remove('price-resolving');
    }
}

function updateProductQuantity(row) {
    const qty = parseInt(row.querySelector('.quantity-input').value) || 1;
    const price = parseFloat(row.querySelector('td:nth-child(3)').textContent);
    const total = price * qty;
    row.querySelector('.product-total').textContent = total.toFixed(2);
    updateInvoiceSummary();
    resolveProductRowPrice(row);
}

function removeProduct(row) {
    row.classList.add('row-delete');
    setTimeout(() => {
        row.remove();
        updateInvoiceSummary();
        document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr').forEach((row, index) => {
            row.cells[0].textContent = index + 1;
        });
    }, 1500);
}

// ============================================================
// 10. ملخص الفاتورة
// ============================================================
function getInvoiceNumberValue(id, fallback = 0) {
    const element = document.getElementById(id);
    const value = Number(element?.value ?? fallback);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : fallback;
}

function updateInvoiceSummary(recalculateBase = true) {
    let calculatedSubtotal = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr').forEach(row => {
        const value = Number(row.querySelector('.product-total')?.textContent || 0);
        if (Number.isFinite(value)) calculatedSubtotal += value;
    });
    const subtotalElement = document.getElementById('subtotal');
    const discountElement = document.getElementById('discountAmount');
    const taxElement = document.getElementById('taxAmount');
    const serviceFeeElement = document.getElementById('serviceFee');
    const totalElement = document.getElementById('totalAmount');
    if (recalculateBase || !subtotalElement.value) subtotalElement.value = calculatedSubtotal.toFixed(2);
    if (!discountElement.value) discountElement.value = '0.00';
    if (!taxElement.value) taxElement.value = '0.00';
    if (!serviceFeeElement.value) serviceFeeElement.value = '0.00';
    const subtotal = getInvoiceNumberValue('subtotal', calculatedSubtotal);
    const discount = getInvoiceNumberValue('discountAmount', 0);
    const tax = getInvoiceNumberValue('taxAmount', 0);
    const serviceFee = getInvoiceNumberValue('serviceFee', 0);
    const derivedTotal = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount + tax + serviceFee);
    if (recalculateBase || !totalElement.value) totalElement.value = derivedTotal.toFixed(2);
    updateRemainingAmount();
}

function updateRemainingAmount() {
    const total = getInvoiceNumberValue('totalAmount', 0);
    const paid = getInvoiceNumberValue('amountPaid', 0);
    const remainingElement = document.getElementById('remainingAmount');
    if (remainingElement) remainingElement.value = Math.max(0, total - paid).toFixed(2);
}

function recalculateInvoiceFromManualFields() {
    const subtotal = getInvoiceNumberValue('subtotal', 0);
    const discount = getInvoiceNumberValue('discountAmount', 0);
    const tax = getInvoiceNumberValue('taxAmount', 0);
    const serviceFee = getInvoiceNumberValue('serviceFee', 0);
    const totalElement = document.getElementById('totalAmount');
    if (totalElement) totalElement.value = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount + tax + serviceFee).toFixed(2);
    updateRemainingAmount();
}

function generateInvoiceNumber() {
    apiCall('getNextInvoiceNumber', {})
        .then(data => {
            if (data.success) {
                document.getElementById('invoiceNumber').value = data.data || data.next_invoice_number || '';
            } else { showToast(data.message || 'تعذر الحصول على رقم الفاتورة', 'error'); }
        })
        .catch(e => showToast(e.message || 'تعذر الحصول على رقم الفاتورة', 'error'));
}
