async function prepareDryStockProducts(products) {
    const page = await apiCall('getDryStockPage', {});
    const catalog = page.data?.products || [];
    for (const item of products) {
        const product = catalog.find(p => Number(p.product_id) === Number(item.product_id));
        if (!product) continue;
        if (Number(product.track_batch) === 1) {
            const batches = (await apiCall('getProductBatches', {product_id:Number(item.product_id)})).data || [];
            const selected = batches.find(b => Number(b.quantity || 0) >= Number(item.quantity || 0));
            if (!selected) throw new Error('لا توجد دفعة متاحة بالكمية المطلوبة للمنتج');
            item.batch_id = Number(selected.batch_id);
        }
        if (Number(product.track_serial) === 1) {
            if (Number(item.quantity) !== 1) throw new Error('يجب بيع القطع ذات السيريال قطعةً قطعة');
            const serials = (await apiCall('getAvailableSerials', {product_id:Number(item.product_id)})).data || [];
            if (!serials.length) throw new Error('لا يوجد سيريال متاح لهذا المنتج');
            let selected = serials[0];
            if (serials.length > 1) {
                const options = Object.fromEntries(serials.map(s => [String(s.serial_id), `${s.serial_no}${s.warranty_end_at ? ' — ضمان حتى '+s.warranty_end_at : ''}`]));
                const choice = await Swal.fire({title:'اختر السيريال',input:'select',inputOptions:options,showCancelButton:true,confirmButtonText:'اختيار',cancelButtonText:'إلغاء'});
                if (!choice.isConfirmed) throw new Error('تم إلغاء اختيار السيريال');
                selected = serials.find(s => String(s.serial_id) === String(choice.value));
            }
            item.serial_id = Number(selected.serial_id);
        }
    }
    return products;
}

async function completeSale() {
    const subtotal = getInvoiceNumberValue('subtotal', 0);
    const discountAmount = getInvoiceNumberValue('discountAmount', 0);
    const taxAmount = getInvoiceNumberValue('taxAmount', 0);
    const serviceFee = getInvoiceNumberValue('serviceFee', 0);
    const total = getInvoiceNumberValue('totalAmount', 0);
    if (subtotal < 0 || discountAmount < 0 || taxAmount < 0 || serviceFee < 0 || total < 0) { showToast('قيم ملخص الفاتورة غير صالحة', 'error'); return; }
    const paymentType = document.getElementById('paymentType').value;
    const isCredit = paymentType === 'آجل';
    const paid = isCredit ? 0 : (parseFloat(document.getElementById('amountPaid').value) || 0);
    if (!isCredit && !paid) { showToast('يرجى إدخال المبلغ المدفوع', 'error'); return; }
    if (!isCredit && paid < total) { showToast('المبلغ المدفوع أقل من الإجمالي النهائي', 'error'); return; }
    const selectedEntityId = Number(document.getElementById('customerId')?.value || 0);
    let entityId = selectedEntityId > 0 ? selectedEntityId : null;

    let selectedPaymentTermId = 0;
    if (isCredit) {
        entityId = selectedEntityId;
        if (!entityId || !selectedCreditCustomer || Number(selectedCreditCustomer.id || selectedCreditCustomer.party_id || selectedCreditCustomer.entity_id) !== entityId) {
            showToast('اختر عميلاً نشطاً للبيع الآجل', 'error');
            return;
        }
        selectedPaymentTermId = Number(document.getElementById('paymentTermsId')?.value || 0);
        if (!selectedPaymentTermId || !paymentTermRows.some(term => Number(term.id) === selectedPaymentTermId)) {
            showToast('اختر شرط الدفع من جدول شروط الدفع قبل ترحيل الفاتورة الآجلة', 'error');
            return;
        }
    }

    const products = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr')).map(row => ({
        product_id: row.getAttribute('data-product-id'),
        quantity: parseInt(row.querySelector('.quantity-input').value),
        unit_price: parseFloat(row.querySelector('td:nth-child(3)').textContent)
    }));

    if (products.length === 0) { showToast('يرجى إضافة منتجات قبل الترحيل', 'error'); return; }
    const unresolved = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr')).some(row => row.dataset.priceResolved !== '1' || row.classList.contains('price-resolving'));
    if (unresolved) { showToast('انتظر حتى يكتمل احتساب أسعار القوائم الفعلية لجميع المنتجات', 'error'); return; }

    try { await prepareDryStockProducts(products); } catch (error) { showToast(error.message || 'تعذر تجهيز الدفعة أو السيريال', 'error'); return; }

    const invoiceData = {
        invoice_number: document.getElementById('invoiceNumber').value,
        payment_type: paymentType,
        entity_id: entityId,
        products: products,
        subtotal,
        discount_amount: discountAmount,
        tax_amount: taxAmount,
        vat_amount: taxAmount,
        service_fee: serviceFee,
        total_amount: total,
        amount_paid: paid,
        payment_terms_id: isCredit ? selectedPaymentTermId : 0,
        transaction_time: businessDayDateTime(),
        occasion_code: document.getElementById('occasionCode')?.value.trim() || null,
        idempotency_key: activeSaleOperationKey || (activeSaleOperationKey = newSaleOperationKey())
    };

    showLoading(true);
    const completeButton = document.getElementById('completeSaleBtn');
    if (completeButton) completeButton.disabled = true;
    apiCall('completeSale', invoiceData)
        .then(data => {
            const sale = data.data || data;
            if (data.success && sale.success !== false && sale.sale_id) {
                showSuccessCheckmark();
                lastSaleId = sale.sale_id;
                lastInvoiceNumber = sale.invoice_number || document.getElementById('invoiceNumber').value;
                const saleSms = sale.sms || {};
                const termSnapshot = sale.payment_terms_snapshot || {};
                const termWarning = isCredit && termSnapshot.success === false
                    ? ' — تعذر تثبيت شرط الدفع على الفاتورة: ' + (termSnapshot.message || 'خطأ غير معروف')
                    : '';
                showToast('تم ترحيل البيع وتحديث المخزون فعلياً' +
                    (isCredit ? (saleSms.queued ? ' — تم وضع SMS في طابور الإرسال' : ' — تعذر تجهيز SMS: ' + (saleSms.reason || 'غير معروف')) : '') +
                    termWarning, termWarning ? 'warning' : 'success');
                // Archive the already-committed invoice independently; PDF errors must not repeat the sale.
                window._invoiceArchivePromise = queueInvoicePdfArchive(lastInvoiceNumber);
                resetForm();
            } else { showToast(sale.error || sale.message || data.error || data.message || 'تعذر ترحيل الفاتورة؛ لم يُخصم المخزون', 'error'); }
        })
        .catch(error => {
            showToast(error.message || error.error || 'تعذر ترحيل الفاتورة؛ لم يُخصم المخزون', 'error');
        })
        .finally(() => { if (completeButton) completeButton.disabled = false; showLoading(false); });
}

// ============================================================
// 11. عرض الفاتورة
// ============================================================
function escapeReceiptValue(value) {
    const node = document.createElement('span');
    node.textContent = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    return node.innerHTML;
}

function invoicePaymentLabel(paymentType) {
    const map = {
        cash: 'نقداً', 'نقداً': 'نقداً',
        credit: 'آجل', 'آجل': 'آجل',
        credit_card: 'بطاقة', bank_transfer: 'تحويل',
        cheque: 'شيك', mobile_money: 'محفظة'
    };
    return map[String(paymentType || '').trim()] || String(paymentType || 'نقداً');
}

function parseStationPhotoValue(value) {
    if (!value) return { uri: '', name: '' };
    const raw = String(value);
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
            return { uri: String(parsed.uri || parsed.path || ''), name: String(parsed.name || parsed.fileName || '') };
        }
    } catch (_) {}
    return { uri: raw, name: raw.split('/').pop() || raw };
}

async function loadCurrentStationLogo(forceReload) {
    if (stationLogoLoadPromise && !forceReload) return stationLogoLoadPromise;
    stationLogoLoadPromise = apiCall('getCurrentStationProfile', {})
        .then(profileResponse => {
            if (!profileResponse.success) throw new Error(profileResponse.message || profileResponse.error || 'تعذر جلب بيانات المحطة الحالية');
            const profile = profileResponse.data || profileResponse;
            const photoValue = profile.station_photo || '';
            const photo = parseStationPhotoValue(photoValue);
            if (!photo.uri) { stationLogoDataUrl = ''; return ''; }
            return apiCall('getStationFilePreviewDataUrl', { uri: photo.uri })
                .then(previewResponse => {
                    if (!previewResponse.success) throw new Error(previewResponse.message || previewResponse.error || 'تعذر قراءة صورة المحطة');
                    const preview = previewResponse.data || previewResponse;
                    stationLogoDataUrl = String(preview.dataUrl || '');
                    return stationLogoDataUrl;
                });
        })
        .catch(error => { stationLogoDataUrl = ''; console.warn('Station logo unavailable:', error); return ''; });
    return stationLogoLoadPromise;
}

function renderSalesInvoice(invoice, targetSection) {
    const items = Array.isArray(invoice.items) ? invoice.items : [];
    const customerName = invoice.customer_name || 'بيع نقدي';
    const payment = invoice.payment_type || 'cash';
    const isCredit = String(payment).toLowerCase() === 'credit' || String(payment) === 'آجل' || Number(invoice.is_credit || 0) === 1;

    const rows = items.map((item, index) => {
        const originalQty = Number(item.quantity || 0);
        const returnedQty = Number(item.returned_quantity || 0);
        const visibleQty = Number(item.remaining_quantity ?? Math.max(0, originalQty - returnedQty));
        const lineTotal = Number(item.net_total_price ?? item.total_price ?? 0);
        const name = item.name || item.product_name || item.product_name_ar || 'منتج';
        const returnNote = returnedQty > 0 ? `<div style="font-size:9px;color:#7b1f1f">مرتجع: ${returnedQty.toFixed(2)}</div>` : '';
        return `<tr>
            <td class="row-number-cell">${index + 1}</td>
            <td class="desc"><span class="product-name">${escapeReceiptValue(name)}</span> ${returnNote}</td>
            <td class="qty">${visibleQty.toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td class="unit">${Number(item.unit_price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td class="total">${lineTotal.toFixed(2)}</td>
        </tr>`;
    }).join('');

    const emptyRows = Array.from({ length: 2 }).map(() =>
        `<tr class="blank-row"><td class="row-number-cell"></td><td class="desc"></td><td class="qty"></td><td class="unit"></td><td class="total"></td></tr>`
    ).join('');

    const subtotal = Number(invoice.subtotal ?? 0);
    const discount = Number(invoice.discount_amount ?? 0);
    const tax = Number(invoice.tax_amount ?? invoice.vat_amount ?? 0);
    const serviceFee = Number(invoice.service_fee ?? 0);
    const net = Number(invoice.net_amount ?? invoice.total_amount ?? 0);
    const paid = Number(invoice.amount_paid ?? 0);
    const remaining = Number(invoice.remaining_amount ?? Math.max(0, net - paid));

    const section = targetSection || document.getElementById('posInvoice');
    section.innerHTML = `
      <div class="invoice-header">
        <div class="invoice-logo-circle">
          ${stationLogoDataUrl ? `<img src="${escapeReceiptValue(stationLogoDataUrl)}" alt="صورة المحطة">` : ''}
        </div>
        <div class="invoice-center">
          <div class="invoice-title">فاتورة بيع</div>
          <span class="invoice-brand-en">SALES INVOICE</span>
          <div class="invoice-payment">
            <span>${isCredit ? '☐' : '☑'} نقداً</span>
            <span>${isCredit ? '☑' : '☐'} آجل</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="invoice-meta">
          <div class="invoice-meta-pill"><span>التاريخ:</span><span class="value">${escapeReceiptValue(invoice.sale_date || '')}</span></div>
          <div class="invoice-meta-pill"><span>NO:</span><span class="value invoice-number-value" dir="ltr">${escapeReceiptValue(invoice.invoice_number || '')}</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="invoice-customer">
        <span class="label-right">مطلوب من الأخ/ الأخت:</span>
        <span class="line">${escapeReceiptValue(customerName)}</span>
        <span class="label-left">المحترم</span>
      </div>

      <table class="invoice-items">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th class="row-number">#</th>
            <th class="desc">التفاصيل<br><span style="font-size:9px">Description</span></th>
            <th class="qty">العدد<br><span style="font-size:9px">Qty</span></th>
            <th class="unit">سعر الوحدة<br><span style="font-size:9px">Unit Price</span></th>
            <th class="total">القيمة الإجمالية<br><span style="font-size:9px">Total Amount</span></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>${rows}${emptyRows}</tbody>
      </table>

      <div class="invoice-summary">
        <div class="invoice-summary-row">
          <div class="invoice-summary-card"><div class="summary-label">الخصم</div><div class="summary-value">${discount.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
          <div class="invoice-summary-card"><div class="summary-label">الضريبة</div><div class="summary-value">${tax.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
          <div class="invoice-summary-card"><div class="summary-label">رسوم توصيل</div><div class="summary-value">${serviceFee.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
          <div class="invoice-summary-card"><div class="summary-label">المدفوع</div><div class="summary-value">${paid.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
          <div class="invoice-summary-card"><div class="summary-label">المتبقي</div><div class="summary-value">${remaining.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="invoice-footer">
        <div class="invoice-footer-labels"><span>اسم المستلم</span><span>التوقيع</span><span>المبيعات</span></div>
        <div class="invoice-footer-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="receipt-note">استلمت البضاعة الموضحة أعلاه كاملة وسليمة</div>
    `;
    section.dataset.invoiceNumber = String(invoice.invoice_number || '');
    return section;
}

function renderReceiptForPrint(invoice) {
    return renderSalesInvoice(invoice);
}

async function loadInvoiceForLastSale() {
    const invoiceNumber = lastInvoiceNumber;
    if (!invoiceNumber) throw new Error('لا توجد فاتورة محفوظة حالياً');
    const response = await apiCall('retrieveInvoice', { invoice_number: invoiceNumber });
    if (!response.success) throw new Error(response.message || response.error || 'تعذر تحميل الفاتورة من SQLite');
    return response.data || response;
}

function queueInvoicePdfArchive(invoiceNumber) {
    // The SAF picker and callback bridge are single-flight operations. Serialize
    // archive requests so two fast sales cannot overwrite the pending invoice HTML.
    const previous = window._invoiceArchivePromise;
    const next = Promise.resolve(previous)
        .catch(error => {
            console.warn('[Invoice PDF Archive] Previous queued operation failed:', error);
            return false;
        })
        .then(() => persistInvoicePdfAfterSale(invoiceNumber));
    window._invoiceArchivePromise = next;
    return next;
}

async function persistInvoicePdfAfterSale(invoiceNumber, showFailureToast = true) {
    if (!invoiceNumber || !window.AndroidInterface || typeof AndroidInterface.saveInvoicePdf !== 'function') return false;
    try {
        const response = await apiCall('retrieveInvoice', { invoice_number: invoiceNumber });
        if (!response || !response.success) throw new Error(response?.message || response?.error || 'تعذر استرجاع الفاتورة المرحلة');
        const invoice = response.data || response;
        await loadCurrentStationLogo();
        // Render into a detached node so background archiving cannot replace the
        // currently displayed invoice if the cashier starts another sale.
        const archiveSection = document.createElement('section');
        archiveSection.id = 'posInvoice';
        archiveSection.classList.add('pos-invoice');
        renderSalesInvoice(invoice, archiveSection);
        await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(resolve, 450)));
        const capture = buildCaptureDocument(archiveSection);
        // Keep the document in the page context while Android's SAF picker is open;
        // avoid sending a potentially multi-megabyte HTML string through evaluateJavascript.
        window._pendingInvoiceArchiveHtml = capture.html;
        const saveResult = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            let timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                clearPendingCall('saveInvoicePdf');
                reject(new Error('انتهت مهلة حفظ PDF في الأرشيف'));
            }, 180000);
            registerPendingCall('saveInvoicePdf', result => {
                if (timeoutId) { clearTimeout(timeoutId); timeoutId = null; }
                resolve(result);
            });
            try {
                const ack = JSON.parse(AndroidInterface.saveInvoicePdf(capture.html));
                if (!ack.success && !ack.queued) {
                    clearPendingCall('saveInvoicePdf');
                    if (timeoutId) { clearTimeout(timeoutId); timeoutId = null; }
                    reject(new Error(ack.error || ack.message || 'تعذر بدء حفظ PDF'));
                }
            } catch (error) {
                clearPendingCall('saveInvoicePdf');
                if (timeoutId) { clearTimeout(timeoutId); timeoutId = null; }
                reject(error);
            }
        });
        if (!saveResult || !saveResult.success) throw new Error(saveResult?.error || 'فشل حفظ PDF');
        console.info('[Invoice PDF Archive] Saved', invoiceNumber, saveResult.file_name, saveResult.bytes);
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        // Keep the committed sale intact, but expose the archive failure instead of
        // silently treating a missing PDF as a completed background task.
        console.error('[Invoice PDF Archive] Failed; sale remains committed:', invoiceNumber, error);
        if (showFailureToast) {
            showToast('تم ترحيل البيع، لكن تعذر حفظ نسخة PDF. يمكنك إعادة المحاولة من زر واتساب.', 'warning');
        }
        return false;
    }
}

// Called by MainActivity after the user selects the archive folder in Android's
// system folder picker. Re-enter the same bridge operation without re-registering
// the JS promise; its original pending callback remains responsible for completion.
window.resumeInvoicePdfAfterFolderSelection = function(callbackAction, phone) {
    const action = callbackAction === 'shareInvoiceJpg' ? 'shareInvoiceJpg' : 'saveInvoicePdf';
    try {
        // The SAF picker may have been opened either by automatic post-sale archiving
        // or by an active WhatsApp request. Resume the exact pending operation.
        const invoiceHtml = action === 'shareInvoiceJpg'
            ? window._lastShareHtml
            : window._pendingInvoiceArchiveHtml;
        if (!invoiceHtml || !window.AndroidInterface) {
            window.handleAndroidResult(action, {
                success: false,
                error: 'تعذر استئناف عملية الفاتورة بعد اختيار المجلد'
            });
            return;
        }
        let rawAck;
        if (action === 'shareInvoiceJpg') {
            if (typeof AndroidInterface.shareInvoiceJpg !== 'function') {
                throw new Error('وظيفة مشاركة PDF غير متاحة');
            }
            const targetPhone = String(phone || window._lastSharePhone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            rawAck = AndroidInterface.shareInvoiceJpg(String(invoiceHtml), targetPhone);
        } else {
            if (typeof AndroidInterface.saveInvoicePdf !== 'function') {
                throw new Error('وظيفة حفظ PDF غير متاحة');
            }
            rawAck = AndroidInterface.saveInvoicePdf(String(invoiceHtml));
        }
        const ack = typeof rawAck === 'string' ? JSON.parse(rawAck) : rawAck;
        if (!ack || (!ack.success && !ack.queued)) {
            window.handleAndroidResult(action, {
                success: false,
                error: ack && (ack.error || ack.message) || 'تعذر استئناف عملية PDF داخل المجلد المحدد'
            });
        }
    } catch (error) {
        window.handleAndroidResult(action, {
            success: false,
            error: error && error.message ? error.message : 'تعذر استئناف عملية PDF'
        });
    }
}

async function printReceipt() {
    try {
        showLoading(true);
        const response = await loadInvoiceForLastSale();
        const invoice = response.data || response;
        const printDocumentName = String(invoice.invoice_number || lastInvoiceNumber || '').trim();
        if (!printDocumentName) throw new Error('رقم الفاتورة غير متوفر للطباعة');

        // Do not open the print preview until this invoice has a verified PDF in
        // the folder selected by the user. Retry a failed archive once; this never
        // re-posts the sale, and detailed renderer diagnostics remain in the log.
        let archiveSucceeded = false;
        if (window._invoiceArchivePromise && typeof window._invoiceArchivePromise.then === 'function') {
            try {
                archiveSucceeded = (await window._invoiceArchivePromise) === true;
            } catch (archiveError) {
                console.warn('[Invoice PDF Archive] Previous archive attempt failed:', archiveError);
            }
        }
        if (!archiveSucceeded) {
            archiveSucceeded = (await persistInvoicePdfAfterSale(printDocumentName, false)) === true;
            window._invoiceArchivePromise = Promise.resolve(archiveSucceeded);
        }
        if (!archiveSucceeded) {
            throw new Error('تعذر حفظ نسخة PDF في مجلد فواتير المبيعات المحدد. أعد المحاولة.');
        }

        await loadCurrentStationLogo();
        renderReceiptForPrint(response.data || response);

        // إجبار المتصفح على إعادة حساب الأبعاد (Reflow) لضمان رؤية العناصر المخفية
        const posInv = document.getElementById('posInvoice');
        if (posInv) {
            posInv.offsetHeight; // Trigger reflow
        }

        // إعطاء وقت كافٍ لتحميل الصور والخطوط قبل استدعاء أمر الطباعة
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800));

        // Set the live document title as well as the native print-job title.
        // Some Android print-service versions derive the suggested PDF filename
        // from the WebView document title rather than the print-job label alone.
        const originalDocumentTitle = document.title;
        document.title = printDocumentName;
        try {
            const printResult = await apiCall('printReceipt', { invoice_number: printDocumentName });
            if (!printResult.success) throw new Error(printResult.message || printResult.error || 'فشل فتح نافذة الطباعة');
            showToast(printResult.message || 'تم فتح فاتورة البيع للطباعة', 'success');
        } finally {
            document.title = originalDocumentTitle;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        showToast(error.message || 'حدث خطأ أثناء الطباعة', 'error');
    } finally {
        showLoading(false);
    }
}

// ============================================================
// 12. WhatsApp
// ============================================================
function normalizeWhatsappPhone(raw) {
    let digits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!digits) return { ok: false, number: '', reason: 'الرقم فارغ' };
    if (digits.startsWith('00')) digits = digits.slice(2);

    if (digits.startsWith('967')) {
        const local = digits.slice(3);
        if (local.length >= 8 && local.length <= 10) return { ok: true, number: digits, country: 'Yemen' };
        return { ok: false, number: '', reason: 'الرقم اليمني غير مكتمل' };
    }
    if (digits.startsWith('0') && digits.length === 10 && digits[1] === '7') {
        return { ok: true, number: '967' + digits.slice(1), country: 'Yemen' };
    }
    if (digits.startsWith('7') && digits.length === 9) {
        return { ok: true, number: '967' + digits, country: 'Yemen' };
    }
    if (digits.length >= 10 && digits.length <= 15) {
        return { ok: true, number: digits, country: 'International' };
    }
    return { ok: false, number: '', reason: 'رقم غير صالح — أدخل رقماً يمنياً أو دولياً' };
}

function renderWhatsappInvoicePreview(invoice) {
    const scaler = document.getElementById('waInvoicePreviewScaler');
    const fullscreenScaler = document.getElementById('waInvoiceFullscreenScaler');
    if (!scaler) return;

    const source = document.getElementById('posInvoice');
    if (!source) return;

    const textPreview = document.getElementById('waInvoicePreview');
    if (textPreview) textPreview.style.display = 'none';

    const cloned = source.cloneNode(true);
    cloned.removeAttribute('id');
    cloned.classList.add('pos-invoice');
    cloned.style.display = 'block';
    cloned.style.visibility = 'visible';
    cloned.style.opacity = '1';
    cloned.style.position = 'relative';
    cloned.style.left = '0';
    cloned.style.top = '0';
    cloned.style.zIndex = 'auto';
    cloned.style.isolation = 'isolate';
    cloned.style.transform = 'none';

    scaler.innerHTML = '';
    scaler.appendChild(cloned);

    if (fullscreenScaler) {
        fullscreenScaler.innerHTML = '';
        const fullClone = source.cloneNode(true);
        fullClone.removeAttribute('id');
        fullClone.classList.add('pos-invoice');
        fullClone.style.display = 'block';
        fullClone.style.visibility = 'visible';
        fullClone.style.opacity = '1';
        fullClone.style.position = 'relative';
        fullClone.style.left = '0';
        fullClone.style.top = '0';
        fullClone.style.zIndex = 'auto';
        fullClone.style.isolation = 'isolate';
        fullClone.style.transform = 'none';
        fullClone.style.width = '794px';
        fullClone.style.minHeight = '1123px';
        fullClone.style.background = '#fff';
        fullClone.style.padding = '38px 34px 30px';
        fullClone.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
        fullscreenScaler.appendChild(fullClone);
    }
}

function openWhatsappShare() {
    if (_whatsappBusy) return;
    _whatsappBusy = true;

    if (!lastInvoiceNumber) {
        _whatsappBusy = false;
        showToast('لا توجد فاتورة حديثة للمشاركة. قم بترحيل عملية بيع أولاً', 'warning');
        return;
    }

    forceHideLoading();
    _lastShareAttemptFailed = false;
    hideBlankWarning();

    const previewEl = document.getElementById('waInvoicePreview');
    const timeEl = document.getElementById('waMessageTime');
    if (previewEl) previewEl.textContent = 'جارٍ تحضير تفاصيل الفاتورة...';
    if (timeEl) timeEl.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ar-EG', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    const phoneInput = document.getElementById('waPhoneInput');
    const validationMsg = document.getElementById('waValidationMsg');
    if (phoneInput) phoneInput.value = '';
    if (validationMsg) { validationMsg.textContent = ''; validationMsg.classList.remove('show'); }

    const modal = document.getElementById('whatsappShareModal');
    if (modal) modal.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => { if (phoneInput) phoneInput.focus(); }, 250);

    (async () => {
        try {
            const response = await loadInvoiceForLastSale();
            const invoice = response.data || response;
            _currentWhatsappInvoice = invoice;

            await loadCurrentStationLogo();
            renderSalesInvoice(invoice);
            renderWhatsappInvoicePreview(invoice);

            if (previewEl) previewEl.textContent = buildInvoiceWhatsAppText(invoice);

            const customerPhone = String(invoice.customer_phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            if (customerPhone && phoneInput) {
                let national = customerPhone;
                if (national.startsWith('967')) national = national.slice(3);
                if (national.startsWith('0')) national = national.slice(1);
                phoneInput.value = national;
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('WhatsApp invoice load failed:', error);
            if (previewEl) previewEl.textContent = 'تعذر تحميل تفاصيل الفاتورة: ' + (error.message || '');
        } finally {
            _whatsappBusy = false;
        }
    })();
}

function closeWhatsappShare() {
    if (_whatsappBusy && _pendingCalls.has('shareInvoiceJpg')) {
        showWhatsappValidation('الرجاء الانتظار حتى اكتمال تجهيز الصورة');
        return;
    }
    const modal = document.getElementById('whatsappShareModal');
    if (modal) modal.classList.remove('show');
    closeWhatsappInvoiceFullscreen();
    _whatsappBusy = false;
    _currentWhatsappInvoice = null;
    hideBlankWarning();
    hideRetryBtn();
}

/**
 * ✅ تم إصلاح مشكلة القص الأفقي وعدم القدرة على التمرير
 */
function openWhatsappInvoiceFullscreen() {
    const fullscreen = document.getElementById('waInvoiceFullscreen');
    if (!fullscreen) return;
    fullscreen.classList.add('show');

    // Recalculate after the modal is visible; use the real mobile viewport as a hard
    // upper bound as WebView layouts can report a wider CSS viewport on some devices.
    const fitInvoiceToViewport = () => {
        const container = fullscreen.querySelector('.wa-invoice-fullscreen-body');
        const wrapper = document.getElementById('waFullscreenWrapper');
        const scaler = document.getElementById('waInvoiceFullscreenScaler');
        if (!container || !wrapper || !scaler || !fullscreen.classList.contains('show')) return;

        const style = window.getComputedStyle(container);
        const horizontalPadding =
            (parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0) + (parseFloat(style.paddingRight) || 0);
        const measuredWidth = Math.max(0, container.clientWidth - horizontalPadding);
        const viewportWidth = Math.max(
            1,
            Math.floor(
                (window.visualViewport && window.visualViewport.width) ||
                document.documentElement.clientWidth ||
                window.innerWidth ||
                measuredWidth
            )
        );

        // Keep a small safety margin so shadows/borders never cross the phone edges.
        const safeViewportWidth = Math.max(1, viewportWidth - 20);
        const availableWidth = Math.max(
            1,
            Math.min(measuredWidth > 0 ? measuredWidth : safeViewportWidth, safeViewportWidth)
        );
        const invoiceWidth = 794;
        const scale = Math.min(1, availableWidth / invoiceWidth);

        // Establish the unscaled document width before measuring height. Measuring first
        // can capture a stale/narrow layout and leave the scaled invoice clipped vertically.
        scaler.style.width = invoiceWidth + 'px';
        scaler.style.minWidth = invoiceWidth + 'px';
        scaler.style.maxWidth = 'none';
        scaler.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ')';
        scaler.style.transformOrigin = 'top left';

        // Read after layout has been forced at the final width. Include scroll and rendered
        // bounds because long invoices can exceed one A4 page.
        const naturalHeight = Math.max(
            1123,
            scaler.scrollHeight || 0,
            scaler.offsetHeight || 0,
            scaler.getBoundingClientRect().height / Math.max(scale, 0.01) || 0
        );

        // Transforms do not affect normal layout size; size the scroll wrapper to the
        // transformed bounds, including invoices with more rows than a single A4 page.
        wrapper.style.width = Math.ceil(invoiceWidth * scale) + 'px';
        wrapper.style.height = Math.ceil(naturalHeight * scale) + 'px';
        wrapper.style.maxWidth = '100%';
        wrapper.style.marginLeft = 'auto';
        wrapper.style.marginRight = 'auto';
        wrapper.style.flexShrink = '0';
        wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
        container.scrollLeft = 0;
    };

    // The first frame opens the dialog; the next frame has its final available width.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(fitInvoiceToViewport);
    });
    setTimeout(fitInvoiceToViewport, 180);

    // Refit after rotation, keyboard/display viewport changes, or split-screen resizing.
    if (fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler) {
        window.removeEventListener('resize', fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler);
        if (window.visualViewport) {
            window.visualViewport.removeEventListener('resize', fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler);
        }
    }
    fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler = fitInvoiceToViewport;
    window.addEventListener('resize', fitInvoiceToViewport, { passive: true });
    if (window.visualViewport) {
        window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', fitInvoiceToViewport, { passive: true });
    }
}
function closeWhatsappInvoiceFullscreen() {
    const fullscreen = document.getElementById('waInvoiceFullscreen');
    if (!fullscreen) return;
    fullscreen.classList.remove('show');
    if (fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler) {
        window.removeEventListener('resize', fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler);
        if (window.visualViewport) {
            window.visualViewport.removeEventListener('resize', fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler);
        }
        fullscreen._invoiceFitHandler = null;
    }
}

function buildInvoiceWhatsAppText(invoice) {
    const pad = (n) => Number(n || 0).toFixed(2);
    const items = Array.isArray(invoice.items) ? invoice.items : [];
    const lines = [];
    lines.push('*فاتورة بيع — محطة أبو أحمد*');
    lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
    lines.push(`رقم الفاتورة: ${invoice.invoice_number || '-'}`);
    lines.push(`التاريخ: ${invoice.sale_date || '-'}`);
    lines.push(`العميل: ${invoice.customer_name || 'بيع نقدي'}`);
    lines.push(`طريقة الدفع: ${invoice.payment_type || 'نقداً'}`);
    lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
    lines.push('*المنتجات:*');
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
        const qty = Number(item.quantity || 0);
        const price = Number(item.unit_price || 0);
        const total = Number(item.total_price || (qty * price));
        const name = item.name || item.product_name || item.product_name_ar || 'منتج';
        lines.push(`${i + 1}. ${name}`);
        lines.push(`   ${qty} × ${pad(price)} = ${pad(total)}`);
    });
    lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
    lines.push(`الإجمالي الفرعي: ${pad(invoice.subtotal)}`);
    if (Number(invoice.discount_amount || 0) > 0) lines.push(`الخصم: ${pad(invoice.discount_amount)}`);
    if (Number(invoice.tax_amount || 0) > 0) lines.push(`الضريبة: ${pad(invoice.tax_amount)}`);
    if (Number(invoice.service_fee || 0) > 0) lines.push(`رسوم توصيل: ${pad(invoice.service_fee)}`);
    lines.push(`*الإجمالي: ${pad(invoice.net_amount ?? invoice.total_amount)}*`);
    lines.push(`المدفوع: ${pad(invoice.amount_paid)}`);
    lines.push(`المتبقي: ${pad(invoice.remaining_amount)}`);
    return lines.join('\n');
}

function showWhatsappValidation(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('waValidationMsg');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => { el.classList.remove('show'); }, 4000);
}

function showBlankWarning(message) {
    const warning = document.getElementById('waBlankWarning');
    const text = document.getElementById('waBlankWarningText');
    if (!warning || !text) return;
    text.textContent = message || 'تعذر تحويل الفاتورة إلى صورة، يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى';
    warning.classList.add('show');
}
function hideBlankWarning() {
    const warning = document.getElementById('waBlankWarning');
    if (warning) warning.classList.remove('show');
}

function showRetryBtn() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('waRetryBtn');
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('show');
}
function hideRetryBtn() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('waRetryBtn');
    if (btn) btn.classList.remove('show');
}

async function retryWhatsappShare() {
    if (_whatsappBusy) return;
    if (!_lastShareHtml || !_lastSharePhone) {
        showWhatsappValidation('لا توجد بيانات سابقة لإعادة المحاولة. أغلق النافذة وأعد الإرسال');
        return;
    }
    hideBlankWarning();
    hideRetryBtn();
    const phoneInput = document.getElementById('waPhoneInput');
    if (phoneInput) phoneInput.value = _lastSharePhone;
    await sendWhatsappInvoice();
}

function buildCaptureDocument(invoiceSectionOverride) {
    const invoiceSection = invoiceSectionOverride || document.getElementById('posInvoice');
    if (!invoiceSection || !invoiceSection.innerHTML.trim()) {
        throw new Error('تصميم الفاتورة غير جاهز للإرسال');
    }

    const captured = invoiceSection.cloneNode(true);
    captured.id = 'posInvoice';
    captured.classList.add('pos-invoice');

    const forceStyle = (el, prop, val) => el && el.style.setProperty(prop, val, 'important');

    forceStyle(captured, 'display', 'block');
    forceStyle(captured, 'visibility', 'visible');
    forceStyle(captured, 'opacity', '1');
    forceStyle(captured, 'position', 'relative');
    forceStyle(captured, 'left', '0');
    forceStyle(captured, 'top', '0');
    forceStyle(captured, 'z-index', 'auto');
    forceStyle(captured, 'isolation', 'isolate');
    forceStyle(captured, 'transform', 'none');
    forceStyle(captured, 'width', '794px');
    forceStyle(captured, 'min-height', '1123px');
    forceStyle(captured, 'height', 'auto');
    forceStyle(captured, 'background-color', '#ffffff');
    forceStyle(captured, 'color', '#172b45');
    forceStyle(captured, 'margin', '0 auto');
    forceStyle(captured, 'padding', '38px 34px 30px');
    forceStyle(captured, 'box-sizing', 'border-box');
    forceStyle(captured, 'direction', 'rtl');
    forceStyle(captured, 'font-family', 'Cairo, "Noto Sans Arabic", Arial, sans-serif');
    forceStyle(captured, 'font-variant-numeric', 'lining-nums tabular-nums');
    forceStyle(captured, 'overflow', 'visible');
    forceStyle(captured, '-webkit-print-color-adjust', 'exact');
    forceStyle(captured, 'print-color-adjust', 'exact');

    const invoiceStyleRaw = document.getElementById('posInvoiceStyleBlock')?.outerHTML || '';
    const invoiceStyleSanitized = invoiceStyleRaw
        .replace(/display\s*:\s*none\s*;?/gi, 'display: block;')
        .replace(/visibility\s*:\s*hidden\s*;?/gi, 'visibility: visible;')
        .replace(/opacity\s*:\s*0\s*;?/gi, 'opacity: 1;');

    const overrideStyle = `
<style id="posInvoiceCaptureOverride">
    html, body {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        background: #ffffff !important;
        background-color: #ffffff !important;
        direction: rtl !important;
        width: 794px !important;
        min-width: 794px !important;
        max-width: 794px !important;
        min-height: 1123px !important;
        overflow: visible !important;
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
        print-color-adjust: exact !important;
    }
    body > #posInvoice, #posInvoice {
        display: block !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        position: relative !important;
        left: 0 !important;
        top: 0 !important;
        z-index: auto !important;
        transform: none !important;
        isolation: isolate !important;
        width: 794px !important;
        min-width: 794px !important;
        min-height: 1123px !important;
        margin: 0 auto !important;
        background: #ffffff !important;
        background-color: #ffffff !important;
        padding: 38px 34px 30px !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
        print-color-adjust: exact !important;
    }
    #posInvoice * {
        visibility: visible !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
        print-color-adjust: exact !important;
    }
    #posInvoice .invoice-header {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr 1fr !important;
        gap: 15px !important;
        padding: 22px !important;
    }
    #posInvoice .invoice-meta { order: initial !important; }
    #posInvoice .invoice-center { order: initial !important; margin-top: 0 !important; }
    #posInvoice .invoice-logo-circle { width: 128px !important; height: 128px !important; right: -18px !important; }
    #posInvoice .invoice-title { font-size: 22px !important; padding: 9px 45px !important; }
    #posInvoice .invoice-items th,
    #posInvoice .invoice-items td { font-size: 11px !important; padding: 8px 5px !important; }
</style>`;

    // Carry the authoritative invoice number as document metadata. Kotlin must not
    // depend on one specific CSS class to identify a financial document.
    const invoiceNumber = String(
        captured.dataset.invoiceNumber ||
        captured.querySelector('.invoice-number-value')?.textContent ||
        document.getElementById('invoiceNumber')?.value ||
        lastInvoiceNumber ||
        ''
    ).trim();
    if (!invoiceNumber) {
        throw new Error('رقم الفاتورة غير متوفر في بيانات الفاتورة');
    }
    const invoiceNumberAttribute = invoiceNumber
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    const invoiceNumberMeta = '<meta name="invoice-number" content="' + invoiceNumberAttribute + '">';
    const viewportMeta = '<meta name="viewport" content="width=794, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">';

    const invoiceHtml =
        '<!DOCTYPE html>' +
        '<html lang="ar" dir="rtl" data-theme="light">' +
        '<head>' +
            '<meta charset="UTF-8">' +
            invoiceNumberMeta +
            viewportMeta +
            invoiceStyleSanitized +
            overrideStyle +
        '</head>' +
        '<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#ffffff;width:794px;min-height:1123px;">' +
            captured.outerHTML +
        '</body>' +
        '</html>';

    const rowsCount = captured.querySelectorAll('.invoice-items tbody tr').length;
    const itemsCount = captured.querySelectorAll('.invoice-items tbody td').length;
    const hasLogo = !!captured.querySelector('.invoice-logo-circle img');
    const logoSrcLen = (captured.querySelector('.invoice-logo-circle img')?.getAttribute('src') || '').length;

    console.log('[WhatsApp Capture] Diagnostics:', {
        htmlLength: invoiceHtml.length,
        rowsCount,
        itemsCount,
        hasLogo,
        logoSrcBytes: logoSrcLen,
        capturedDisplay: captured.style.display,
        invoiceInnerLength: invoiceSection.innerHTML.length
    });

    const approxBytes = new Blob([invoiceHtml]).size;
    if (approxBytes > 1_500_000) {
        console.warn('[WhatsApp Capture] HTML too large:', approxBytes, 'bytes; stripping logo to fit bridge limit');
        const logoImg = captured.querySelector('.invoice-logo-circle img');
        if (logoImg) logoImg.remove();
        return buildCaptureDocumentWithoutLogo(captured, invoiceStyleSanitized, overrideStyle, invoiceNumberMeta);
    }

    return { html: invoiceHtml, diagnostics: { rowsCount, itemsCount, hasLogo, logoSrcLen, approxBytes } };
}

function buildCaptureDocumentWithoutLogo(captured, sanitizedStyle, overrideStyle, invoiceNumberMeta) {
    const html = '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="UTF-8">' +
        invoiceNumberMeta +
        '<meta name="viewport" content="width=794, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">' +
        sanitizedStyle + overrideStyle + '</head>' +
        '<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#ffffff;width:794px;min-height:1123px;">' +
        captured.outerHTML + '</body></html>';
    console.warn('[WhatsApp Capture] Rebuilt HTML without logo:', html.length, 'chars');
    return { html, diagnostics: { logoSrcLen: 0, approxBytes: html.length } };
}

async function sendWhatsappInvoice() {
    if (_whatsappBusy) return;
    const invoice = _currentWhatsappInvoice;
    if (!invoice) { showWhatsappValidation('لم يتم تحميل الفاتورة بعد. الرجاء الانتظار'); return; }
    const phoneInput = document.getElementById('waPhoneInput');
    const raw = (phoneInput && phoneInput.value || '').trim();
    if (!raw) { showWhatsappValidation('الرجاء إدخال رقم واتساب العميل'); if (phoneInput) phoneInput.focus(); return; }
    const result = normalizeWhatsappPhone(raw);
    if (!result.ok) { showWhatsappValidation(result.reason || 'رقم غير صالح'); if (phoneInput) phoneInput.focus(); return; }

    const sendBtn = document.getElementById('waSendBtn');
    if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = true;
    _whatsappBusy = true;
    hideBlankWarning();
    hideRetryBtn();
    showLoading(true);

    const awaitBridge = (action, invoke, timeoutMs = 120000) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        let settled = false;
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            clearPendingCall(action);
            reject(new Error('انتهت مهلة ' + (action === 'saveInvoicePdf' ? 'حفظ' : 'تجهيز') + ' PDF'));
        }, timeoutMs);
        registerPendingCall(action, value => {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            resolve(value);
        });
        try {
            const rawAck = invoke();
            const ack = typeof rawAck === 'string' ? JSON.parse(rawAck) : rawAck;
            if (!ack || (!ack.success && !ack.queued)) {
                settled = true;
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                clearPendingCall(action);
                reject(Object.assign(new Error(ack && (ack.error || ack.message) || 'تعذر بدء عملية PDF'), { code: ack && ack.code }));
            }
        } catch (error) {
            if (!settled) {
                settled = true;
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                clearPendingCall(action);
                reject(error);
            }
        }
    });

    try {
        if (!window.AndroidInterface) throw new Error('التطبيق غير متاح');
        const invoiceNumber = String(invoice.invoice_number || lastInvoiceNumber || '').trim();
        if (!invoiceNumber) throw new Error('رقم الفاتورة غير متوفر');

        // Critical race fix: sale archiving is asynchronous. Wait for its exact
        // operation to finish before checking the saved PDF.
        if (window._invoiceArchivePromise && typeof window._invoiceArchivePromise.then === 'function') {
            showToast('جاري إكمال حفظ الفاتورة قبل المشاركة...', 'info');
            await window._invoiceArchivePromise;
        }

        let shareResult = null;
        if (typeof AndroidInterface.shareSavedInvoicePdf === 'function') {
            try {
                const rawAck = AndroidInterface.shareSavedInvoicePdf(invoiceNumber, result.number);
                shareResult = typeof rawAck === 'string' ? JSON.parse(rawAck) : rawAck;
                if (!shareResult || !shareResult.success) {
                    throw Object.assign(new Error(shareResult && (shareResult.error || shareResult.message) || 'لا توجد نسخة محفوظة صالحة'), { code: shareResult && shareResult.code });
                }
                _lastShareAttemptFailed = false;
                showToast('تم فتح واتساب بالنسخة المحفوظة من الفاتورة', 'success');
                closeWhatsappShare();
                return;
            } catch (savedError) {
                console.warn('[WhatsApp] Saved PDF unavailable; regenerating from the current invoice:', savedError);
            }
        }

        // Real non-print fallback: regenerate and validate the PDF through the
        // existing native invoice pipeline, then share it. Never launch PrintManager
        // automatically from the WhatsApp button.
        if (typeof AndroidInterface.shareInvoiceJpg !== 'function') {
            throw new Error('لا توجد نسخة محفوظة، ومسار إنشاء PDF المباشر غير متاح');
        }
        await loadCurrentStationLogo();
        const response = await apiCall('retrieveInvoice', { invoice_number: invoiceNumber });
        if (!response || !response.success) throw new Error(response && (response.error || response.message) || 'تعذر استرجاع الفاتورة المرحلة');
        const archivedInvoice = response.data || response;
        const archiveSection = document.createElement('section');
        archiveSection.id = 'posInvoice';
        archiveSection.classList.add('pos-invoice');
        renderSalesInvoice(archivedInvoice, archiveSection);
        await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(resolve, 450)));
        const capture = buildCaptureDocument(archiveSection);
        _lastShareHtml = capture.html;
        _lastSharePhone = result.number;
        showToast('النسخة المحفوظة غير متاحة؛ يجري إنشاء PDF من الفاتورة المرحلة...', 'info');
        shareResult = await awaitBridge('shareInvoiceJpg', () =>
            AndroidInterface.shareInvoiceJpg(capture.html, result.number), 180000);
        if (!shareResult || !shareResult.success) {
            throw new Error(shareResult && (shareResult.error || shareResult.message) || 'فشل إنشاء PDF ومشاركته');
        }
        _lastShareAttemptFailed = false;
        hideBlankWarning();
        hideRetryBtn();
        showToast('تم إنشاء PDF من الفاتورة المرحلة وفتح واتساب لمشاركته', 'success');
        closeWhatsappShare();
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[WhatsApp invoice share failed]', error);
        _lastShareAttemptFailed = true;
        const message = error && error.message ? error.message : 'تعذرت مشاركة الفاتورة';
        showBlankWarning(message + ' — لم تُفتح نافذة الطباعة تلقائياً. تحقق من صلاحية مجلد Invoices ثم أعد المحاولة.');
        showWhatsappValidation(message);
        showRetryBtn();
    } finally {
        clearPendingCall('shareSavedInvoicePdf');
        clearPendingCall('shareInvoiceJpg');
        clearPendingCall('saveInvoicePdf');
        _whatsappBusy = false;
        if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = false;
        showLoading(false);
    }
}
async function deliverLastPurchase() {
    try {
        let saleId = Number(lastSaleId || 0);
        if (!(saleId > 0) && lastInvoiceNumber) {
            const invoice = await loadInvoiceForLastSale();
            saleId = Number(invoice.sale_id || 0);
        }
        if (!(saleId > 0)) {
            showToast('لا توجد عملية بيع محفوظة لإنشاء طلب توصيل', 'error');
            return;
        }
        window.location.href = `deliveries.html?sale_id=${encodeURIComponent(saleId)}`;
    } catch (error) {
        showToast(error.message || 'تعذر فتح شاشة توصيل المشتريات', 'error');
    }
}

// ============================================================
// 13. دوال العملاء
// ============================================================
function customerDatabaseId(customer) {
    return Number(customer && (customer.id || customer.party_id || 0));
}

function customerDisplayName(customer) {
    return String(customer && (customer.commercial_name || customer.commercial_name_ar || customer.name || customer.legal_name || customer.party_code) || '—');
}

function renderCreditCustomerResults(query = '') {
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('customerSearchResults');
    if (!resultsContainer) return;
    const normalizedQuery = String(query || '').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('ar');
    const matches = creditCustomers.filter(customer => {
        const searchable = `${customerDisplayName(customer)} ${customer.party_code || ''} ${customer.primary_phone || ''}`.toLocaleLowerCase('ar');
        return !normalizedQuery || searchable.includes(normalizedQuery);
    });
    resultsContainer.replaceChildren();
    if (!matches.length) {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        const cell = document.createElement('td');
        cell.colSpan = 3;
        cell.textContent = creditCustomers.length ? 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة' : 'لا يوجد عملاء نشطون ضمن المحطة الحالية';
        row.appendChild(cell);
        resultsContainer.appendChild(row);
        return;
    }
    matches.forEach(customer => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        row.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        row.title = 'انقر مرتين لتحديد هذا العميل';
        const code = document.createElement('td');
        code.textContent = customer.party_code || String(customerDatabaseId(customer));
        const name = document.createElement('td');
        name.textContent = customerDisplayName(customer);
        const action = document.createElement('td');
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-primary';
        button.textContent = 'اختيار';
        button.addEventListener('click', () => selectCreditCustomer(customer));
        action.appendChild(button);
        row.append(code, name, action);
        row.addEventListener('dblclick', function () { selectCreditCustomer(customer); });
        resultsContainer.appendChild(row);
    });
}

function openCreditCustomerModal() {
    if (document.getElementById('paymentType').value !== 'آجل') return;
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('customerSearchInput');
    if (!searchInput) { showToast('تعذر فتح اختيار العميل', 'error'); return; }
    openModal('customerSearchModal');
    searchInput.value = '';
    renderCreditCustomerResults();
    loadCustomers().finally(() => renderCreditCustomerResults(searchInput.value));
    setTimeout(() => { try { searchInput.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (_) {} }, 120);
}

function loadCustomers() {
    return apiCall('getCustomers', {})
        .then(data => {
            const select = document.getElementById('customerId');
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر عميل</option>';
            const raw = data.data || data.customers || [];
            const list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (Array.isArray(raw.rows) ? raw.rows : []);
            if (data.success) {
                creditCustomers = list.filter(customer => customer && customerDatabaseId(customer) > 0 && customer.is_active !== 0 && customer.is_deleted !== 1);
                // Reconcile a customer selected before the asynchronous lookup completed.
                const selectedId = Number(document.getElementById('customerId')?.value || 0);
                if (selectedId > 0) {
                    const refreshedCustomer = creditCustomers.find(customer => customerDatabaseId(customer) === selectedId);
                    if (refreshedCustomer) {
                        selectedCreditCustomer = refreshedCustomer;
                        syncPosPaymentTermForCustomer(refreshedCustomer);
                    }
                }
                updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
                creditCustomers.forEach(customer => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = String(customerDatabaseId(customer));
                    option.textContent = customerDisplayName(customer);
                    select.appendChild(option);
                });
            } else { throw new Error(data.message || 'تعذر جلب العملاء من قاعدة البيانات'); }
        })
        .catch(error => { creditCustomers = []; console.error('Error loading customers:', error); showToast(error.message || 'تعذر جلب العملاء للبيع الآجل', 'error'); });
}


function paymentTermDaysFromCustomer(customer) {
    if (!customer) return null;
    const rawDays = customer.payment_terms_days ?? customer.paymentTermsDays;
    if (rawDays !== null && rawDays !== undefined && String(rawDays).trim() !== '') {
        const days = Number(rawDays);
        if (Number.isInteger(days) && days >= 0 && days <= 365) return days;
    }
    const text = String(customer.payment_terms || customer.payment_terms_text || customer.credit_terms || '')
        .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, ch => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(ch))).trim();
    if (/^(cash|نقد|نقدي|نقداً|فوري|فوراً|عند الاستلام|upon receipt|immediate)$/i.test(text)) return 0;
    const match = /(?:net|صافي|خلال|within)\s*(\d{1,3})/i.exec(text);
    if (!match) return null;
    const days = Number(match[1]);
    return Number.isInteger(days) && days >= 0 && days <= 365 ? days : null;
}

function preferredPosPaymentTermId(customer) {
    if (!customer) return '';
    const savedId = Number(customer.payment_terms_id || customer.payment_term_id || 0);
    if (savedId > 0 && paymentTermRows.some(term => Number(term.id) === savedId)) return String(savedId);
    const days = paymentTermDaysFromCustomer(customer);
    if (days === null) return '';
    const match = paymentTermRows.find(term => Number(term.days) === days);
    return match ? String(match.id) : '';
}

function updatePosPaymentTermsPreview() {
    const select = document.getElementById('paymentTermsId');
    const preview = document.getElementById('paymentTermsDueDate');
    if (!select || !preview) return;
    const option = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
    const days = option && option.value ? Number(option.dataset.days) : NaN;
    if (!Number.isInteger(days) || days < 0 || days > 365) { preview.value = ''; return; }
    const base = String(businessDayDateTime() || '').slice(0,10);
    const parts = base.split('-').map(Number);
    if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some(value => !Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0)) { preview.value = ''; return; }
    const date = new Date(Date.UTC(parts[0],parts[1]-1,parts[2]));
    if (date.getUTCFullYear() !== parts[0] || date.getUTCMonth() !== parts[1]-1 ||
        date.getUTCDate() !== parts[2]) { preview.value = ''; return; }
    date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + days);
    preview.value = date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
}

function syncPosPaymentTermForCustomer(customer) {
    const select = document.getElementById('paymentTermsId');
    if (!select) return;
    select.value = preferredPosPaymentTermId(customer);
    updatePosPaymentTermsPreview();
}

function updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility() {
    const section = document.getElementById('paymentTermsSection');
    const row = document.getElementById('paymentTermsRow');
    const select = document.getElementById('paymentTermsId');
    const credit = document.getElementById('paymentType')?.value === 'آجل';
    // Show the terms/date row immediately for credit sales; customer selection
    // remains a separate required step in completeSale().
    if (section) section.style.display = credit ? '' : 'none';
    if (row) row.style.display = credit ? '' : 'none';
    if (select) { select.required = credit; select.disabled = !credit; }
    updatePosPaymentTermsPreview();
}

    function loadPaymentTerms() {
    return apiCall('getPaymentTerms', {applies_to:'customer'})
        .then(response => {
            const raw = response.data || response;
            paymentTermRows = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (Array.isArray(raw.rows) ? raw.rows : []);
            const select = document.getElementById('paymentTermsId');
            if (!select) return;
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر شرط الدفع...</option>';
            paymentTermRows.forEach(term => {
                const option = document.createElement('option');
                option.value = String(term.id);
                option.dataset.days = String(term.days);
                const days = Number(term.days);
                const labels = {1:'بعد يوم واحد',3:'بعد 3 أيام',7:'بعد 7 أيام',15:'بعد 15 يوماً',30:'بعد 30 يوماً',45:'بعد 45 يوماً',60:'بعد 60 يوماً',90:'بعد 90 يوماً'};
                option.textContent = labels[days] || ('بعد ' + days + ' يوماً');
                option.title = String(term.name_ar || term.code || option.textContent);
                select.appendChild(option);
            });
            syncPosPaymentTermForCustomer(selectedCreditCustomer);
            updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
        })
        .catch(error => {
            paymentTermRows = [];
            const select = document.getElementById('paymentTermsId');
            if (select) select.innerHTML = '<option value="">تعذر تحميل شروط الدفع</option>';
            showToast(error.message || 'تعذر تحميل شروط الدفع من SQLite', 'error');
        });
}

        .then(data => {

            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر نوع العميل</option>';
            const list = data.data || data.entity_types || [];

                    option.value = type.type_id;
                    option.textContent = type.type_name;
                    select.appendChild(option);
                });

}

function loadCustomersByEntityType(entityTypeId) {
    if (!entityTypeId) return;
    apiCall('getEntitiesByType', { entity_type_id: entityTypeId })
        .then(data => {
            const select = document.getElementById('customerId');
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر عميل</option>';
            const list = data.data || data.entities || [];
            if (data.success && list) {
                list.forEach(entity => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');

                    option.textContent = entity.commercial_name || entity.commercial_name_ar || entity.legal_name || '---';

                });

}

function loadCustomerDetails(customerId) {
    const id = Number(customerId || 0);
    const matchingCustomer = creditCustomers.find(customer => customerDatabaseId(customer) === id) || null;
    const details = document.getElementById('customerDetailsContainer');
    if (!matchingCustomer) {
        // Keep the selected placeholder while getCustomers is still loading; clearing it
        // here makes completeSale reject a valid customer chosen through selectCustomer().
        if (Number(selectedCreditCustomer?.id || selectedCreditCustomer?.party_id || 0) !== id) {
            selectedCreditCustomer = null;
        }
        if (details) details.style.display = 'none';
        updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
        return;
    }
    selectedCreditCustomer = matchingCustomer;
    displayCustomerDetails(selectedCreditCustomer);
    syncPosPaymentTermForCustomer(matchingCustomer);
    updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
}

function displayCustomerDetails(customer) {
    const container = document.getElementById('customerDetailsContainer');
    const grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'customer-info-grid';
    const entries = [
        ['رقم العميل', customer.entity_id || customerDatabaseId(customer)],
        ['الاسم القانوني', customer.legal_name || ''],
        ['الاسم التجاري', customer.commercial_name || ''],
        ['الحد الائتماني', `${customer.credit_limit || 0} ريال`],
        ['الرصيد الحالي', `${customer.current_balance || 0} ريال`],
        ['شروط الدفع', customer.payment_terms || ''],
        ['الحالة', customer.is_active ? 'نشط' : 'غير نشط'],
        ['الهاتف', customer.primary_phone || customer.phone || ''],
        ['البريد الإلكتروني', customer.email || ''],
        ['العنوان', [customer.address_line1, customer.address_line2, customer.city, customer.state].filter(Boolean).join(' ')]
    ];
    entries.forEach(([label, value]) => {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'customer-info-item';
        const strong = document.createElement('strong');
        strong.textContent = `${label}: `;
        const text = document.createElement('span');
        text.textContent = String(value ?? '');
        item.append(strong, text);
        grid.appendChild(item);
    });
    container.replaceChildren(grid);
    container.style.display = 'block';
}

function searchCustomers() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('customerSearchInput').value.trim();
    renderCreditCustomerResults(searchTerm);
}

function selectCreditCustomer(customer) {
    const customerId = customerDatabaseId(customer);
    if (!customerId) { showToast('معرف العميل غير صالح', 'error'); return; }
    selectedCreditCustomer = customer;
    document.getElementById('customerId').value = String(customerId);
    if (customer.party_type_id) document.getElementById('entityTypeSelect').value = String(customer.party_type_id);
    displayCustomerDetails(customer);
    syncPosPaymentTermForCustomer(customer);
    updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
    closeModal('customerSearchModal');
}

function selectCustomer(customerId, customerName = '') {
    const customer = creditCustomers.find(item => customerDatabaseId(item) === Number(customerId));
    if (customer) { selectCreditCustomer(customer); return; }
    selectedCreditCustomer = { id: Number(customerId), commercial_name: customerName, is_active: 1 };
    document.getElementById('customerId').value = String(customerId);
    closeModal('customerSearchModal');
    syncPosPaymentTermForCustomer(selectedCreditCustomer);
    updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
    loadCustomerDetails(customerId);
}

function addNewCustomer() {
    closeModal('customerSearchModal');
    window.location.href = 'screens/customers.html';
}

function saveNewCustomer() {
    const name = document.getElementById('newCustomerName').value.trim();
    const phone = document.getElementById('newCustomerPhone').value.trim();
    const email = document.getElementById('newCustomerEmail').value.trim();
    const creditLimit = document.getElementById('newCustomerCreditLimit').value || 0;
    if (!name || !phone) { showToast('يرجى إدخال الاسم والهاتف', 'error'); return; }
    showLoading(true);
    apiCall('addCustomer', { name, phone, email, credit_limit: creditLimit })
        .then(data => {
            const created = data && data.customer ? data.customer : (data && data.data && typeof data.data === 'object' ? data.data : data);
            const createdId = created && (created.id || created.party_id || created.entity_id);
            if (data && data.success && createdId) {
                const createdName = created.name || created.commercial_name || name;
                selectCustomer(createdId, createdName);
                document.getElementById('newCustomerModal').style.display = 'none';
                showToast('تم حفظ العميل بنجاح', 'success');
                loadCustomers();
                loadCustomerDetails(createdId);
            } else {
                showToast((data && (data.error || data.message)) || 'حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ العميل', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { showToast(error && (error.error || error.message) || 'حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ العميل', 'error'); })
        .finally(() => showLoading(false));
}

function openReturnOverlay() {
    openModal('returnOverlay');
    const today = new Date();
    const weekAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const formatDate = (date) => {
        const y = date.getFullYear();
        const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
    };
    document.getElementById('returnStartDate').value = formatDate(weekAgo);
    document.getElementById('returnEndDate').value = formatDate(today);
    flatpickr("#returnStartDate", { locale: "ar", dateFormat: "Y-m-d", defaultDate: formatDate(weekAgo) });
    flatpickr("#returnEndDate", { locale: "ar", dateFormat: "Y-m-d", defaultDate: formatDate(today) });
    searchReturnSales();
}

function searchReturnSales() {
    const startDate = document.getElementById('returnStartDate').value;
    const endDate = document.getElementById('returnEndDate').value;
    if (!startDate || !endDate) { showToast('يرجى اختيار نطاق التواريخ', 'error'); return; }
    if (startDate > endDate) { showToast('تاريخ البداية يجب ألا يكون بعد تاريخ النهاية', 'error'); return; }
    showLoading(true);
    apiCall('searchSales', { start_date: startDate, end_date: endDate })
        .then(data => {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('returnSalesTableBody');
            tbody.innerHTML = '';
            const list = data.data || data.sales || [];
            if (data.success && Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
                list.forEach(sale => {
                    const returnable = Number(sale.returnable_quantity ?? sale.net_quantity ?? sale.quantity ?? 0);
                    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                    tr.innerHTML = `
                        <td class="sales-report-invoice-number" data-invoice-length="${String(sale.invoice_number || '').length}">${escapePosText(sale.invoice_number)}</td>
                        <td>${escapePosText(sale.sale_date)}</td>
                        <td>${escapePosText(sale.product_name || 'منتج')}</td>
                        <td>${Number(sale.quantity || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td>${Number(sale.unit_price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td>${Number(sale.total_price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td>${returnable.toFixed(2)}</td>
                    `;
                    if (returnable <= 0.000001) tr.classList.add('disabled-row');
                    tr.addEventListener('dblclick', () => {
                        if (returnable <= 0.000001) { showToast('تم إرجاع هذه الكمية بالكامل مسبقاً', 'warning'); return; }
                        document.querySelectorAll('#returnSalesTableBody tr').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('selected-row'));
                        tr.classList.add('selected-row');
                        fillReturnForm(sale);
                        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('returnDetailProduct')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' }), 80);
                    });
                    tr.addEventListener('click', () => tr.classList.add('touch-active'));
                    tbody.appendChild(tr);
                });
                const returnTable = document.getElementById('returnSalesTable');
                const firstProductCell = tbody.querySelector('tr td:nth-child(3)');
                if (returnTable) {
                    try { returnTable.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (_) { try { returnTable.focus(); } catch (__) {} }
                }
                if (firstProductCell) setTimeout(() => firstProductCell.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' }), 60);
            } else {
                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7">لا توجد بنود مبيعات في الفترة المحددة</td></tr>';
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { showToast(error.message || 'حدث خطأ في البحث عن المبيعات', 'error'); })
        .finally(() => showLoading(false));
}

function updateReturnReasonOptions(preferredValue) {
    const type = document.getElementById('returnDetailType')?.value || 'return';
    const reason = document.getElementById('returnDetailReason');
    if (!reason) return;
    const options = type === 'damage' ? ['تالف','منتهي الصلاحية','مثقوب','فاسد','أسباب أخرى'] : ['السعر مرتفع','غير مرغوب به','خطأ في الطلب','زائد عن الحاجة','أسباب أخرى'];
    reason.replaceChildren(...options.map(value => { const option=document.createElement('option'); option.value=value; option.textContent=value; return option; }));
    reason.value = preferredValue && options.includes(preferredValue) ? preferredValue : options[0];
}

function fillReturnForm(sale) {
    selectedReturnSale = sale;
    const returnable = Number(sale.returnable_quantity ?? sale.net_quantity ?? sale.quantity ?? 0);
    document.getElementById('returnDetailInvoice').value = sale.invoice_number || '';
    document.getElementById('returnDetailProduct').value = sale.product_name || '';
    const qty = document.getElementById('returnDetailQuantity');
    qty.value = returnable > 0 ? returnable : '';
    qty.max = String(Math.max(0, returnable));
    qty.step = '0.01';
    document.getElementById('returnDetailType').value = 'return';
    updateReturnReasonOptions('السعر مرتفع');
    document.getElementById('returnDetailNotes').value = '';
}

function saveReturn() {
    const invoiceNumber = document.getElementById('returnDetailInvoice').value.trim();
    const productName = document.getElementById('returnDetailProduct').value.trim();
    const quantity = Number(document.getElementById('returnDetailQuantity').value);
    const reason = document.getElementById('returnDetailReason').value.trim();
    const notes = document.getElementById('returnDetailNotes').value.trim();
    const available = Number(selectedReturnSale?.returnable_quantity ?? selectedReturnSale?.net_quantity ?? selectedReturnSale?.quantity ?? 0);
    if (!invoiceNumber || !productName || !reason || !selectedReturnSale) {
        showToast('اختر بند مبيعات وأدخل سبب الإرجاع', 'error');
        return;
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
        showToast('كمية الإرجاع يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر', 'error');
        return;
    }
    if (quantity > available + 1e-9) {
        showToast(`الكمية المتاحة للإرجاع: ${available.toFixed(2)}`, 'error');
        return;
    }
    if (!activeReturnOperationKey) activeReturnOperationKey = newSaleOperationKey();
    const saveButton = document.querySelector('#returnOverlay .floating-buttons .btn-success');
    if (saveButton) saveButton.disabled = true;
    showLoading(true);
    apiCall('processProductSaleAdjustment', {
        invoice_number: invoiceNumber,
        sale_id: Number(selectedReturnSale.sale_id || 0),
        sale_item_id: Number(selectedReturnSale.item_id || selectedReturnSale.sale_item_id || 0),
        product_id: Number(selectedReturnSale.product_id || 0),
        barcode: String(selectedReturnSale.barcode || ''),
        quantity,
        adjustment_type: document.getElementById('returnDetailType').value,
        reason,
        notes,
        idempotency_key: activeReturnOperationKey
    })
        .then(data => {
            if (data.success) {
                showToast(data.message || 'تم حفظ المرتجع وتحديث SQLite فعلياً', 'success');
                selectedReturnSale = null;
                activeReturnOperationKey = '';
                closeModal('returnOverlay');
            } else {
                showToast(data.message || data.error || 'تعذر حفظ المرتجع', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { showToast(error.message || 'حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ المرتجع', 'error'); })
        .finally(() => {
            if (saveButton) saveButton.disabled = false;
            showLoading(false);
        });
}

function processReturn() {
    const invoiceNumber = document.getElementById('returnInvoiceNumber').value;
    const barcode = document.getElementById('returnBarcode').value;
    const quantity = document.getElementById('returnQuantity').value;
    const reason = document.getElementById('returnReason').value;
    if (!invoiceNumber || !barcode || !quantity || !reason) {
        showToast('يرجى ملء جميع الحقول المطلوبة', 'error');
        return;
    }
    showLoading(true);
    apiCall('processReturn', { invoice_number: invoiceNumber, barcode: barcode, quantity: quantity, reason: reason })
        .then(data => {
            if (data.success) {
                showToast('تم معالجة الإرجاع بنجاح', 'success');
                closeModal('returnModal');
            } else {
                showToast(data.message || 'حدث خطأ أثناء معالجة الإرجاع', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { showToast('حدث خطأ أثناء معالجة الإرجاع', 'error'); })
        .finally(() => showLoading(false));
}

function searchInvoices() {
