function loadInvoice(invoiceNumber) {
    showLoading(true);
    apiCall('retrieveInvoice', { invoice_number: invoiceNumber })
        .then(data => {
            if (data.success) {
                loadInvoiceData(data.data || data);
                closeModal('invoiceRetrieveModal');
                showToast('تم تحميل الفاتورة بنجاح', 'success');
            } else {
                showToast(data.message || 'حدث خطأ في تحميل الفاتورة', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { showToast('حدث خطأ في تحميل الفاتورة', 'error'); })
        .finally(() => showLoading(false));
}

function loadInvoiceData(data) {
    document.getElementById('invoiceNumber').value = data.invoice_number;
    document.getElementById('paymentType').value = data.payment_type;
    if (data.payment_type === 'آجل' && data.entity_id) {
        document.getElementById('customerInfoRow').style.display = 'block';
    }
    const tbody = document.getElementById('productsTableBody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    data.items.forEach((item, index) => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        row.setAttribute('data-product-id', item.product_id);
        row.setAttribute('data-barcode', item.barcode);
        row.setAttribute('data-description', item.description || '');
        row.innerHTML = `
            <td><input type="number" class="form-control quantity-input" value="${item.quantity}" min="1" dir="ltr" inputmode="numeric"></td>
            <td class="product-name-large">${item.name}</td>
            <td>${Number(item.unit_price).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>${Number(item.total_price).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary product-details-btn" title="تفاصيل المنتج" type="button"><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i></button>
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger remove-product-btn" title="حذف" type="button"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
            </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
        const qtyInput = row.querySelector('.quantity-input');
        qtyInput.addEventListener('change', () => updateProductQuantity(row));
        row.querySelector('.remove-product-btn').addEventListener('click', () => removeProduct(row));
        row.querySelector('.product-details-btn').addEventListener('click', () => showProductDetails({
            product_name: item.name,
            expiry_date: item.expiry_date,
            min_stock_level: item.min_stock_level,
            description: item.description || ''
        }, row));
        const productNameCell = row.querySelector('.product-name-large');
        productNameCell.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
            showDoubleClickActions(e, row, {
                product_name: item.name,
                description: item.description || '',
                expiry_date: item.expiry_date,
                min_stock_level: item.min_stock_level
            });
        });
    });
    updateInvoiceSummary();
}

function toggleSalesReport() {
    const reportModal = document.getElementById('salesReportModal');
    if (reportModal.style.display === 'flex') {
        closeModal('salesReportModal');
        return;
    }
    openModal('salesReportModal');
    const today = new Date();
    const weekAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const formatDate = date => `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    const start = document.getElementById('salesReportStartDate');
    const end = document.getElementById('salesReportEndDate');
    if (!start.value) start.value = formatDate(weekAgo);
    if (!end.value) end.value = formatDate(today);
    fetchSalesReport();
}

function printSalesReport() {
    const body = document.getElementById('salesReportTableBody');
    if (!body || !body.children.length) { showToast('لا توجد بيانات تقرير للطباعة', 'warning'); return; }
    document.body.classList.add('sales-report-print-mode');
    setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
            const response = await apiCall('printSalesReport');
            if (!response.success) throw new Error(response.message || response.error || 'فشل فتح نافذة الطباعة');
            showToast(response.message || 'تم إرسال تقرير المبيعات إلى الطباعة', 'success');
        } catch (error) { showToast(error.message || 'تعذر طباعة تقرير المبيعات', 'error'); }
        finally { setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove('sales-report-print-mode'), 1500); }
    },100);
}

function fetchSalesReport() {
    const startDate = document.getElementById('salesReportStartDate').value;
    const endDate = document.getElementById('salesReportEndDate').value;
    if (!startDate || !endDate) { showToast('يرجى اختيار نطاق التواريخ', 'error'); return; }
    if (startDate > endDate) { showToast('تاريخ البداية يجب ألا يكون بعد تاريخ النهاية', 'error'); return; }
    showLoading(true);
    apiCall('searchSales', { start_date: startDate, end_date: endDate })
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById('salesReportTableBody');
            tableBody.innerHTML = '';
            const list = data.data || data.sales || [];
            if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'فشل جلب تقرير المبيعات');
            if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
                list.forEach(sale => {
                    const sold = Number(sale.quantity || 0);
                    const returned = Number(sale.returned_quantity || 0);
                    const netQty = Number(sale.net_quantity ?? Math.max(0, sold - returned));
                    const netTotal = Number(sale.net_total ?? (Number(sale.total_price || 0) * (sold > 0 ? netQty / sold : 0)));
                    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                    tr.innerHTML = `
                        <td>${escapePosText(sale.invoice_number)}</td>
                        <td>${escapePosText(sale.sale_date)}</td>
                        <td>${escapePosText(sale.product_name || 'منتج')}</td>
                        <td>${sold.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td>${returned.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td>${netTotal.toFixed(2)}</td>
                    `;
                    tableBody.appendChild(tr);
                });
            } else {
                tableBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6">لا توجد مبيعات في الفترة المحددة</td></tr>';
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { showToast(error.message || 'حدث خطأ في جلب تقرير المبيعات', 'error'); })
        .finally(() => showLoading(false));
}

function openSidebar() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    if (sidebar) {
        sidebar.classList.add('open');
        document.body.classList.add('sidebar-is-open');
        const toggle = document.getElementById('sidebarToggle');
        if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    }
}

function closeSidebar() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    if (sidebar) {
        sidebar.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.classList.remove('sidebar-is-open');
        const toggle = document.getElementById('sidebarToggle');
        if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
}

function toggleSidebar() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    if (!sidebar) return;
    if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) closeSidebar();
    else openSidebar();
}

function handleButtonClick(action) {
    closeSidebar();
    closeAllModals();

    switch(action) {
        case 'newSale':
            resetForm();
            showToast('تم بدء عملية بيع جديدة', 'success');
            setTimeout(() => { focusPosField('paymentType', true); }, 350);
            break;
        case 'return':
            setTimeout(() => { openReturnOverlay(); }, 240);
            break;
        case 'invoiceRetrieveModal':
            setTimeout(() => { retrieveInvoice(); }, 240);
            break;
        case 'salesReport':
            setTimeout(() => { toggleSalesReport(); }, 240);
            break;
        case 'back':
            window.location.href = '../main.html';
            break;
        default:
            showToast('إجراء غير معروف', 'error');
    }
}

function setupSidebar() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const sidebarToggle = document.getElementById('sidebarToggle');
    if (!sidebar || !sidebarToggle) { console.error('Sidebar elements not found'); return; }

    sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        toggleSidebar();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (sidebar.classList.contains('open') &&
            !sidebar.contains(e.target) &&
            !sidebarToggle.contains(e.target)) {
            closeSidebar();
        }
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
        if (!sidebar.classList.contains('open')) return;
        const t = e.target;
        if (sidebar.contains(t)) return;
        if (sidebarToggle.contains(t)) return;
        closeSidebar();
    }, { passive: true });

    let touchStartX = 0, touchEndX = 0, touchStartY = 0;
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
        touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
        touchStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
    }, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
        touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
        const touchEndY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
        const dy = Math.abs(touchEndY - touchStartY);
        if (dy > 80) return;
        if (touchEndX < touchStartX - 60) closeSidebar();
        if (touchEndX > touchStartX + 60 && touchStartX < 40) openSidebar();
    }, { passive: true });
}

function loadDeferredEntityTypes() {
    apiCall('getEntityTypes', {})
        .then(data => {
            const select = document.getElementById('deferredEntityTypeSelect');
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر نوع العميل</option>';
            const list = data.data || data.entity_types || [];
            if (data.success && list) {
                list.forEach(type => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = type.type_id;
                    option.textContent = type.type_name;
                    select.appendChild(option);
                });
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { console.error('Error loading entity types for deferred:', error); });

    document.getElementById('deferredEntityTypeSelect').addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (this.value) loadCustomersByEntityTypeDeferred(this.value);
    });
    document.getElementById('deferredCustomerId').addEventListener('change', function() {
        loadCustomerDetailsDeferred(this.value);
    });
}

function loadCustomersByEntityTypeDeferred(entityTypeId) {
    apiCall('getEntitiesByType', { entity_type_id: entityTypeId })
        .then(data => {
            const select = document.getElementById('deferredCustomerId');
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر عميل</option>';
            const list = data.data || data.entities || [];
            if (data.success && list) {
                list.forEach(entity => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = entity.entity_id;
                    option.textContent = entity.commercial_name || entity.legal_name;
                    select.appendChild(option);
                });
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { console.error('Error:', error); });
}

function loadCustomerDetailsDeferred(customerId) {
    if (!customerId) return;
    apiCall('getEntityDetails', { entity_id: customerId })
        .then(data => {
            if (data.success) {
                displayDeferredCustomerDetails(data.entity);
            }
        })
        .catch(error => { console.error('Error:', error); });
}

function displayDeferredCustomerDetails(customer) {
    const container = document.getElementById('deferredCustomerDetailsContainer');
    container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="customer-info-grid">
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>رقم العميل:</strong> ${customer.entity_id}</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>الاسم القانوني:</strong> ${customer.legal_name || ''}</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>الاسم التجاري:</strong> ${customer.commercial_name || ''}</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>الحد الائتماني:</strong> ${customer.credit_limit || 0} ريال</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>الرصيد الحالي:</strong> ${customer.current_balance || 0} ريال</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>شروط الدفع:</strong> ${customer.payment_terms || ''}</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>الحالة:</strong> ${customer.is_active ? 'نشط' : 'غير نشط'}</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>الهاتف:</strong> ${customer.primary_phone || ''}</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>البريد الإلكتروني:</strong> ${customer.email || ''}</div>
            <div class="customer-info-item"><strong>العنوان:</strong> ${customer.address_line1 || ''} ${customer.address_line2 || ''} ${customer.city || ''} ${customer.state || ''}</div>
        </div>
    `;
    container.style.display = 'block';
}

function confirmDeferredCustomer() {
    const entityTypeId = document.getElementById('deferredEntityTypeSelect').value;
    const customerId = document.getElementById('deferredCustomerId').value;
    if (!entityTypeId || !customerId) {
        showToast('يرجى اختيار نوع واسم العميل', 'error');
        return;
    }
    document.getElementById('entityTypeSelect').value = entityTypeId;
    document.getElementById('customerId').value = customerId;
    document.getElementById('customerInfoRow').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('customerNameField').style.display = 'block';
    loadCustomerDetails(customerId);
    closeModal('deferredPaymentModal');
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    loadThemeSettings();

    document.getElementById('homeButton').addEventListener('click', function () { window.location.href = '../main.html'; });
    loadCurrentStationLogo();

    if (!document.getElementById('successCheckmark')) {
        const checkEl = document.createElement('div');
        checkEl.id = 'successCheckmark';
        checkEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>';
        document.body.appendChild(checkEl);
    }

    document.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t && (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'SELECT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) {
            setTimeout(() => { try { t.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (_) {} }, 50);
        }
    }, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t && (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'SELECT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) {
            setTimeout(() => { try { t.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (_) {} }, 0);
        }
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.pos-action-btn').forEach(btn => {
        let touchTimer = null;
        btn.addEventListener('touchstart', function () {
            btn.classList.add('touch-show');
            if (touchTimer) clearTimeout(touchTimer);
            touchTimer = setTimeout(() => { btn.classList.remove('touch-show'); }, 1600);
        }, { passive: true });
        btn.addEventListener('touchend', function () {
            if (touchTimer) clearTimeout(touchTimer);
            touchTimer = setTimeout(() => { btn.classList.remove('touch-show'); }, 1200);
        }, { passive: true });
        btn.addEventListener('touchcancel', function () {
            btn.classList.remove('touch-show');
            if (touchTimer) clearTimeout(touchTimer);
        });
    });

    document.getElementById('paymentType').addEventListener('change', function() {
        const customerRow = document.getElementById('customerInfoRow');
        if (this.value === 'آجل') {
            customerRow.style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('customerNameField').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('entityTypeField').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('amountPaid').value = '0.00';
            document.getElementById('amountPaid').readOnly = true;
            updateRemainingAmount();
            try { this.blur(); } catch (_) {}
            if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur) {
                try { document.activeElement.blur(); } catch (_) {}
            }
            setTimeout(() => { openCreditCustomerModal(); }, 280);
        } else {
            customerRow.style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('customerId').value = '';
            document.getElementById('entityTypeSelect').value = '';
            document.getElementById('customerDetailsContainer').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('entityTypeField').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('amountPaid').readOnly = false;
            selectedCreditCustomer = null;
            closeModal('customerSearchModal');
            const termsSelect = document.getElementById('paymentTermsId');
            if (termsSelect) termsSelect.value = '';
        }
        updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
    });
    document.getElementById('entityTypeSelect').addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (this.value) loadCustomersByEntityType(this.value);
        else document.getElementById('customerNameField').style.display = 'none';
    });
    document.getElementById('customerId').addEventListener('change', function() {
        const selected = creditCustomers.find(customer =>
            customerDatabaseId(customer) === Number(this.value || 0)
        ) || null;
        selectedCreditCustomer = selected;
        loadCustomerDetails(this.value);
        if (selected) syncPosPaymentTermForCustomer(selected);
        else if (document.getElementById('paymentTermsId')) document.getElementById('paymentTermsId').value = '';
        updatePosPaymentTermsVisibility();
        loadActivePromotions();
        document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr').forEach(row => resolveProductRowPrice(row));
    });
    document.getElementById('paymentTermsId').addEventListener('change', updatePosPaymentTermsPreview);
    document.getElementById('occasionCode').addEventListener('change', function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr').forEach(row => resolveProductRowPrice(row));
    });
    ['subtotal','discountAmount','taxAmount','serviceFee'].forEach(id => {
        const field = document.getElementById(id);
        if (field) field.addEventListener('input', recalculateInvoiceFromManualFields);
    });
    document.getElementById('totalAmount').addEventListener('input', updateRemainingAmount);
    document.getElementById('remainingAmount').addEventListener('input', function() {
        const total = getInvoiceNumberValue('totalAmount', 0);
        const remaining = getInvoiceNumberValue('remainingAmount', 0);
        document.getElementById('amountPaid').value = Math.max(0, total - remaining).toFixed(2);
        updateRemainingAmount();
    });
    document.getElementById('returnDetailType').addEventListener('change', () => updateReturnReasonOptions());
    updateReturnReasonOptions();
    document.getElementById('amountPaid').addEventListener('input', updateRemainingAmount);
    document.getElementById('amountPaid').addEventListener('dblclick', function() {
        this.value = document.getElementById('totalAmount').value;
        updateRemainingAmount();
    });
    document.getElementById('amountPaid').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') completeSale();
    });
    document.getElementById('completeSaleBtn').addEventListener('click', completeSale);
    document.getElementById('addManualBarcodeBtn').addEventListener('click', addProductManually);
    document.getElementById('manualBarcodeInput').addEventListener('click', openManualProductPicker);
    document.getElementById('manualProductSearch').addEventListener('input', function() { renderManualProductPicker(this.value); });
    document.getElementById('stopScanBtn').addEventListener('click', stopScanner);
    document.getElementById('toggleFlashBtn').addEventListener('click', toggleFlash);
    document.getElementById('toggleScanBtn').addEventListener('click', toggleScanner);
    document.getElementById('saveNewCustomerBtn').addEventListener('click', saveNewCustomer);
    document.getElementById('printReceiptBtn').addEventListener('click', printReceipt);
    document.getElementById('whatsappInvoiceBtn').addEventListener('click', openWhatsappShare);
    document.getElementById('deliverPurchaseBtn').addEventListener('click', deliverLastPurchase);
    document.getElementById('openCreditCustomerModalBtn').addEventListener('click', openCreditCustomerModal);
    document.getElementById('customerSearchInput').addEventListener('input', function() { renderCreditCustomerResults(this.value); });
    loadActivePromotions();
    document.getElementById('addCustomerBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        closeModal('customerSearchModal');
        window.location.href = 'screens/customers.html';
    });
    document.getElementById('clearCustomerBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
        document.getElementById('customerId').value = '';
        document.getElementById('entityTypeSelect').value = '';
        document.getElementById('customerDetailsContainer').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('customerNameField').style.display = 'none';
    });

    const waSendBtn = document.getElementById('waSendBtn');
    if (waSendBtn) waSendBtn.addEventListener('click', sendWhatsappInvoice);

    const waPreviewCard = document.getElementById('waInvoicePreviewCard');
    if (waPreviewCard) {
        waPreviewCard.addEventListener('click', openWhatsappInvoiceFullscreen);
    }

    const waPhoneInput = document.getElementById('waPhoneInput');
    if (waPhoneInput) {
        waPhoneInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            const start = this.selectionStart;
            this.value = toLatinDigits(this.value).replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
            try { this.setSelectionRange(start, start); } catch (_) {}
        });
        waPhoneInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); sendWhatsappInvoice(); }
        });
    }

    setupSidebar();
    loadDeferredEntityTypes();

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
        const fullscreen = document.getElementById('waInvoiceFullscreen');
        if (fullscreen && fullscreen.classList.contains('show')) {
            closeWhatsappInvoiceFullscreen();
            return;
        }
        const waModal = document.getElementById('whatsappShareModal');
        if (waModal && waModal.classList.contains('show')) {
            closeWhatsappShare();
            return;
        }
        closeAllModals({ restoreFocus: true });
    });

    scannerActive = false;
    scannerButtonState(false);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
        if (document.hidden) stopScanner();
    });
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', function () { stopScanner(); });

    forceHideLoading();
});

        {label:'وقت البيع', key:'sale_time', type:'time', required:true, readonly:true},
        {label:'رسوم خدمة التوصيل واحتسابها', key:'delivery_fee_configuration', type:'delivery_fee_configuration', required:false, full:true},
        {label:'الإجمالي بعد رسوم التوصيل (للعرض)', key:'delivery_fee_display_total', type:'number', required:false, readonly:true, full:true, value:'0'},
        {label:'موقع التوصيل', key:'delivery_location', type:'text', required:false, full:true},
        {label:'اسم العميل النقدي', key:'cash_customer_name', type:'text', required:false, full:true},
        {label:'رمز العرض / المناسبة (اختياري)', key:'occasion_code', type:'select', required:false, full:true},
        {label:'ملاحظات', key:'notes', type:'textarea', required:false}
    ],
    valueFields:['total_amount'],
    titleFields:['sale_id'],
    subtitleFields:['shift_id','pump_id','fuel_type_id','quantity','price_per_liter','total_amount','payment_method'],
    createMethod:'saveFuelSaleRecord',
    updateMethod:'updateFuelSaleRecord',
    deleteMethod:'deleteFuelSaleRecord',
    reportKind:'operational:FuelSale',
    reports:['الكل','مبيعات كاش','مبيعات آجل'],
    operationKey:null
};

const FIELD_LABELS = {
    sale_id:'رقم البيع', id:'المعرف', shift_id:'الوردية', pump_id:'المضخة',
    nozzle_id:'الفوهة', fuel_type_id:'نوع الوقود', fuel_id:'نوع الوقود',
    fuel_name:'نوع الوقود', fuel_name_ar:'نوع الوقود', quantity:'الكمية (لتر)',
    liters:'الكمية (لتر)', price_per_liter:'سعر اللتر', unit_price:'سعر الوحدة',
    total_amount:'الإجمالي', total_price:'الإجمالي', net_amount:'الصافي',
    payment_method:'طريقة الدفع', payment_type:'طريقة الدفع',
    customer_id:'معرف العميل', customer_name:'اسم العميل',
    customer_party_id:'معرف العميل', sale_date:'تاريخ البيع',
    sale_time:'وقت البيع', business_day:'يوم العمل', occasion_code:'رمز العرض',
    notes:'ملاحظات', status:'الحالة', is_active:'نشط', is_deleted:'محذوف',
    created_at:'تاريخ الإنشاء', updated_at:'تاريخ التحديث',
    original_quantity:'الكمية الأصلية', returned_quantity:'المرتجع',
    damaged_quantity:'التالف', returnable_quantity:'المتاح للإرجاع',
    shift_name:'اسم الوردية', pump_name:'اسم المضخة', pump_name_ar:'اسم المضخة',
    nozzle_number:'رقم الفوهة', cashier_name:'أمين الصندوق',
    user_name:'المستخدم', username:'المستخدم', station_id:'المحطة',
    branch_id:'الفرع', sms_status:'حالة الرسالة', delivery_status:'حالة التوصيل'
};

const VALUE_TRANSLATIONS = {
    cash:'نقدي', cash_payment:'نقدي', 'نقداً':'نقدي', 'نقدي':'نقدي',
    credit:'آجل', credit_sale:'آجل', credit_account:'آجل', 'آجل':'آجل',
    credit_card:'بطاقة', card:'بطاقة', bank_transfer:'تحويل بنكي',
    transfer:'تحويل بنكي', cheque:'شيك', check:'شيك',
    mobile_money:'محفظة إلكترونية', wallet:'محفظة إلكترونية',
    active:'نشط', inactive:'غير نشط', pending:'قيد المعالجة',
    processing:'قيد المعالجة', completed:'مكتمل', done:'مكتمل',
    cancelled:'ملغى', canceled:'ملغى', failed:'فاشل', rejected:'مرفوض',
    returned:'مرتجع', damaged:'تالف', 'true':'نعم', 'false':'لا',
    '1':'نعم', '0':'لا'
};

function translateFieldLabel(key) {
    if (!key) return '';
    return FIELD_LABELS[key] || FIELD_LABELS[String(key).toLowerCase()] || String(key);
}

function translateFieldValue(key, value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '—';
    const k = String(key || '').toLowerCase();
    const v = String(value).trim();
    const vLower = v.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'payment_method' || k === 'payment_type') return VALUE_TRANSLATIONS[vLower] || v;
    if (k === 'status' || k === 'delivery_status' || k === 'sms_status') return VALUE_TRANSLATIONS[vLower] || v;
    if (k === 'is_active' || k === 'is_deleted') {
        const n = Number(value);
        const isOne = n === 1 || vLower === 'true' || v === '1' || v === 'نعم';
        if (k === 'is_deleted') return isOne ? 'نعم' : 'لا';
        return isOne ? 'نشط' : 'غير نشط';
    }
    if (k === 'quantity' || k === 'liters' || k === 'price_per_liter' ||
        k === 'unit_price' || k === 'total_amount' || k === 'total_price' ||
        k === 'net_amount' || k === 'original_quantity' ||
        k === 'returned_quantity' || k === 'damaged_quantity' ||
        k === 'returnable_quantity') {
        const n = Number(value);
        if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n.toFixed(2);
    }
    if (vLower === 'true') return 'نعم';
    if (vLower === 'false') return 'لا';
    return v;
}

const bridge = window.AndroidInterface;
const state = {
    rows: [],
    filtered: [],
    editing: null,
    filter: 'all',
    loadedAt: null,
    pendingIdempotencyKey: null,
    lastSuccessfulSaleFingerprint: null,
    priceLookupSeq: 0,
    formOpenSequence: 0,
    pumpNozzleRequestSequence: 0,
    formOpenStartedAt: 0,
    isSaving: false,

const fuelSalesAsyncBridge = window.FuelSalesAsyncBridge &&
    typeof window.FuelSalesAsyncBridge.create === 'function'
    ? window.FuelSalesAsyncBridge.create(bridge, {timeoutMs: 30000})
    : null;

window.__fuelSalesNativeResult = function(requestId, rawResponse) {
    if (fuelSalesAsyncBridge) fuelSalesAsyncBridge.resolve(requestId, rawResponse);
};

function invokeFuelSalesAsync(operation, args=[], timeoutMs) {
    if (!fuelSalesAsyncBridge) return Promise.reject(new Error('مساعد Android غير المتزامن لمبيعات الوقود غير محمّل'));
    return fuelSalesAsyncBridge.invoke(operation, args, timeoutMs);
}

function fuelSalePerformanceNow() {
    return window.performance && typeof window.performance.now === 'function' ? window.performance.now() : Date.now();
}

function recordFuelSalePerformance(label, startedAt) {
    const elapsed = Math.max(0, fuelSalePerformanceNow() - Number(startedAt || 0));
    if (window.console && typeof window.console.info === 'function') {
        window.console.info('[FuelSalesPerformance] ' + label + ': ' + elapsed.toFixed(1) + 'ms');
    }
    return elapsed;
}

function parseOptionalBridgeResult(raw) {
    try { return parse(raw); } catch (_) { return null; }
}

window.addEventListener('pagehide', function() {
    if (fuelSalesAsyncBridge) fuelSalesAsyncBridge.rejectAll('تم مغادرة شاشة مبيعات الوقود');
});

try {
    const savedView = localStorage.getItem('fuel-sales-view');
    if (savedView === 'cards' || savedView === 'tree' || savedView === 'table') {
        state.viewMode = savedView;
    }
} catch (_) {}

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
function newIdempotencyKey(){
    if (window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
        return window.crypto.randomUUID();
    }
    return 'fuel-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,12);
}

const esc = (value) => String(value == null ? '—' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const today = () => {
    if (typeof businessDayDate === 'function') {
        try { return businessDayDate(); } catch(_) {}
    }
    const d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
};

/* ============================================================
   Dynamic Top Bar Height Calculation
   يمنع حجب البطاقات الإحصائية مهما تغير ارتفاع الشريط العلوي
   ============================================================ */
function updateTopBarHeight() {
    const topBar = $('topBar');
    if (!topBar) return;
    if (document.body.classList.contains('modal-open')) return;
    const height = topBar.offsetHeight;
    if (height > 0) {
        document.body.style.paddingTop = (height + 5) + 'px';
    }
}

window.addEventListener('resize', updateTopBarHeight);
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    updateTopBarHeight();
    setTimeout(updateTopBarHeight, 100);
    setTimeout(updateTopBarHeight, 500);
});

/* ============================================================
   Toast
   ============================================================ */
function toast(message, bad=false, context='auto') {
    let node;
    if (context === 'form') node = $('formToast');
    else if (context === 'global') node = $('toast');
    else node = ($('formModal') && $('formModal').classList.contains('show')) ? $('formToast') : $('toast');
    if (!node) node = $('toast');
    if (!node) return;
    const isFormFeedback = node.id === 'formToast';
    node.textContent = message;
    node.className = 'toast' + (isFormFeedback ? ' form-toast' : '') + ' show ' + (bad ? 'error' : 'success');
    clearTimeout(node._timer);
    if (!isFormFeedback) node._timer = setTimeout(() => node.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
}
function clearFormToast() {
    const node = $('formToast');
    if (!node) return;
    clearTimeout(node._timer);
    node.textContent = '';
    node.className = 'toast form-toast';
}

function showFormToast(message, type='success') {
    const node = $('formToast');
    if (!node) {
        toast(message, type === 'error', 'global');
        return;
    }
    clearTimeout(node._timer);
    node.textContent = String(message || '');
    const tone = ['success','error','warning','info'].includes(type) ? type : 'success';
    node.className = 'toast form-toast show ' + tone;
    node.setAttribute('aria-live', type === 'error' ? 'assertive' : 'polite');
    const body = node.closest('.modal-body');
    if (body) body.scrollTop = 0;
}

let _advTimeout = null;
function showAdvancedNotification(message, type='success', title) {
    const el = $('advancedNotification');
    if (!el) return;
    const iconEl = $('advancedNotificationIcon');
    const titleEl = $('advancedNotificationTitle');
    const msgEl = $('advancedNotificationMessage');
    const normalized = (type === 'error' || type === 'fail' || type === 'danger') ? 'error'
        : (type === 'warning' || type === 'warn') ? 'warning' : 'success';
    const config = {
        success: { icon: 'fa-check', title: title || 'عملية ناجحة', duration: 3200 },
        error: { icon: 'fa-exclamation-triangle', title: title || 'فشلت العملية', duration: 4200 },
        warning: { icon: 'fa-exclamation-circle', title: title || 'تنبيه', duration: 3800 }
    }[normalized];
    el.classList.remove('show', 'success', 'error', 'warning');
    void el.offsetWidth;
    el.classList.add(normalized);
    if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + config.icon + '"></i>';
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = config.title;
    if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = message || '';
    requestAnimationFrame(() => el.classList.add('show'));
    clearTimeout(_advTimeout);
    _advTimeout = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), config.duration);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const closeBtn = $('advancedNotificationClose');
    if (closeBtn) {
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const el = $('advancedNotification');
            if (el) el.classList.remove('show');
            clearTimeout(_advTimeout);
        });
    }
});

/* ============================================================
   Utilities
   ============================================================ */
function setLoading(v) { $('loadingIndicator').classList.toggle('show', Boolean(v)); }

function parse(raw) {
    if (raw == null) throw new Error('لم يرجع الجسر نتيجة');
    const value = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    if (value && value.success === false) throw new Error(value.error || value.message || 'فشلت العملية');
    return value;
}

function dataOf(value) {
    return value && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, 'data') ? value.data : value;
}

function invoke(method, args=[]) {
    if (!bridge || typeof bridge[method] !== 'function') {
        return Promise.reject(new Error('العقد ' + method + ' غير متاح في Android Bridge'));
    }
    try { return Promise.resolve(parse(bridge[method](...args))); }
    catch (error) { return Promise.reject(error); }
}

function argsForLoad() {
    if (CFG.listMethod === 'getFuelSalesPage') {
        const params = {limit: 100, offset: 0, search: $('searchInput').value || ''};
        if (state.filter === 'cash' || state.filter === 'credit') params.payment_method = state.filter;
        return [JSON.stringify(params)];
    }
    return CFG.listArgs || [];
}

function rowsFrom(value) {
    const raw = dataOf(value);
    if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw;
    if (raw && Array.isArray(raw.rows)) return raw.rows;
    if (raw && Array.isArray(raw.data)) return raw.data;
    if (raw && typeof raw === 'object') return [raw];
    return [];
}

function field(row, names) {
    for (const name of (names||[])) {
        if (row && row[name] !== undefined && row[name] !== null && row[name] !== '') return row[name];
    }
    return '';
}
function titleOf(row) { return field(row, CFG.titleFields) || field(row,['name','title','label','id','key']) || 'سجل'; }
function subtitleOf(row) {
    return (CFG.subtitleFields||[]).map(k => {
        const v = row && row[k];
        return v===undefined||v===null||v==='' ? null : k+': '+v;
    }).filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
}
function idOf(row) { return field(row,['id','_id','sale_id','shift_id','pump_id','fuel_sale_id','vehicle_id','tank_id','payment_id','request_id','asset_id','employee_id']); }
function numeric(v) { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; }
function setDateDefaults() {
    if ($('reportFrom') && !$('reportFrom').value) $('reportFrom').value = today();
    if ($('reportTo') && !$('reportTo').value) $('reportTo').value = today();
}

/* ============================================================
   View switcher
   ============================================================ */
function setupViewSwitcher() {
    const container = $('viewSwitcher');
    if (!container) return;
    const buttons = container.querySelectorAll('.view-btn');
    buttons.forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.view === state.viewMode);
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const view = btn.dataset.view;
            if (!view || view === state.viewMode) return;
            state.viewMode = view;
            buttons.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.view === view));
            try { localStorage.setItem('fuel-sales-view', view); } catch (_) {}
            renderCards();
        });
    });
}

function renderFilters() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#filterChips .filter-chip').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('#filterChips .filter-chip').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        state.filter = btn.dataset.filter;
        reloadData();
    }));
}

function paymentType(row) {
    const v = String(field(row,['payment_method','payment_type','paymentMethod','is_credit'])||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (['credit','credit_sale','credit_account','آجل','اجل','1','true'].includes(v)) return 'credit';
    return 'cash';
}

function applyFilter() {
    const q = ($('searchInput').value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    state.filtered = state.rows.filter(row => {
        const text = JSON.stringify(row||{}).toLowerCase();
        const matchesSearch = !q || text.includes(q);
        const matchesPayment = state.filter==='all' || paymentType(row)===state.filter;
        return matchesSearch && matchesPayment;
    });
    renderCards();
}

/* ============================================================
   Stats
   ============================================================ */
function renderStats() {
    const rows = state.filtered;
    $('statCount').textContent = rows.length.toLocaleString('ar');
    $('itemCount').textContent = rows.length.toLocaleString('ar');
    const active = rows.filter(row => ['active','open','pending','completed','مفتوحة','نشط','قيد التنفيذ']
        .includes(String(field(row,['status','state','is_active'])))).length;
    $('statActive').textContent = active.toLocaleString('ar');
    let total = 0;
    (CFG.valueFields||[]).forEach(k => total += rows.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+numeric(row&&row[k]),0));
    $('statTotal').textContent = total ? total.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) : '—';
    $('statUpdated').textContent = state.loadedAt
        ? state.loadedAt.toLocaleTimeString('ar',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) : '—';
}

/* ============================================================
   Render cards
   ============================================================ */
function renderCards() {
    renderStats();
    const box = $('cardsContainer');
    if (!box) return;
    if (!state.filtered.length) {
        box.className = 'cards-container';
        box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><i class="fas fa-inbox"></i><p>لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.</p></div>';
        return;
    }
    if (state.viewMode === 'table') {
        box.className = 'cards-container view-table';
        box.innerHTML = renderTableHtml();
    } else if (state.viewMode === 'tree') {
        box.className = 'cards-container view-tree';
        box.innerHTML = renderTreeHtml();
    } else {
        box.className = 'cards-container view-cards';
        box.innerHTML = renderCardsHtml();
    }
    bindRowEvents(box);
}

function renderCardsHtml() {
    return state.filtered.map((row,index) => {
        const id = esc(idOf(row)||index);
        const fields = (CFG.subtitleFields||[]).filter(k => row && row[k]!==undefined && row[k]!==null && row[k]!=='');
        const value = (CFG.valueFields||[]).map(k=>numeric(row&&row[k])).filter(v=>v!==0).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
        const buttons = '<div class="action-row">'
            + '<button class="btn" type="button" data-view="' + id + '"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i> عرض</button>'
            + (CFG.updateMethod ? '<button class="btn warning" type="button" data-edit="' + id + '"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i> تعديل</button>' : '')
            + (CFG.deleteMethod ? '<button class="btn danger" type="button" data-delete="' + id + '"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i> حذف</button>' : '')
            + (row.sale_id ? '<button class="btn warning" type="button" data-adjust="' + id + '"><i class="fas fa-rotate-left"></i> مرتجع/تالف</button>' : '')
            + '</div>';
        const subtitleHtml = fields.map(k => esc(translateFieldLabel(k)) + ': <strong>' + esc(translateFieldValue(k, row[k])) + '</strong>').join(' · ');
        return '<article class="data-card">'
            + '<div class="data-card-head">'
            + '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">'
            + '<div class="data-card-title">' + esc(titleOf(row)) + '</div>'
            + '<div class="data-card-subtitle">' + subtitleHtml + '</div>'
            + '</div>'
            + (value ? '<div class="data-card-value">' + value.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</div>' : '')
            + '</div>'
            + '<div class="data-fields">' + fields.map(k => '<div class="data-field"><span>' + esc(translateFieldLabel(k)) + '</span><strong>' + esc(translateFieldValue(k, row[k])) + '</strong></div>').join('') + '</div>'
            + buttons
            + '</article>';
    }).join('');
}

function renderTableHtml() {
    const columns = [
        {key:'sale_id', label:'رقم البيع'},
        {key:'sale_date', label:'التاريخ'},
        {key:'sale_time', label:'الوقت'},
        {key:'fuel_type_id', label:'نوع الوقود'},
        {key:'quantity', label:'الكمية (لتر)'},
        {key:'price_per_liter', label:'سعر اللتر'},
        {key:'total_amount', label:'الإجمالي'},
        {key:'payment_method', label:'الدفع'}
    ];
    const headerHtml = columns.map(c => '<th>' + esc(c.label) + '</th>').join('') + '<th>إجراءات</th>';
    const bodyHtml = state.filtered.map((row,index) => {
        const id = esc(idOf(row)||index);
        const cells = columns.map(c => {
            const v = row[c.key];
            if (c.key === 'payment_method') {
                const kind = paymentType(row);
                const label = translateFieldValue(c.key, v);
                return '<td><span style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:700;'
                    + (kind==='credit' ? 'background:rgba(217,119,6,0.15);color:var(--warning-token);' : 'background:rgba(5,150,105,0.15);color:var(--success-token);')
                    + '">' + esc(label) + '</span></td>';
            }
            return '<td>' + esc(translateFieldValue(c.key, v)) + '</td>';
        }).join('');
        const actions = '<td><div style="display:flex;gap:3px;justify-content:center;">'
            + '<button class="btn" style="padding:4px 7px;font-size:0.7rem;" type="button" data-view="' + id + '"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i></button>'
            + (row.sale_id ? '<button class="btn warning" style="padding:4px 7px;font-size:0.7rem;" type="button" data-adjust="' + id + '"><i class="fas fa-rotate-left"></i></button>' : '')
            + (CFG.deleteMethod ? '<button class="btn danger" style="padding:4px 7px;font-size:0.7rem;" type="button" data-delete="' + id + '"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>' : '')
            + '</div></td>';
        return '<tr>' + cells + actions + '</tr>';
    }).join('');
    return '<div style="width:100%;overflow-x:auto;border-radius:10px;border:var(--silver-border);background:var(--bg-secondary);box-shadow:var(--silver-shadow);">'
        + '<table style="width:100%;min-width:760px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:0.78rem;">'
        + '<thead><tr style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold-primary),var(--gold-dark));color:#fff;">'
        + headerHtml.replace(/<th>/g, '<th style="padding:10px 8px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:0.75rem;white-space:nowrap;">') + '</tr></thead>'
        + '<tbody>' + bodyHtml.replace(/<td>/g, '<td style="padding:8px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);font-weight:600;">') + '</tbody>'
        + '</table></div>';
}

function renderTreeHtml() {
    const groups = new Map();
    state.filtered.forEach(row => {
        const rawDate = String(row.sale_date || '').trim() || 'غير محدد';
        if (!groups.has(rawDate)) groups.set(rawDate, []);
        groups.get(rawDate).push(row);
    });
    const sortedDates = Array.from(groups.keys()).sort((a,b) => String(b).localeCompare(String(a)));
    return '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">' + sortedDates.map(date => {
        const rows = groups.get(date);
        const totalAmount = rows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + numeric(r.total_amount), 0);
        const totalQty = rows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + numeric(r.quantity), 0);
        const dateLabel = date === 'غير محدد' ? 'بدون تاريخ' : date;
        const items = rows.map((row, idx) => {
            const id = esc(idOf(row) || (date + '-' + idx));
            const fuelName = translateFieldValue('fuel_type_id', row.fuel_name_ar || row.fuel_name || row.fuel_type_id);
            const time = String(row.sale_time || '').trim() || '—';
            const customer = row.customer_name || row.customer_name_ar || 'بيع نقدي';
            const payment = translateFieldValue('payment_method', row.payment_method);
            return '<div class="tree-item" data-view="' + id + '" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin-top:4px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-glass);border:var(--silver-border);cursor:pointer;">'
                + '<div style="width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold-primary),var(--gold-dark));color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.85rem;flex-shrink:0;"><i class="fas fa-gas-pump"></i></div>'
                + '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:right;">'
                + '<div style="font-weight:800;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-primary);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">#' + esc(row.sale_id || id) + ' — ' + esc(fuelName) + '</div>'
                + '<div style="font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:2px;">' + esc(time) + ' · ' + esc(customer) + ' · ' + esc(payment) + ' · ' + esc(numeric(row.quantity).toFixed(2)) + ' لتر</div>'
                + '</div>'
                + '<div style="font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-primary);font-size:0.85rem;white-space:nowrap;">' + numeric(row.total_amount).toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</div>'
                + '</div>';
        }).join('');
        return '<div data-group>'
            + '<button type="button" data-tree-toggle style="width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(200,154,18,0.12),rgba(200,154,18,0.05));border:var(--silver-border);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;color:var(--text-primary);text-align:right;">'
            + '<i class="fas fa-chevron-down tree-chevron" style="color:var(--gold-primary);font-size:0.85rem;"></i>'
            + '<span style="flex:1;font-weight:800;font-size:0.85rem;"><i class="fas fa-calendar-day" style="color:var(--gold-primary);margin-left:4px;"></i> ' + esc(dateLabel) + '</span>'
            + '<span style="display:inline-flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;">'
            + '<span style="padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-secondary);color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;border:var(--silver-border);"><i class="fas fa-receipt"></i> ' + rows.length + '</span>'
            + '<span style="padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-secondary);color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;border:var(--silver-border);"><i class="fas fa-droplet"></i> ' + totalQty.toFixed(2) + ' لتر</span>'
            + '<span style="padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-secondary);color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;border:var(--silver-border);"><i class="fas fa-coins"></i> ' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</span>'
            + '</span></button>'
            + '<div style="padding:6px 6px 8px;">' + items + '</div>'
            + '</div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
}

function bindRowEvents(box) {
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openDetails(b.dataset.view);
    }));
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-edit]').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openForm(findRow(b.dataset.edit));
    }));
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-delete]').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        deleteRow(findRow(b.dataset.delete));
    }));
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-adjust]').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openFuelAdjustment(findRow(b.dataset.adjust));
    }));
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-tree-toggle]').forEach(h => h.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const group = h.closest('[data-group]');
        if (!group) return;
        const body = group.children[1];
        if (!body) return;
        const isHidden = body.style.display === 'none';
        body.style.display = isHidden ? '' : 'none';
        const chev = h.querySelector('.tree-chevron');
        if (chev) chev.style.transform = isHidden ? '' : 'rotate(-90deg)';
    }));
}

function findRow(id) {
    return state.rows.find((row,index) => String(idOf(row)||index) === String(id));
}

function openDetails(id) {
    const row = findRow(id);
    if (!row) return;
    const details = Object.entries(row).map(([k,v]) => {
        const label = translateFieldLabel(k);
        const value = translateFieldValue(k, typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : v);
        return '<div class="detail-item"><span>' + esc(label) + '</span><strong>' + esc(value) + '</strong></div>';
    }).join('');
    $('detailsBody').innerHTML = '<div class="detail-grid">' + details + '</div>'
        + '<details style="margin-top:12px;"><summary style="cursor:pointer;padding:6px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-secondary);">البيانات الخام (JSON)</summary>'
        + '<pre class="raw-json">' + esc(JSON.stringify(row, null, 2)) + '</pre></details>';
    openModal(null, 'detailsModal');
}

/* ============================================================
   Form inputs
   ============================================================ */
function inputHtml(def, row) {
    const value = row && row[def.key] !== undefined ? row[def.key] : (def.value !== undefined ? def.value : '');
    const req = def.required ? 'required' : '';
    const ro = def.readonly ? 'readonly tabindex="-1"' : '';
    const cls = def.readonly ? ' readonly' : '';
    if (def.type === 'delivery_fee_configuration') {
        const rowFee = row && row.delivery_service_fee !== undefined ? Number(row.delivery_service_fee) : NaN;
        const fee = Number.isFinite(rowFee) && rowFee !== 0 ? row.delivery_service_fee : '';
        return '<div class="form-group full delivery-fee-form-group"><div class="delivery-fee-composite">' +
            '<div class="delivery-fee-cell"><label class="form-label" for="deliveryFeeModeSelect">احتساب رسوم التوصيل</label>' +
            '<select id="deliveryFeeModeSelect" class="form-input" data-key="delivery_fee_mode" required>' +
            '<option value="exempt">معفي منها</option><option value="add_to_sales">تُضاف لقيمة المبيعات</option>' +
            '<option value="driver">على حساب السائق</option><option value="deduct_from_sales">تُنقص من المبيعات</option></select></div>' +
            '<div class="delivery-fee-cell" data-delivery-fee-charge-dependent="true" style="display:none"><label class="form-label" for="deliveryServiceFeeInput">رسوم خدمة التوصيل</label>' +
            '<input id="deliveryServiceFeeInput" class="form-input" data-key="delivery_service_fee" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" inputmode="decimal" value="' + esc(fee) + '"></div>' +
            '</div></div>';
    }
    if (def.type === 'payment_terms_preview') {
        return '<div class="form-group payment-terms-field" data-payment-terms-preview-group="true" style="display:none">' +
            '<label class="form-label">' + esc(def.label) + '</label>' +
            '<input id="paymentTermsDueDatePreview" class="form-input readonly" type="date" readonly tabindex="-1" aria-readonly="true">' +
            '</div>';
    }
    if (def.key === 'delivery_fee_display_total') {
        const numericValue = row && row.delivery_fee_display_total !== undefined
            ? row.delivery_fee_display_total
            : (row && row.total_amount !== undefined ? row.total_amount : 0);
        return '<div class="form-group full" data-delivery-fee-charge-dependent="true" style="display:none">' +
            '<label class="form-label">' + esc(def.label) + '</label>' +
            '<textarea id="deliveryFeeDisplaySummary" class="form-input delivery-fee-display-summary" rows="5" readonly aria-readonly="true" tabindex="-1" placeholder="سيظهر تفصيل احتساب الرسوم هنا"></textarea>' +
            '<input id="deliveryFeeDisplayTotalValue" type="hidden" data-key="delivery_fee_display_total" value="' + esc(numericValue) + '">' +
            '</div>';
    }
    if (def.key === 'delivery_location') {
        return '<div class="form-group full" data-delivery-location-field="true">' +
            '<label class="form-label">' + esc(def.label) + '</label>' +
            '<input class="form-input delivery-location-input" data-key="delivery_location" type="text" inputmode="text" autocomplete="on" list="savedDeliveryLocations" value="' + esc(value) + '" placeholder="أدخل الموقع أو اختر موقعاً محفوظاً">' +
            '<datalist id="savedDeliveryLocations"></datalist>' +
            '</div>';
    }
    if (def.type === 'textarea') {
        return '<div class="form-group full"><label class="form-label">' + esc(def.label) + (def.required?' *':'') + '</label>'
            + '<textarea class="form-input" data-key="' + esc(def.key) + '" rows="3" ' + req + '>' + esc(value) + '</textarea></div>';
    }
    if (def.type === 'select') {
        const paymentTermsClass = def.key === 'payment_terms_id' ? ' payment-terms-field' : '';
        return '<div class="form-group' + paymentTermsClass + (def.full?' full':'') + '"><label class="form-label">' + esc(def.label) + (def.required?' *':'') + '</label>'
            + '<select class="form-input' + cls + '" data-key="' + esc(def.key) + '" ' + req + ' ' + ro + '><option value="">اختر...</option></select></div>';
    }
    const cashCustomerWrapper = def.key === 'cash_customer_name'
        ? ' data-cash-customer-group="true" style="display:none"'
        : '';
    return '<div class="form-group' + (def.full?' full':'') + '"' + cashCustomerWrapper + '><label class="form-label">' + esc(def.label) + (def.required?' *':'') + '</label>'
        + '<input class="form-input' + cls + '" data-key="' + esc(def.key) + '" type="' + esc(def.type) + '" value="' + esc(value) + '" ' + req + ' ' + ro + '></div>';
}

function normalizePromotionBoundary(value, isEnd=false) {
    const boundary = String(value||'').trim().replace('T', ' ');
    if (!boundary) return '';
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(boundary)) return boundary + ' ' + (isEnd?'23:59:59.999':'00:00:00');
    return boundary;
}

function selectedFuelSaleDateTime() {
    const date = document.querySelector('[data-key="sale_date"]')?.value || localDate(new Date());
    const time = document.querySelector('[data-key="sale_time"]')?.value || localTime(new Date());
    return date + ' ' + time;
}

function promotionIsValidAt(row, at) {
    const from = normalizePromotionBoundary(row?.valid_from, false);
    const to = normalizePromotionBoundary(row?.valid_to, true);
    const instant = String(at||'').trim().replace('T', ' ');
    return (!from || from <= instant) && (!to || to >= instant);
}

async function loadActivePromotions(row=null, openToken=state.formOpenSequence) {
    const select = document.querySelector('[data-key="occasion_code"]');
    if (!select || !bridge || typeof bridge.executeFuelSalesAsync !== 'function') return;
    try {
        let promotionRows = state.activePromotionCache.rows;
        const cacheFresh = state.activePromotionCache.loadedAt &&
            Date.now() - state.activePromotionCache.loadedAt < 60000;
        if (!cacheFresh) {
            const result = await invokeFuelSalesAsync('promotions', [JSON.stringify({})]);
            promotionRows = rowsFrom(result);
            state.activePromotionCache = { loadedAt: Date.now(), rows: promotionRows };
        }
        if (openToken !== state.formOpenSequence || !$('formModal').classList.contains('show')) return;

        const at = selectedFuelSaleDateTime();
        const isActive = (r) => {
            if (!r) return false;
            const v = r.is_active;
            if (v === undefined || v === null) return true;
            if (v === true || v === 'true' || v === '1') return true;
            if (v === false || v === 'false' || v === '0') return false;
            const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n === 1 : true;
        };
        const isDeleted = (r) => {
            if (!r) return true;
            const v = r.is_deleted;
            if (v === undefined || v === null) return false;
            if (v === true || v === 'true' || v === '1') return true;
            if (v === false || v === 'false' || v === '0') return false;
            const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n === 1 : false;
        };
        const active = promotionRows.filter(r => r && isActive(r) && !isDeleted(r) && promotionIsValidAt(r, at));
        const occasionOptions = new Map();
        active.forEach(r => {
            const code = String(r.occasion_code || '').trim();
            if (code && !occasionOptions.has(code)) occasionOptions.set(code, r.list_name_ar || r.list_name || r.list_code || code);
        });
        const previous = String(field(row,['occasion_code']) || select.value || '').trim();
        select.innerHTML = '<option value="">بدون عرض محدد</option>'
            + Array.from(occasionOptions.entries()).map(([code,label]) => '<option value="' + esc(code) + '">' + esc(label) + '</option>').join('');
        if (previous && occasionOptions.has(previous)) select.value = previous;
        else if (occasionOptions.size === 1) select.value = occasionOptions.keys().next().value;
        select.onchange = () => refreshResolvedFuelPrice();
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Fuel Promotions]', e);
    }
}

async function getSaleFormLookupData() {
    const cache = state.saleFormLookupCache;
    if (cache.loadedAt && Date.now() - cache.loadedAt < 15000) return cache;
    if (state.saleFormLookupPromise) return state.saleFormLookupPromise;

    // Keep the four essential lookups together. The optional location autocomplete
    // is loaded after the inputs are wired so it cannot delay the usable form.
    state.saleFormLookupPromise = (async () => {
        const response = await invokeFuelSalesAsync('formLookups', []);
        const shift = parseOptionalBridgeResult(response.shift);
        const pumps = parseOptionalBridgeResult(response.pumps);
        const fuels = parseOptionalBridgeResult(response.fuels);
        const customers = parseOptionalBridgeResult(response.customers);
        const paymentTerms = parseOptionalBridgeResult(response.paymentTerms);
        state.saleFormLookupCache = {
            loadedAt: Date.now(),
            shift: dataOf(shift),
            pumps: rowsFrom(pumps),
            fuels: rowsFrom(fuels),
            customers: rowsFrom(customers),
            paymentTerms: rowsFrom(paymentTerms)
        };
        return state.saleFormLookupCache;
    })().finally(() => {
        state.saleFormLookupPromise = null;
    });
    return state.saleFormLookupPromise;
}

function normalizeSavedDeliveryLocationText(value) {
    const raw = String(value == null ? '' : value);
    const unicodeNormalized = typeof raw.normalize === 'function' ? raw.normalize('NFC') : raw;
    return unicodeNormalized.replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function normalizeSavedDeliveryLocations(values) {
    const unique = new Map();
    (Array.isArray(values) ? values : []).forEach(value => {
        const location = normalizeSavedDeliveryLocationText(value);
        if (!location) return;
        // Lowercase is locale-independent; Arabic remains unchanged while Latin names
        // become case-insensitive regardless of the device language.
        const key = location.toLowerCase();
        if (!unique.has(key)) unique.set(key, location);
    });
    return Array.from(unique.values()).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'ar'));
}

function deliveryLocationScopeKey(response) {
    const value = response && response.data && typeof response.data === 'object' &&
        !Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : response;
    const userId = Number(value && (value.user_id ?? value.userId));
    const stationId = Number(value && (value.station_id ?? value.stationId));
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(userId) || userId <= 0 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(stationId) || stationId <= 0) return '';
    return String(userId) + ':' + String(stationId);
}

async function resolveSavedDeliveryLocationScope() {
    if (state.savedDeliveryLocationScopePromise) return state.savedDeliveryLocationScopePromise;
    state.savedDeliveryLocationScopePromise = (async () => {
        const response = parse(await invokeFuelSalesAsync('scope', []));
        const scopeKey = deliveryLocationScopeKey(response);
        if (!scopeKey) throw new Error('لم يرجع Android Bridge معرف المستخدم والمحطة لمقترحات مواقع التوصيل');

        if (state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.scopeKey !== scopeKey) {
            state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache = { scopeKey, loadedAt: 0, rows: [] };
            state.savedDeliveryLocationsRevision = Number(state.savedDeliveryLocationsRevision || 0) + 1;
            const datalist = document.getElementById('savedDeliveryLocations');
            if (datalist) datalist.innerHTML = '';
        }
        return scopeKey;
    })().finally(() => {
        state.savedDeliveryLocationScopePromise = null;
    });
    return state.savedDeliveryLocationScopePromise;
}

function rememberSavedDeliveryLocation(value, confirmedResponse=null) {
    const location = normalizeSavedDeliveryLocationText(value);
    if (!location) return;

    const cache = state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache;
    const responseScopeKey = confirmedResponse ? deliveryLocationScopeKey(confirmedResponse) : '';

    // A write result must carry the authenticated native scope and it must still
    // match the cache namespace currently displayed by this WebView. If the user or
    // station changed while the write was pending, leave the new scope untouched.
    if (!cache.scopeKey || !responseScopeKey || cache.scopeKey !== responseScopeKey) return;

    const rows = normalizeSavedDeliveryLocations([
        ...(cache.rows || []),
        location
    ]);
    state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache = { scopeKey: cache.scopeKey, loadedAt: Date.now(), rows };
    state.savedDeliveryLocationsRevision = Number(state.savedDeliveryLocationsRevision || 0) + 1;

    const datalist = document.getElementById('savedDeliveryLocations');
    if (datalist) {
        datalist.innerHTML = rows
            .map(item => '<option value="' + esc(item) + '"></option>')
            .join('');
    }
}

function isCurrentFuelForm(openToken) {
    return Number(openToken) === Number(state.formOpenSequence) &&
        Boolean($('formModal') && $('formModal').classList.contains('show'));
}

async function loadSavedDeliveryLocationSuggestions(openToken, row=null) {
    const datalist = document.getElementById('savedDeliveryLocations');
    if (!datalist) return;

    // Do not display a previous user's/station's suggestions while the authenticated
    // scope is being revalidated for this form opening.
    datalist.innerHTML = '';

    let scopeKey = '';
    try {
        scopeKey = await resolveSavedDeliveryLocationScope();
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('[Fuel Sales] Saved delivery-location scope unavailable:', error.message || error);
        return;
    }
    if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken) || state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.scopeKey !== scopeKey) return;

    let locations = state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.rows || [];
    const cacheFresh = state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.scopeKey === scopeKey &&
        state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.loadedAt &&
        Date.now() - state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.loadedAt < 60000;

    if (!cacheFresh && bridge && typeof bridge.executeFuelSalesAsync === 'function') {
        const revisionAtQueryStart = Number(state.savedDeliveryLocationsRevision || 0);
        try {
            const response = parse(await invokeFuelSalesAsync('locations', []));
            // The same SQLite result carries its authenticated scope. A delayed response
            // from another account/station must never refill this datalist.
            if (deliveryLocationScopeKey(response) !== scopeKey) {
                throw new Error('تغير نطاق المستخدم أو المحطة أثناء تحميل مواقع التوصيل');
            }
            if (state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.scopeKey !== scopeKey) return;

            const queriedLocations = normalizeSavedDeliveryLocations(
                rowsFrom(response).map(item =>
                    typeof item === 'string' ? item : (item.location || item.delivery_location || '')
                )
            );

            // A committed sale may add a location while this SQLite snapshot is in flight.
            const currentRevision = Number(state.savedDeliveryLocationsRevision || 0);
            locations = currentRevision === revisionAtQueryStart
                ? queriedLocations
                : normalizeSavedDeliveryLocations([
                    ...queriedLocations,
                    ...(state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.rows || [])
                ]);
            state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache = { scopeKey, loadedAt: Date.now(), rows: locations };
            state.savedDeliveryLocationsRevision = currentRevision + 1;
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('[Fuel Sales] Saved delivery locations unavailable:', error.message || error);
        }
    }

    if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken) || state.savedDeliveryLocationsCache.scopeKey !== scopeKey) return;
    const locationInput = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_location"]');
    const currentLocation = normalizeSavedDeliveryLocationText(
        field(row, ['delivery_location','location']) ||
        locationInput?.value ||
        ''
    );
    const suggestions = normalizeSavedDeliveryLocations([
        ...locations,
        ...(currentLocation ? [currentLocation] : [])
    ]);
    datalist.innerHTML = suggestions
        .map(location => '<option value="' + esc(location) + '"></option>')
        .join('');
}


function explicitCustomerPaymentTermDays(customer) {
    const stored = field(customer, ['payment_terms_days','paymentTermsDays']);
    if (stored !== '') {
        const days = Number(stored);
        if (Number.isInteger(days) && days >= 0 && days <= 365) return days;
    }
    const raw = String(field(customer, ['payment_terms','payment_terms_text','credit_terms']) || '')
        .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, ch => String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(ch))).trim();
    if (/^(cash|نقد|نقدي|نقداً|فوري|فوراً|عند الاستلام|upon receipt|immediate)$/i.test(raw)) return 0;
    const match = /(?:net|صافي|خلال|within)\s*(\d{1,3})/i.exec(raw);
    if (!match) return null;
    const days = Number(match[1]);
    return Number.isInteger(days) && days >= 0 && days <= 365 ? days : null;
}

function preferredFuelPaymentTermId(customer, terms) {
    const savedId = Number(field(customer, ['payment_terms_id','payment_term_id']) || 0);
    if (savedId > 0 && terms.some(term => Number(term.id) === savedId)) return String(savedId);
    const days = explicitCustomerPaymentTermDays(customer);
    if (days === null) return '';
    const match = terms.find(term => Number(term.days) === days);
    return match ? String(match.id) : '';
}

function updateFuelPaymentTermsVisibility() {
    const select = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_terms_id"]');
    const payment = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_method"]');
    const customer = document.querySelector('[data-key="customer_id"]');
    const preview = document.querySelector('[data-payment-terms-preview-group="true"]');
    if (!select || !payment || !customer) return;
    const method = String(payment.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const isCredit = ['credit','credit_sale','credit_account','on_account','آجل','اجل'].includes(method);
    const visible = isCredit && Number(customer.value || 0) > 0;
    const group = select.closest('.form-group');
    if (group) group.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
    if (preview) preview.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
    select.required = visible && !state.editing;
    select.disabled = Boolean(state.editing);
    if (!visible && !state.editing) select.value = '';
    updateFuelPaymentTermsPreview();
}

function updateFuelPaymentTermsPreview() {
    const select = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_terms_id"]');
    const dateInput = document.getElementById('paymentTermsDueDatePreview');
    const saleDate = document.querySelector('[data-key="sale_date"]')?.value || '';
    if (!dateInput) return;
    const option = select?.options?.[select.selectedIndex];
    const days = option && option.value ? Number(option.dataset.days) : NaN;
    if (!saleDate || !Number.isInteger(days) || days < 0 || days > 365) { dateInput.value = ''; return; }
    const parts = saleDate.slice(0,10).split('-').map(Number);
    if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some(value => !Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0)) { dateInput.value = ''; return; }
    const date = new Date(Date.UTC(parts[0],parts[1]-1,parts[2]));
    if (date.getUTCFullYear() !== parts[0] || date.getUTCMonth() !== parts[1]-1 ||
        date.getUTCDate() !== parts[2]) { dateInput.value = ''; return; }
    date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + days);
    dateInput.value = date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
}

async function loadSaleFormLookups(row=null, openToken=state.formOpenSequence) {
    const lookups = await getSaleFormLookupData();
    if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) return;

    const shiftId = field(lookups.shift,['shift_id','id']);
    const shiftEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="shift_id"]');
    if (shiftEl && !row) shiftEl.value = shiftId || '';

    const pumpEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="pump_id"]');
    if (pumpEl) {
        pumpEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر المضخة...</option>'
            + lookups.pumps.map(x => '<option value="' + esc(field(x,['id','pump_id'])) + '">' + esc(field(x,['id','pump_id'])) + ' — ' + esc(field(x,['pump_name_ar','pump_name','pump_code','name'])||'مضخة') + '</option>').join('');
        if (row) pumpEl.value = field(row,['pump_id']) || '';
    }

    const fuelEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="fuel_type_id"]');
    if (fuelEl) {
        fuelEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر نوع الوقود...</option>'
            + lookups.fuels.map(x => '<option value="' + esc(field(x,['id','fuel_type_id'])) + '" data-price="' + esc(field(x,['default_sale_price','sale_price','price_per_liter'])||'') + '">'
                + esc(field(x,['id','fuel_type_id'])) + ' — ' + esc(field(x,['fuel_name_ar','fuel_name','name'])||'وقود') + '</option>').join('');
        if (row) fuelEl.value = field(row,['fuel_type_id']) || '';
    }

    const pay = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_method"]');
    if (pay) {
        pay.innerHTML = '<option value="cash">نقدي</option>'
            + '<option value="credit">آجل</option>'
            + '<option value="credit_card">بطاقة</option>';
        pay.value = field(row,['payment_method']) || 'cash';
    }

    const customerEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="customer_id"]');
    if (customerEl) {
        customerEl.innerHTML = '<option value="" selected hidden>اختر العميل عند الحاجة...</option>'
            + '<option value="cash_sale">مبيعات نقدية</option>'
            + lookups.customers.map(x => '<option value="' + esc(field(x,['id','party_id','customer_id'])) + '">' + esc(field(x,['commercial_name_ar','commercial_name','legal_name','name']) || 'عميل') + '</option>').join('');
        const existingCustomerId = field(row,['customer_id','customer_party_id']);
        const hasCashName = String(field(row,['cash_customer_name']) || '').trim().length > 0;
        if (existingCustomerId) customerEl.value = String(existingCustomerId);
        else if (row && hasCashName && ['cash','نقدي','نقداً'].includes(String(field(row,['payment_method']) || '').trim().toLowerCase())) {
            customerEl.value = 'cash_sale';
        } else customerEl.value = '';
    }

    const termSelect = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_terms_id"]');
    if (termSelect) {
        const terms = Array.isArray(lookups.paymentTerms) ? lookups.paymentTerms : [];
        const labels = {1:'بعد يوم واحد',3:'بعد 3 أيام',7:'بعد 7 أيام',15:'بعد 15 يوماً',30:'بعد 30 يوماً',45:'بعد 45 يوماً',60:'بعد 60 يوماً',90:'بعد 90 يوماً'};
        termSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر شروط الدفع من الجدول...</option>' +
            terms.map(term => '<option value="' + esc(term.id) + '" data-days="' + esc(term.days) + '">' +
                esc(labels[Number(term.days)] || ('بعد ' + Number(term.days) + ' يوماً')) +
                '</option>').join('');
        const selectedCustomerId = Number(customerEl?.value || 0);
        const selectedCustomer = lookups.customers.find(item =>
            Number(field(item,['id','party_id','customer_id'])) === selectedCustomerId
        );
        const savedTermId = Number(field(row,['payment_terms_id_at_sale','payment_terms_id']) || 0);
        termSelect.value = savedTermId > 0 && terms.some(term => Number(term.id) === savedTermId)
            ? String(savedTermId)
            : (row ? '' : preferredFuelPaymentTermId(selectedCustomer, terms));
        termSelect.onchange = () => {
            state.lastSuccessfulSaleFingerprint = null;
            updateFuelPaymentTermsPreview();
        };
    }

    const feeModeEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_fee_mode"]');
    if (feeModeEl) {
        feeModeEl.value = String(field(row,['delivery_fee_mode']) || 'exempt');
        if (!['exempt','add_to_sales','driver','deduct_from_sales'].includes(feeModeEl.value)) feeModeEl.value = 'exempt';
    }
    const deliveryLocationEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_location"]');
    if (deliveryLocationEl) deliveryLocationEl.value = String(field(row,['delivery_location','location']) || '');
    const cashNameEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="cash_customer_name"]');
    if (cashNameEl) cashNameEl.value = String(field(row,['cash_customer_name','cash_customer_display_name']) || '');

    const locationInput = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_location"]');
    if (locationInput && row) {
        locationInput.value = String(field(row,['delivery_location','location']) || '');
    }

    if (!row) {
        const now = new Date();
        const dateEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="sale_date"]');
        if (dateEl) dateEl.value = localDate(now);
        const timeEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="sale_time"]');
        if (timeEl) timeEl.value = localTime(now);
    }

    const pumpSelect = document.querySelector('[data-key="pump_id"]');
    if (pumpSelect) {
        pumpSelect.onchange = async () => {
            const changedPumpId = String(pumpSelect.value || '');
            await loadPumpNozzles(changedPumpId, '', openToken);
            if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken) || String(pumpSelect.value || '') !== changedPumpId) return;
            const fuel = document.querySelector('[data-key="fuel_type_id"]');
            const price = document.querySelector('[data-key="price_per_liter"]');
            const total = document.querySelector('[data-key="total_amount"]');
            if (fuel) fuel.value = '';
            if (price) price.value = '';
            if (total) total.value = '';
            updateDeliveryFeeDisplay();
        };
    }

    const selectedPumpId = row ? field(row,['pump_id']) : (pumpSelect?.value || '');
    const nozzleSelect = document.querySelector('[data-key="nozzle_id"]');
    if (nozzleSelect) {
        nozzleSelect.disabled = !selectedPumpId;
        nozzleSelect.onchange = () => {
        const option = nozzleSelect.options[nozzleSelect.selectedIndex];
        const fuelId = option?.dataset?.fuelTypeId || '';
        const fuel = document.querySelector('[data-key="fuel_type_id"]');
        if (fuel && fuelId && Array.from(fuel.options).some(o => String(o.value) === String(fuelId))) {
            fuel.value = String(fuelId);
            fuel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true}));
        } else {
            const price = document.querySelector('[data-key="price_per_liter"]');
            const total = document.querySelector('[data-key="total_amount"]');
            if (fuel) fuel.value = '';
            if (price) price.value = '';
            if (total) total.value = '';
            toast('هذه الفوهة غير مرتبطة بنوع وقود صالح في قاعدة البيانات؛ تحقق من إعداد الفوهة.', true, 'form');
        }
        };
    }

    const fee = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_service_fee"]');
    const mode = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_fee_mode"]');
    if (fee) fee.oninput = updateDeliveryFeeDisplay;
    if (mode) mode.onchange = updateDeliveryFeeDisplay;
    const location = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_location"]');
    const cashName = document.querySelector('[data-key="cash_customer_name"]');
    [location,cashName].forEach(el => {
        if (el) el.addEventListener('input', () => { state.lastSuccessfulSaleFingerprint = null; });
    });

    bindFuelCalculation(!row);
    updateFuelPaymentTermsVisibility();
