        function renderSkeletons() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('dashStats');
            const skeletonCards = [
                'total-products', 'daily-sales', 'cash-sales', 'credit-sales',
                'collected-amount', 'active-customers',
                'returned-products-full', 'damaged-products-full',
                'due-invoices', 'expiry-soon',
                'customer-debts', 'supplier-debts',
                'inventory-value', 'low-stock',
                'pending-tasks', 'occupancy'
            ];
            grid.innerHTML = '';
            skeletonCards.forEach(id => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'stat-card skeleton';
                if (id === 'returned-products-full' || id === 'damaged-products-full') {
                    card.classList.add('full-width');
                }
                card.id = `skeleton-${id}`;
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="card-header"></div>
                    <div class="stat-value"></div>
                    <div class="stat-label"></div>
                    <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function enforceStatsTwoColumns() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('dashStats');
            if (!grid) return;
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))';
            grid.style.width = '100%';
            Array.from(grid.children).forEach(card => {
                card.style.minWidth = '0';
                card.style.maxWidth = '100%';
                card.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
            });
        }

        function updateStatsCards(stats) {
            stats = stats || {};
            const grid = document.getElementById('dashStats');
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            const formatTrend = (trendData) => {
                if (!trendData || !Number.isFinite(Number(trendData.percentage_change))) {
                    return { text: '—', up: false, label: 'لا توجد مقارنة كافية' };
                }
                const pct = Number(trendData.percentage_change);
                const dir = trendData.trend_direction;
                return {
                    text: (pct > 0 ? '+' : '') + pct + '%',
                    up: dir === 'up',
                    label: trendData.trend_label || 'مقارنة سابقة'
                };
            };
            const prodTrend = formatTrend(stats.products_trend_data);
            const salesTrend = formatTrend(stats.sales_trend_data);
            const custTrend = formatTrend(stats.customers_trend_data);

            const cardDefs = [
                { id: 'card-total-products', header: 'إجمالي المنتجات', icon: 'fa-boxes',
                    value: stats.total_products || 0, label: prodTrend.label,
                    trend: prodTrend.text, trendUp: prodTrend.up },
                { id: 'card-daily-sales', header: 'المبيعات اليومية', icon: 'fa-chart-line',
                    value: (stats.daily_sales || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ' + CURRENCY, label: salesTrend.label,
                    trend: salesTrend.text, trendUp: salesTrend.up, cls: 'success-card' },
                { id: 'card-cash-sales', header: 'مبيعات نقدية', icon: 'fa-money-bill-wave',
                    value: (stats.cash_sales || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ' + CURRENCY,
                    label: 'من المبيعات اليومية' },
                { id: 'card-credit-sales', header: 'مبيعات آجلة', icon: 'fa-user-clock',
                    value: (stats.credit_sales || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ' + CURRENCY,
                    label: 'إجمالي البيع الآجل اليوم' },
                { id: 'card-collected-amount', header: 'المتحصل فعلياً', icon: 'fa-hand-holding-usd',
                    value: (stats.collected_amount || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ' + CURRENCY,
                    label: 'من سجلات التحصيل اليوم' },
                { id: 'card-active-customers', header: 'العملاء النشطين', icon: 'fa-users',
                    value: stats.active_customers || 0, label: custTrend.label,
                    trend: custTrend.text, trendUp: custTrend.up, cls: '' },
                { id: 'card-returned-products', header: 'المرتجعات', icon: 'fa-undo',
                    dual: [
                        { value: Number(stats.returned_fuel_today || 0).toFixed(2), label: 'كمية اليوم (لتر)' },
                        { value: Number(stats.returned_products_today || 0).toFixed(2), label: 'كمية اليوم (منتج)' }
                    ], cls: 'info-card', fullWidth: true },
                { id: 'card-damaged-products', header: 'التالفة', icon: 'fa-ban',
                    dual: [
                        { value: Number(stats.damaged_fuel_today || 0).toFixed(2), label: 'كمية اليوم (لتر)' },
                        { value: Number(stats.damaged_products_today || 0).toFixed(2), label: 'كمية اليوم (منتج)' }
                    ], cls: 'danger-card', fullWidth: true },
                { id: 'card-due-invoices', header: 'الفواتير المستحقة', icon: 'fa-file-invoice',
                    value: stats.due_invoices || 0, label: 'فاتورة خلال 8 أيام (اليوم + 7)', cls: 'info-card' },
                { id: 'card-expiry-soon', header: 'المنتهية قريباً', icon: 'fa-hourglass-half',
                    value: stats.expiry_soon || 0, label: 'منتج خلال 30 يومًا',
                    badge: stats.expiry_soon || 0, cls: 'warning-card' },
                { id: 'card-customer-debts', header: 'مديونية العملاء', icon: 'fa-hand-holding-usd',
                    value: (stats.customer_debts || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ' + CURRENCY,
                    label: 'إجمالي الديون المستحقة', cls: 'warning-card' },
                { id: 'card-supplier-debts', header: 'مديونية الموردين', icon: 'fa-file-invoice-dollar',
                    value: Number(stats.total_supplier_payables ?? stats.supplier_payables_summary?.total_supplier_payables ?? stats.supplier_debts ?? 0).toFixed(2) + ' ' + CURRENCY,
                    label: 'إجمالي الدين للموردين' },
                { id: 'card-inventory-value', header: 'قيمة المخزون', icon: 'fa-warehouse',
                    value: (stats.inventory_value || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ' + CURRENCY,
                    label: 'القيمة الإجمالية للمخزون', cls: 'success-card' },
                { id: 'card-low-stock', header: 'انخفاض المخزون', icon: 'fa-exclamation-circle',
                    value: stats.low_stock || 0, label: 'تحت الحد الأدنى',
                    badge: stats.low_stock || 0, cls: 'danger-card' },
                { id: 'card-pending-tasks', header: 'المهام المعلقة', icon: 'fa-tasks',
                    value: stats.pending_tasks || 0, label: 'مهمة تحتاج لمراجعتك',
                    badge: stats.pending_tasks || 0, cls: 'info-card' },
                { id: 'card-occupancy', header: 'امتلاء الخزانات', icon: 'fa-tachometer-alt',

                    progress: (Number(stats.occupancy_rate) || 0), cls: 'info-card' }
            ];

            cardDefs.forEach(def => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = `stat-card ${def.cls || ''}${def.fullWidth ? ' full-width' : ''}`;
                card.id = def.id;
                let badgeHtml = '';
                if (def.badge && def.badge > 0) {
                    badgeHtml = `<div class="card-badge">${def.badge}</div>`;
                }
                let progressHtml = '';
                if (def.progress !== undefined) {
                    progressHtml = `<div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${Math.min(100, def.progress)}%"></div></div>`;
                }
                let trendHtml = '';
                if (def.trend) {
                    const up = def.trendUp !== false;
                    trendHtml = `<div class="stat-trend trend-${up ? 'up' : 'down'}"><i class="fas fa-arrow-${up ? 'up' : 'down'}"></i> ${def.trend}</div>`;
                }
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="card-header">
                        <div class="card-icon-wrapper"><i class="fas ${def.icon}"></i></div>
                        <h3>${def.header}</h3>

                    ${def.dual ? `<div class="dual-stat-values">${def.dual.map(item => `

                        </div>`).join('')}</div>` : `<div class="stat-value">${def.value}</div>

                        ${trendHtml}
                        <span class="stat-label">${def.label}</span>
                    </div>`}
                    ${badgeHtml}
                    ${progressHtml}
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });

            enforceStatsTwoColumns();

        function readDashboardCache() {
            try {
                const cached = localStorage.getItem('dashboardCache');
                if (!cached) return null;
                const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
                return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
            } catch (e) { return null; }
        }

        async function loadDashboard(forceRefresh = false) {
            if (isRefreshing) {
                if (forceRefresh) dashboardRefreshQueued = true;
                return;
            }
            isRefreshing = true;
            // Preserve the last successful snapshot while refreshing; show skeletons only
            // before the first successful load in this WebView session.
            if (!dashboardCache) renderSkeletons();

            try {
                const result = await apiCall('getDashboardStats');
                if (!result.success || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result.error || 'فشل تحميل الإحصائيات');
                }
                const stats = result.data;
                dashboardCache = stats;
                try { localStorage.setItem('dashboardCache', JSON.stringify(stats)); } catch (e) {}
                updateStatsCards(stats);
                if (stats.notifications) showRealNotifications(stats);
                // Reminder refresh performs multiple synchronous bridge calls. Run it only
                // once per 15 minutes after the first successful dashboard load for this
                // authenticated user/station, instead of on every resume/focus refresh.
                const reminderCheckAt = Date.now();
                if (shouldRefreshMainDueReminders(reminderCheckAt)) {
                    if (await refreshMainDueReminders()) markMainDueRemindersRefreshed(reminderCheckAt);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Dashboard error:', e);
                showToast(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل بيانات SQLite', 'error');
            } finally {
                isRefreshing = false;
                if (dashboardRefreshQueued) {
                    dashboardRefreshQueued = false;
                    setTimeout(() => loadDashboard(true), 0);
                }
            }
        }

        function scheduleDashboardResumeRefresh() {
            if (dashboardResumeRefreshTimer !== null) {
                clearTimeout(dashboardResumeRefreshTimer);
            }
            dashboardResumeRefreshTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                dashboardResumeRefreshTimer = null;
                if (document.hidden || isSleeping || isRefreshing) return;
                loadDashboard(false);
            }, 180);
        }

        function manualRefresh() {
            loadDashboard(true);
        }

        // ================================================================
        // Notifications — six dashboard bubbles
        // ================================================================
        const REENABLE_DELAY = 3000;

        function showRealNotifications(stats) {
            if (!stats || !notificationsEnabled) return;
            if (Number(stats.low_stock) > 0) addNotificationToQueue({
                type: 'low_stock', icon: 'fa-exclamation-circle', color: 'danger',
                targetCard: 'card-low-stock',
                message: `هناك ${Number(stats.low_stock)} منتج تحت الحد الأدنى`
            });
            if (Number(stats.due_invoices) > 0) addNotificationToQueue({
                type: 'due_invoices', icon: 'fa-file-invoice', color: 'info',
                targetCard: 'card-due-invoices',
                message: `${Number(stats.due_invoices)} فاتورة مستحقة خلال 8 أيام`
            });

            const damagedFuel = Number(stats.damaged_fuel_today) || 0;
            const damagedProd = Number(stats.damaged_products_today) || 0;
            if (damagedFuel > 0 || damagedProd > 0) {
                const parts = [];
                if (damagedFuel > 0) parts.push(`${damagedFuel.toFixed(2)} لتر وقود`);
                if (damagedProd > 0) parts.push(`${damagedProd.toFixed(2)} منتج`);
                addNotificationToQueue({
                    type: 'damaged_products', icon: 'fa-ban', color: 'damaged',
                    targetCard: 'card-damaged-products', message: `تالفات اليوم: ${parts.join(' + ')}`
                });
            }

            const retFuel = Number(stats.returned_fuel_today) || 0;
            const retProd = Number(stats.returned_products_today) || 0;
            if (retFuel > 0 || retProd > 0) {
                const parts = [];
                if (retFuel > 0) parts.push(`${retFuel.toFixed(2)} لتر وقود`);
                if (retProd > 0) parts.push(`${retProd.toFixed(2)} منتج`);
                addNotificationToQueue({
                    type: 'returned_products', icon: 'fa-undo', color: 'returned',
                    targetCard: 'card-returned-products', message: `مرتجعات اليوم: ${parts.join(' + ')}`
                });
            }
            if (Number(stats.expiry_soon) > 0) addNotificationToQueue({
                type: 'expiry_soon', icon: 'fa-hourglass-half', color: 'warning',
                targetCard: 'card-expiry-soon',
                message: `هناك ${Number(stats.expiry_soon)} منتج ستنتهي صلاحيته خلال 30 يومًا`
            });
            if (Number(stats.pending_tasks) > 0) addNotificationToQueue({
                type: 'pending_tasks', icon: 'fa-tasks', color: 'info',
                targetCard: 'card-pending-tasks',
                message: `لديك ${Number(stats.pending_tasks)} مهمة تحتاج إلى مراجعتك`
            });
            processNotificationQueue();
        }

        function addNotificationToQueue(notification) {
            if (!notification || !notificationsEnabled || activeBubbles.has(notification.type)) return;
            if (notificationQueue.some(item => item.type === notification.type)) return;
            notificationQueue.push(notification);
        }

        function processNotificationQueue() {
            if (!notificationsEnabled || isProcessingQueue || notificationQueue.length === 0) return;
            isProcessingQueue = true;
            createNotificationBubble(notificationQueue.shift());
            setTimeout(() => { isProcessingQueue = false; processNotificationQueue(); }, 1500);
        }

        function createNotificationBubble(notification) {
            if (!notification || activeBubbles.has(notification.type)) return;
            const container = document.getElementById('bubbleContainer') || createBubbleContainer();
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            const bubbleColors = { low_stock:'#FF4757', due_invoices:'#3D8BC4', damaged_products:'#EA5808', returned_products:'#6F42C1', expiry_soon:'#F59E0B', pending_tasks:'#14B8A6' };
            bubble.className = `notification-bubble bubble-${notification.color}`;
            bubble.style.setProperty('--bubble-color', bubbleColors[notification.type] || '#3D8BC4');
            bubble.dataset.target = notification.targetCard;
            bubble.dataset.type = notification.type;
            bubble.title = notification.message;
            bubble.setAttribute('aria-label', notification.message);
            bubble.setAttribute('role', 'button');
            bubble.tabIndex = 0;
            bubble.innerHTML = `<i class="fas ${notification.icon}" aria-hidden="true"></i>`;
            bubble.addEventListener('click', () => handleBubbleClick(bubble));
            bubble.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
                if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    handleBubbleClick(bubble);
                }
            });
            container.appendChild(bubble);
            activeBubbles.set(notification.type, { element: bubble });
            animateBubbleFromCard(bubble);
        }

        function animateBubbleFromCards(bubble, sources) {
            if (!bubble || !Array.isArray(sources) || !sources.length) return;
            if (window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
            const destination=bubble.getBoundingClientRect();
            const targetX=destination.left+destination.width/2, targetY=destination.top+destination.height/2;
            sources.forEach((source,index)=>{
                if(!source||typeof source.getBoundingClientRect!=='function')return;
                const rect=source.getBoundingClientRect();
                const particle=document.createElement('span');
                particle.className='bubble-flight-particle';
                Object.assign(particle.style,{position:'fixed',left:`${rect.left+rect.width/2-10}px`,top:`${rect.top+rect.height/2-10}px`,width:'20px',height:'20px',borderRadius:'50%',zIndex:'100001',pointerEvents:'none',background:'radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff6d6,#d4a86a 65%,#9a6b22)',boxShadow:'0 0 16px rgba(212,168,106,.8)',opacity:'.95'});
                document.body.appendChild(particle);
                const dx=targetX-(rect.left+rect.width/2),dy=targetY-(rect.top+rect.height/2);
                const keyframes=[{transform:'translate(0,0) scale(.35)',opacity:0},{transform:`translate(${dx*.58}px,${dy*.58-24}px) scale(.8)`,opacity:1,offset:.65},{transform:`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) scale(.08)`,opacity:0}];
                if(typeof particle.animate==='function'){
                    const anim=particle.animate(keyframes,{duration:760+index*70,delay:index*80,easing:'cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.25,1)'});
                    anim.onfinish=()=>particle.remove();
                }else{
                    particle.style.transition=`transform ${760+index*70}ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.25,1) ${index*80}ms, opacity ${760+index*70}ms ease ${index*80}ms`;
                    requestAnimationFrame(()=>{particle.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) scale(.08)`;particle.style.opacity='0';});
                    setTimeout(()=>particle.remove(),900+index*80);
                }
            });
            bubble.animate?.([{transform:'scale(.7)',opacity:.35},{transform:'scale(1.12)',opacity:1,offset:.6},{transform:'scale(1)',opacity:1}],{duration:520,easing:'cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1)'});
        }
        function animateBubbleFromCard(bubble) {
            if (!bubble || window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
            const source = document.getElementById(bubble.dataset.target);
            if (!source || typeof bubble.getBoundingClientRect !== 'function') { bubble.style.opacity = '1'; return; }
            const from = source.getBoundingClientRect(), to = bubble.getBoundingClientRect();
            const dx = from.left + from.width / 2 - (to.left + to.width / 2);
            const dy = from.top + from.height / 2 - (to.top + to.height / 2);
            if (typeof bubble.animate === 'function') {
                try {
                    const animation = bubble.animate([{ transform:`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) scale(.18)`, opacity:.15 },{ transform:'translate(0,0) scale(1)', opacity:1 }], { duration:900, easing:'cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1)', fill:'both' });
                    animation.onfinish = () => { bubble.style.opacity='1'; bubble.style.transform='none'; };
                    return;
                } catch (_) { /* older WebView fallback */ }
            }
            bubble.style.transition='none'; bubble.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) scale(.18)`; bubble.style.opacity='.15';
            setTimeout(() => { bubble.style.transition='transform 900ms cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1), opacity 900ms ease'; bubble.style.transform='translate(0,0) scale(1)'; bubble.style.opacity='1'; },30);
        }

        function handleBubbleClick(bubble) {
            if (!bubble || bubble.dataset.dismissed === 'true') return;
            bubble.dataset.dismissed = 'true';
            const type = bubble.dataset.type;
            const card = document.getElementById(bubble.dataset.target);
            if (card) {
                card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                const previousShadow = card.style.boxShadow;
                card.style.boxShadow = '0 0 24px rgba(212,168,106,.95)';
                setTimeout(() => { card.style.boxShadow = previousShadow; }, 1800);
            } else {
                console.warn(`[Bubble] Card "${bubble.dataset.target}" not found.`);
            }
            bubble.style.transition = 'all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)';
            bubble.style.transform = 'scale(0)';
            bubble.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => {
                bubble.remove();
                if (activeBubbles.get(type)?.element === bubble) activeBubbles.delete(type);
            }, 350);
        }

        function createBubbleContainer() {
            const container = document.createElement('div');
            container.id = 'bubbleContainer';
            container.className = 'bubble-container';
            document.body.appendChild(container);
            return container;
        }

        function hideAllBubbles() {
            activeBubbles.forEach(({ element }) => {
                element.style.transition = 'all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)';
                element.style.transform = 'scale(0)';
                element.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => element.remove(), 400);
            });
            activeBubbles.clear();
            notificationQueue = [];
            isProcessingQueue = false;
            notificationsEnabled = false;
            if (notificationsReenableTimer !== null) clearTimeout(notificationsReenableTimer);
            notificationsReenableTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                notificationsEnabled = true;
                notificationsReenableTimer = null;
            }, REENABLE_DELAY);
        }

        function initCardDoubleClick() {
            const routes = {
                'card-total-products': 'screens/products.html',
                'card-daily-sales': 'screens/sales-reports.html',
                'card-active-customers': 'screens/customers.html',
                'card-expiry-soon': 'screens/expiry-soon.html',
                'card-low-stock': 'screens/stock-levels.html',
                'card-due-invoices': 'screens/customer-debts.html?drilldown=due-invoices',
                'card-returned-products': 'screens/returned-products.html',
                'card-damaged-products': 'screens/damaged-products.html',
                'card-customer-debts': 'screens/customer-debts.html',
                'card-supplier-debts': 'screens/suppliers.html',
                'card-inventory-value': 'screens/inventory-reports.html',
                'card-pending-tasks': 'screens/tasks.html',
                'card-occupancy': 'screens/tanks.html'
            };
            Object.entries(routes).forEach(([id, route]) => {
                const card = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!card || card.dataset.bound) return;
                card.dataset.bound = 'true';
                card.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    navigateTo(route);
                });
            });
        }

        // ================================================================
        // Pull-to-Refresh
        // ================================================================
        function initPullToRefresh() {
            let startY = 0, moveY = 0, pulling = false;
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                if (document.querySelector('.command-palette-overlay.show')) return;
                if (isSleeping) return;
                startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                pulling = false;
            }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
                if (document.querySelector('.command-palette-overlay.show')) return;
                if (isSleeping) return;
                moveY = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
                if (moveY > 0 && window.scrollY === 0) pulling = true;
            }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
                if (isSleeping) return;
                if (pulling && moveY > 70) manualRefresh();
                moveY = 0;
                pulling = false;
            }, { passive: true });
        }

            currentLeadX = SIDEBAR_CLOSED;

            initSleepMode();

            const cmdInput = document.getElementById('commandPaletteInput');
            cmdInput.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
                renderCommandPaletteResults(e.target.value.trim());
            });
            cmdInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                const results = document.querySelectorAll('.palette-results .result-item');
                let active = -1;
                results.forEach((el, i) => { if (el.classList.contains('active')) active = i; });
                if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    let next = active + 1;
                    if (next >= results.length) next = 0;
                    results.forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
                    if (results[next]) results[next].classList.add('active');
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    let prev = active - 1;
                    if (prev < 0) prev = results.length - 1;
                    results.forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
                    if (results[prev]) results[prev].classList.add('active');
                } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const activeEl = document.querySelector('.palette-results .result-item.active');
                    if (activeEl) activeEl.click();
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeCommandPalette();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'k') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const overlay = document.getElementById('commandPaletteOverlay');
                    if (overlay.classList.contains('show')) closeCommandPalette();
                    else openCommandPalette();
                }
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
                    if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) closeSidebar();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('click', handlePanelOutsideClick);

            initPullToRefresh();

            if (!bridgeReady) {
                setTimeout(() => { if (!useAndroidInterface) initAndroidBridge(); }, 2000);
                return;
            }

            const userLoaded = await loadUserFromKotlin();
            if (!userLoaded) return;

            await refreshDebtReminderSendSuccess();
            if (!window.__debtReminderSendSuccessTimer) {
                window.__debtReminderSendSuccessTimer = setInterval(() => {
                    if (!document.hidden && !isSleeping) refreshDebtReminderSendSuccess();
                }, 12000);
            }

            initCardDoubleClick();

            updateThemeButton(document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark');

            if (currentUser) updateUserInfo(currentUser);

            window.addEventListener('pageshow', async function(e) {
                await loadDisplaySettings();
                scheduleDashboardResumeRefresh();
                handleUserActivity();
            });
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
                if (!document.hidden && !isSleeping) {
                    scheduleDashboardResumeRefresh();
                    handleUserActivity();
                }
            });
            window.addEventListener('focus', function() {
                if (!isSleeping) {
                    scheduleDashboardResumeRefresh();
                    handleUserActivity();
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
                syncElasticSvgWidth();
            });
        });

        function handlePanelOutsideClick(event) {
            if (isSleeping) return;
            const target = event.target;
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const sideTab = document.getElementById('sideTab');
            const searchInput = document.getElementById('sidebarSearch');
            const pinBtn = document.getElementById('pinBtn');
            const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.sidebar-close');
            const compactBtn = document.getElementById('compactBtn');
            const cmdPalette = document.querySelector('.command-palette-box');

            if (sidebar && sidebar.contains(target)) return;
            if (sideTab && sideTab.contains(target)) return;
            if (searchInput && searchInput.contains(target)) return;
            if (pinBtn && pinBtn.contains(target)) return;
            if (closeBtn && closeBtn.contains(target)) return;
            if (compactBtn && compactBtn.contains(target)) return;
            if (cmdPalette && cmdPalette.contains(target)) return;

            if (sidebar && sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
                closeSidebar();
            }
        }
