package com.aistudio.dieselstationsms.kxmpzq

import android.database.Cursor
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * Workpaper for reconciling historical financial data.
 *
 * Read-only workpaper used before and after source-backed historical repairs.
 * Missing required schema and unresolved source differences block statement approval.
 */
internal class HistoricalFinancialReconciliationAudit(private val db: SQLiteDatabase) {

    fun run(stationId: Int): JSONObject {
        require(stationId > 0) { "A valid station scope is required" }
        val checks = JSONObject()
        val issues = JSONArray()
        val schemaComplete = checkRequiredSchema(checks, issues)
        if (schemaComplete) {
            checkSales(stationId, checks, issues)
            checkPayments(stationId, checks, issues)
            checkCashAndBanks(stationId, checks, issues)
            checkCustomerAndSupplierLedgers(stationId, checks, issues)
            checkInventory(stationId, checks, issues)
            checkFuelAndRefills(stationId, checks, issues)
            checkPeriodsAndCurrency(stationId, checks, issues)
            checkOpeningBalances(stationId, checks, issues)
        }
        return JSONObject()
            .put("station_id", stationId)
            .put("checked_at", now())
            .put("status", if (issues.length() == 0) "reconciled" else "reconciliation_required")
            .put("approval_status", if (issues.length() == 0) "ready" else "blocked")
            .put("ready_for_financial_statement_approval", issues.length() == 0)
            .put("blocking_issue_count", issues.length())
            .put("checks", checks)
            .put("issues", issues)
            .put("automatic_repairs", false)
    }

    /**
     * Prevent a false clean report when a checker silently returns because a table
     * or a critical column is absent. Such a database cannot pass statement approval.
     */
    private fun checkRequiredSchema(checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray): Boolean {
        val required = linkedMapOf(
            "sales_transactions" to setOf("id","station_id","status","is_deleted","sale_code","net_amount","paid_amount","remaining_amount","currency_id","amount_in_default"),
            "journal_entries" to setOf("id","station_id","reference_type","reference_id","status","is_deleted","fiscal_year","fiscal_period"),
            "journal_entry_items" to setOf("journal_entry_id","account_id","debit","credit"),
            "payments" to setOf("id","station_id","status","is_deleted","payment_code","amount","sale_id","customer_party_id","cash_box_id","bank_account_id","journal_entry_id","payment_method","currency_id","amount_in_default"),
            "parties" to setOf("id","station_id","party_type_id","legal_name","current_balance","total_due","total_purchases","total_payments","is_deleted"),
            "party_types" to setOf("id","type_code"),
            "customer_ledger" to setOf("id","party_id","debit","credit"),
            "supplier_ledger" to setOf("id","party_id","debit","credit","transaction_type","transaction_id"),
            "accounts" to setOf("id","account_code","account_type","is_active","is_deleted","opening_balance","parent_account_id","cash_box_id","bank_account_id","is_cash_account","is_bank_account"),
            "cash_boxes" to setOf("id","station_id","opening_balance","current_balance"),
            "cash_movements" to setOf("id","cash_box_id","movement_type","amount","balance_before","balance_after"),
            "bank_accounts" to setOf("id","station_id","opening_balance","current_balance"),
            "bank_ledger" to setOf("id","bank_account_id","debit","credit","balance"),
            "products" to setOf("id","station_id","product_name","product_name_ar","quantity","is_deleted"),
            "inventory_levels" to setOf("product_id","quantity_on_hand"),
            "inventory_movements" to setOf("id","station_id","status","is_deleted","product_id","quantity_before","quantity_change","quantity_after"),
            "fuel_sales" to setOf("id","station_id","sale_id","fuel_type_id","quantity","cost_per_liter","cost_amount","status","is_deleted"),
            "fuel_types" to setOf("id","default_purchase_price"),
            "tank_refills" to setOf("id","station_id","refill_code","supplier_id","net_amount","delivered_quantity","actual_quantity","tank_level_before","tank_level_after","status","is_deleted"),
            "fiscal_periods" to setOf("station_id","start_date","end_date")
        )
        val gaps = JSONArray()
        var gapCount = 0
        for ((table, needed) in required) {
            if (!tableExists(table)) {
                gaps.put(JSONObject().put("table",table).put("missing_table",true))
                gapCount++
                continue
            }
            val missing = (needed - columns(table)).sorted()
            if (missing.isNotEmpty()) {
                gaps.put(JSONObject().put("table",table).put("missing_columns",JSONArray(missing)))
                gapCount += missing.size
            }
        }
        checks.put("required_schema_gaps",gaps)
        if (gaps.length() > 0) {
            add(issues,"historical_schema_incomplete","critical",
                "لا يمكن اعتماد القوائم المالية: توجد جداول أو أعمدة مطلوبة للمصالحة غير متاحة",gapCount,null,gaps)
            return false
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun checkSales(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        if (!tableExists("sales_transactions") || !tableExists("journal_entries")) return
        val sales = rows(
            "SELECT s.id,COALESCE(s.sale_code,''),COALESCE(s.net_amount,0) FROM sales_transactions s " +
                "WHERE s.station_id=? AND s.status='completed' AND COALESCE(s.is_deleted,0)=0 " +
                "AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries j WHERE j.station_id=s.station_id AND j.reference_type='sale' " +
                "AND j.reference_id=s.id AND j.status='posted' AND COALESCE(j.is_deleted,0)=0) ORDER BY s.id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("sale_id", c.getLong(0)).put("sale_code", c.getString(1)).put("amount", c.getDouble(2)) }
        val cogs = rows(
            "SELECT s.id,COALESCE(s.sale_code,''),COALESCE(s.net_amount,0) FROM sales_transactions s " +
                "WHERE s.station_id=? AND s.status='completed' AND COALESCE(s.is_deleted,0)=0 " +
                "AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries j WHERE j.station_id=s.station_id AND j.reference_type='sale_cogs' " +
                "AND j.reference_id=s.id AND j.status='posted' AND COALESCE(j.is_deleted,0)=0) ORDER BY s.id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("sale_id", c.getLong(0)).put("sale_code", c.getString(1)).put("sales_amount", c.getDouble(2)) }
        checks.put("missing_sale_journals", sales).put("missing_sale_cogs_journals", cogs)
        add(issues, "missing_sale_journals", "critical", "مبيعات مكتملة بلا قيد إيراد/تحصيل/ذمم مطابق", sales.length(), sum(sales, "amount"), sales)
        add(issues, "missing_sale_cogs_journals", "critical", "مبيعات مكتملة بلا قيد تكلفة مطابق؛ لا يمكن استنتاج تكلفة تاريخية من سعر اليوم", cogs.length(), sum(cogs, "sales_amount"), cogs)

        val arithmetic = rows(
            "SELECT id,COALESCE(sale_code,''),COALESCE(net_amount,0),COALESCE(paid_amount,0),COALESCE(remaining_amount,0) " +
                "FROM sales_transactions WHERE station_id=? AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0 " +
                "AND ABS(COALESCE(net_amount,0)-COALESCE(paid_amount,0)-COALESCE(remaining_amount,0))>0.01 ORDER BY id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("sale_id", c.getLong(0)).put("sale_code", c.getString(1)).put("net", c.getDouble(2))
            .put("paid", c.getDouble(3)).put("remaining", c.getDouble(4)).put("difference", c.getDouble(2)-c.getDouble(3)-c.getDouble(4)) }
        checks.put("sales_payment_arithmetic_mismatches", arithmetic)
        add(issues, "sales_payment_arithmetic_mismatches", "critical", "صافي الفاتورة لا يساوي المدفوع زائد المتبقي", arithmetic.length(), sum(arithmetic, "difference"), arithmetic)
    }

    private fun checkPayments(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        if (!tableExists("payments") || !tableExists("journal_entries")) return
        val missing = rows(
            "SELECT p.id,COALESCE(p.payment_code,''),COALESCE(p.amount,0),COALESCE(p.sale_id,0),COALESCE(p.customer_party_id,0)," +
                "COALESCE(p.cash_box_id,0),COALESCE(p.bank_account_id,0),COALESCE(p.journal_entry_id,0),COALESCE(p.payment_method,'') " +
                "FROM payments p WHERE p.station_id=? AND p.status='completed' AND COALESCE(p.is_deleted,0)=0 AND " +
                "(COALESCE(p.journal_entry_id,0)=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries j WHERE j.id=p.journal_entry_id " +
                "AND j.station_id=p.station_id AND j.reference_type='payment' AND j.reference_id=p.id AND j.status='posted' AND COALESCE(j.is_deleted,0)=0)) ORDER BY p.id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("payment_id", c.getLong(0)).put("payment_code", c.getString(1)).put("amount", c.getDouble(2))
            .put("sale_id", c.getLong(3)).put("customer_party_id", c.getLong(4)).put("cash_box_id", c.getLong(5))
            .put("bank_account_id", c.getLong(6)).put("journal_entry_id", c.getLong(7)).put("payment_method", c.getString(8)) }
        checks.put("completed_payments_without_posted_journal", missing)
        add(issues, "completed_payments_without_posted_journal", "critical",
            "مدفوعات مكتملة بلا قيد مرحّل مطابق؛ يلزم إثبات مصدر التسوية وتخصيص الفاتورة أولاً",
            missing.length(), sum(missing, "amount"), missing)
        val withoutSource = rows(
            "SELECT id,COALESCE(payment_code,''),COALESCE(amount,0),COALESCE(payment_method,'') FROM payments " +
                "WHERE station_id=? AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0 AND " +
                "COALESCE(cash_box_id,0)=0 AND COALESCE(bank_account_id,0)=0 ORDER BY id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("payment_id", c.getLong(0)).put("payment_code", c.getString(1)).put("amount", c.getDouble(2)).put("payment_method", c.getString(3)) }
        checks.put("completed_payments_without_settlement_source", withoutSource)
        add(issues, "completed_payments_without_settlement_source", "critical", "مدفوعات بلا صندوق أو بنك محفوظ في سجل المصدر",
            withoutSource.length(), sum(withoutSource, "amount"), withoutSource)
        val unscoped = if (hasColumn("payments", "station_id")) scalar(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE (station_id IS NULL OR station_id=0) AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0",
            emptyArray()
        ) else 0
        checks.put("completed_payments_missing_station_scope", unscoped)
        add(issues, "completed_payments_missing_station_scope", "critical",
            "مدفوعات مكتملة بلا نطاق محطة؛ لا يجوز إسنادها تلقائياً إلى هذه المحطة", unscoped, null, null)
    }

    /**
     * Reconcile physical cash and bank control balances against the exact source-ledger
     * chain used by the repair service. Broken/unknown chains are blockers, never guessed.
     */
    private fun checkCashAndBanks(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        val cashIssues = JSONArray()
        val cashCols = columns("cash_movements")
        val cashScope = (if (cashCols.contains("station_id")) " AND station_id=?" else "") +
            (if (cashCols.contains("is_deleted")) " AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0" else "") +
            (if (cashCols.contains("status")) " AND lower(status) IN ('completed','posted','approved')" else "")
        val boxes = rows(
            "SELECT id,COALESCE(opening_balance,0),COALESCE(current_balance,0) FROM cash_boxes WHERE station_id=?" +
                (if (hasColumn("cash_boxes","is_deleted")) " AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0" else "") + " ORDER BY id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("cash_box_id",c.getLong(0)).put("opening_balance",c.getDouble(1)).put("current_balance",c.getDouble(2)) }
        for (box in 0 until boxes.length()) {
            val b=boxes.getJSONObject(box)
            val id=b.getLong("cash_box_id")
            val opening=b.getDouble("opening_balance")
            val current=b.getDouble("current_balance")
            val args=if (cashCols.contains("station_id")) arrayOf(id.toString(),stationId.toString()) else arrayOf(id.toString())
            val movements=rows(
                "SELECT lower(movement_type),COALESCE(amount,0),balance_before,balance_after FROM cash_movements " +
                    "WHERE cash_box_id=?"+cashScope+" ORDER BY id",args
            ) { c -> JSONObject().put("type",c.getString(0)).put("amount",c.getDouble(1))
                .put("before",if(c.isNull(2)) JSONObject.NULL else c.getDouble(2))
                .put("after",if(c.isNull(3)) JSONObject.NULL else c.getDouble(3)) }
            var expected=opening
            var previous=opening
            var valid=true
            var reason=""
            for (i in 0 until movements.length()) {
                val m=movements.getJSONObject(i)
                val type=m.optString("type").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                val amount=m.optDouble("amount",Double.NaN)
                val before=if(m.isNull("before")) Double.NaN else m.optDouble("before",Double.NaN)
                val after=if(m.isNull("after")) Double.NaN else m.optDouble("after",Double.NaN)
                val delta=when(type) { "in"->amount; "out","refund"-> -amount; else->Double.NaN }
                if(!amount.isFinite() || amount<0 || !before.isFinite() || !after.isFinite() ||
                    !delta.isFinite() || abs(before-previous)>0.01 || abs(before+delta-after)>0.01) {
                    valid=false
                    reason="cash_movement_chain_invalid_or_unknown_type"
                    break
                }
                expected+=delta
                previous=after
            }
            if(!valid || abs(current-expected)>0.01) {
                cashIssues.put(JSONObject().put("cash_box_id",id).put("opening_balance",opening)
                    .put("current_balance",current).put("movement_count",movements.length())
                    .put("source_calculation",if(valid) expected else JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("difference",if(valid) current-expected else JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("reason",if(!valid) reason else if(movements.length()==0) "no_movements_to_prove_current_balance" else "current_balance_differs_from_movement_chain"))
            }
            val mapScope=if(hasColumn("accounts","station_id")) " AND station_id=?" else ""
            val mapArgs=if(hasColumn("accounts","station_id")) arrayOf(id.toString(),stationId.toString()) else arrayOf(id.toString())
            val mapCount=scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE cash_box_id=? AND account_type='asset' AND is_cash_account=1 AND is_active=1 AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0"+mapScope,mapArgs)
            if((abs(opening)>0.01 || abs(current)>0.01 || movements.length()>0) && mapCount!=1) {
                add(issues,"cash_box_account_mapping","critical",
                    "الصندوق المستخدم مالياً يجب أن يرتبط بحساب أستاذ عام نقدي واحد فقط",
                    1,null,JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("cash_box_id",id).put("matching_cash_accounts",mapCount)
                        .put("opening_balance",opening).put("current_balance",current)))
            }
        }
        checks.put("cash_balance_chain_mismatches",cashIssues)
        add(issues,"cash_balance_chain_mismatches","critical",
            "الرصيد الحالي للصندوق لا يمكن إثباته من رصيد الافتتاح وسلسلة حركات صحيحة",
            cashIssues.length(),null,cashIssues)

        val bankIssues = JSONArray()
        val bankCols=columns("bank_ledger")
        val bankScope=(if(bankCols.contains("station_id")) " AND station_id=?" else "")+
            (if(bankCols.contains("is_deleted")) " AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0" else "")+
            (if(bankCols.contains("status")) " AND lower(status) IN ('completed','posted','approved')" else "")
        val banks=rows(
            "SELECT id,COALESCE(opening_balance,0),COALESCE(current_balance,0) FROM bank_accounts WHERE station_id=?"+
                (if(hasColumn("bank_accounts","is_deleted")) " AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0" else "")+" ORDER BY id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("bank_account_id",c.getLong(0)).put("opening_balance",c.getDouble(1)).put("current_balance",c.getDouble(2)) }
        for (i in 0 until banks.length()) {
            val b=banks.getJSONObject(i)
            val id=b.getLong("bank_account_id")
            val opening=b.getDouble("opening_balance")
            val current=b.getDouble("current_balance")
            val args=if(bankCols.contains("station_id")) arrayOf(id.toString(),stationId.toString()) else arrayOf(id.toString())
            val entries=rows(
                "SELECT COALESCE(debit,0),COALESCE(credit,0),COALESCE(balance,0) FROM bank_ledger " +
                    "WHERE bank_account_id=?"+bankScope+" ORDER BY id",args
            ) { c -> JSONObject().put("debit",c.getDouble(0)).put("credit",c.getDouble(1)).put("balance",c.getDouble(2)) }
            var expected=opening
            var valid=true
            for (j in 0 until entries.length()) {
                val e=entries.getJSONObject(j)
                val debit=e.getDouble("debit")
                val credit=e.getDouble("credit")
                val balance=e.getDouble("balance")
                val after=expected+debit-credit
                if(!debit.isFinite() || !credit.isFinite() || !balance.isFinite() || debit< -0.01 || credit< -0.01 ||
                    (debit>0.01 && credit>0.01) || abs(after-balance)>0.01) { valid=false; break }
                expected=after
            }
            if(!valid || abs(current-expected)>0.01) {
                bankIssues.put(JSONObject().put("bank_account_id",id).put("opening_balance",opening)
                    .put("current_balance",current).put("ledger_row_count",entries.length())
                    .put("source_calculation",if(valid) expected else JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("difference",if(valid) current-expected else JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("reason",if(!valid) "bank_ledger_chain_invalid" else if(entries.length()==0) "no_ledger_rows_to_prove_current_balance" else "current_balance_differs_from_ledger_chain"))
            }
            val mapScope=if(hasColumn("accounts","station_id")) " AND station_id=?" else ""
            val mapArgs=if(hasColumn("accounts","station_id")) arrayOf(id.toString(),stationId.toString()) else arrayOf(id.toString())
            val mapCount=scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE bank_account_id=? AND account_type='asset' AND is_bank_account=1 AND is_active=1 AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0"+mapScope,mapArgs)
            if((abs(opening)>0.01 || abs(current)>0.01 || entries.length()>0) && mapCount!=1) {
                add(issues,"bank_account_gl_mapping","critical",
                    "الحساب البنكي المستخدم مالياً يجب أن يرتبط بحساب أستاذ عام بنكي واحد فقط",
                    1,null,JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("bank_account_id",id).put("matching_bank_accounts",mapCount)
                        .put("opening_balance",opening).put("current_balance",current)))
            }
        }
        checks.put("bank_balance_chain_mismatches",bankIssues)
        add(issues,"bank_balance_chain_mismatches","critical",
            "الرصيد الحالي للبنك لا يمكن إثباته من رصيد الافتتاح ودفتر البنك المتسلسل",
            bankIssues.length(),null,bankIssues)
    }

    private fun checkCustomerAndSupplierLedgers(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        if (tableExists("parties") && tableExists("party_types") && tableExists("customer_ledger")) {
            val customers = rows(
                "SELECT p.id,COALESCE(p.legal_name,''),COALESCE(p.current_balance,0),COUNT(l.id)," +
                    "COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l.debit,0)-COALESCE(l.credit,0)),0) FROM parties p " +
                    "JOIN party_types t ON t.id=p.party_type_id LEFT JOIN customer_ledger l ON l.party_id=p.id " +
                    "WHERE p.station_id=? AND COALESCE(p.is_deleted,0)=0 AND t.type_code<>'SUPPLIER' GROUP BY p.id " +
                    "HAVING ABS(COALESCE(p.current_balance,0)-COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l.debit,0)-COALESCE(l.credit,0)),0))>0.01 " +
                    "OR (COUNT(l.id)=0 AND ABS(COALESCE(p.current_balance,0))>0.01) ORDER BY p.id",
                arrayOf(stationId.toString())
            ) { c -> JSONObject().put("party_id", c.getLong(0)).put("party_name", c.getString(1))
                .put("current_balance", c.getDouble(2)).put("ledger_row_count", c.getInt(3)).put("ledger_net_debit", c.getDouble(4)) }
            checks.put("customer_subledger_mismatches", customers)
            add(issues, "customer_subledger_mismatches", "critical",
                "رصيد العميل لا يطابق دفتر العميل؛ الرصيد الافتتاحي غير الموثق يحتاج سنداً مستقلاً",
                customers.length(), sum(customers, "current_balance"), customers)
            val ar = controlAccount(stationId, "1103", "asset", false)
            checks.put("customer_receivable_control_reconciliation", ar)
            if (ar.optBoolean("available") && abs(ar.optDouble("difference", 0.0)) > 0.01)
                add(issues, "customer_receivable_control_reconciliation", "critical",
                    "حساب رقابة المدينين لا يطابق مجموع أرصدة العملاء في المحطة", 1, ar.optDouble("difference"), JSONArray().put(ar))
        }
        if (tableExists("parties") && tableExists("party_types") && tableExists("supplier_ledger")) {
            val suppliers = rows(
                "SELECT p.id,COALESCE(p.legal_name,''),COALESCE(p.current_balance,0),COALESCE(p.total_due,0)," +
                    "COALESCE(p.total_purchases,0),COALESCE(p.total_payments,0),COUNT(l.id)," +
                    "COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l.credit,0)-COALESCE(l.debit,0)),0) FROM parties p " +
                    "JOIN party_types t ON t.id=p.party_type_id LEFT JOIN supplier_ledger l ON l.party_id=p.id " +
                    "WHERE p.station_id=? AND t.type_code='SUPPLIER' AND COALESCE(p.is_deleted,0)=0 GROUP BY p.id HAVING " +
                    "ABS(COALESCE(p.current_balance,0)-COALESCE(p.total_due,0))>0.01 OR " +
                    "ABS(COALESCE(p.current_balance,0)-COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l.credit,0)-COALESCE(l.debit,0)),0))>0.01 OR " +
                    "ABS(COALESCE(p.total_purchases,0)-COALESCE(p.total_payments,0)-COALESCE(p.total_due,0))>0.01 ORDER BY p.id",
                arrayOf(stationId.toString())
            ) { c -> JSONObject().put("supplier_id", c.getLong(0)).put("supplier_name", c.getString(1))
                .put("current_balance", c.getDouble(2)).put("total_due", c.getDouble(3))
                .put("total_purchases", c.getDouble(4)).put("total_payments", c.getDouble(5))
                .put("ledger_row_count", c.getInt(6)).put("ledger_net_credit", c.getDouble(7)) }
            checks.put("supplier_subledger_mismatches", suppliers)
            add(issues, "supplier_subledger_mismatches", "critical",
                "رصيد المورد أو مجموع دفتر المورد لا يطابق إجمالي المشتريات والدفعات", suppliers.length(), null, suppliers)
            val ap = controlAccount(stationId, "2101", "liability", true)
            checks.put("supplier_payable_control_reconciliation", ap)
            if (ap.optBoolean("available") && abs(ap.optDouble("difference", 0.0)) > 0.01)
                add(issues, "supplier_payable_control_reconciliation", "critical",
                    "حساب رقابة الدائنين لا يطابق دفتر الموردين", 1, ap.optDouble("difference"), JSONArray().put(ap))
        }
    }

    private fun controlAccount(stationId: Int, code: String, accountType: String, supplier: Boolean): JSONObject {
        val accountScope = if (hasColumn("accounts","station_id")) " AND station_id=?" else ""
        val accountArgs = if (hasColumn("accounts","station_id")) arrayOf(code,accountType,stationId.toString()) else arrayOf(code,accountType)
        val ids = query(
            "SELECT id,COALESCE(opening_balance,0) FROM accounts WHERE account_code=? AND account_type=? AND is_active=1 AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0" + accountScope,
            accountArgs
        ) { c -> c.getLong(0) to c.getDouble(1) }
        if (ids.size != 1) return JSONObject().put("available", false).put("reason", "الحساب الرقابي غير فريد أو غير نشط")
        val id = ids[0].first
        val gl = scalarDouble(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.debit-i.credit),0) FROM journal_entry_items i JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id=i.journal_entry_id " +
                "WHERE i.account_id=? AND j.station_id=? AND j.status='posted' AND COALESCE(j.is_deleted,0)=0",
            arrayOf(id.toString(), stationId.toString())
        )
        val partyTotal = scalarDouble(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.current_balance),0) FROM parties p JOIN party_types t ON t.id=p.party_type_id " +
                "WHERE p.station_id=? AND COALESCE(p.is_deleted,0)=0 AND " +
                if (supplier) "t.type_code='SUPPLIER'" else "t.type_code<>'SUPPLIER'",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        )
        val expected = if (supplier) -partyTotal else partyTotal
        val book = ids[0].second + gl
        return JSONObject().put("available", true).put("account_id", id).put("account_code", code)
            .put("opening_balance", ids[0].second).put("posted_gl_net_debit", gl)
            .put("party_balance_total", partyTotal).put("expected_gl_net_debit", expected)
            .put("difference", book - expected).put("reconciled", abs(book - expected) <= 0.01)
    }

    private fun checkInventory(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        val movementsExist = tableExists("inventory_movements")
        val ledgerCount = if (!tableExists("inventory_ledger")) 0 else when {
            hasColumn("inventory_ledger","station_id") ->
                scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_ledger WHERE station_id=?", arrayOf(stationId.toString()))
            hasColumn("inventory_ledger","product_id") && tableExists("products") && hasColumn("products","station_id") ->
                scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_ledger l JOIN products p ON p.id=l.product_id WHERE p.station_id=?", arrayOf(stationId.toString()))
            else -> -1
        }
        val movementCount = if (movementsExist) scalar(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_movements WHERE station_id=? AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) else 0
        checks.put("completed_inventory_movement_count", movementCount).put("inventory_ledger_row_count", ledgerCount)
        // inventory_ledger is not part of the app's currently used posting path. The
        // authoritative inventory checks below reconcile inventory_movements, warehouse
        // levels and product totals; an absent auxiliary projection is therefore recorded
        // for diagnostics but must not by itself block statement approval.
        checks.put("inventory_ledger_projection_status", when {
            !tableExists("inventory_ledger") -> "not_configured_using_inventory_movements"
            ledgerCount == -1 -> "available_but_not_station_scopable"
            movementCount > 0 && ledgerCount == 0 -> "empty_auxiliary_projection"
            else -> "available"
        })

        if (tableExists("products") && tableExists("inventory_levels")) {
            val levels = rows(
                "SELECT p.id,COALESCE(p.product_name_ar,p.product_name,''),COALESCE(p.quantity,0)," +
                    "COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory_levels l WHERE l.product_id=p.id),0) " +
                    "FROM products p WHERE p.station_id=? AND COALESCE(p.is_deleted,0)=0 AND " +
                    "EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_levels l WHERE l.product_id=p.id) AND " +
                    "ABS(COALESCE(p.quantity,0)-(SELECT SUM(l.quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory_levels l WHERE l.product_id=p.id))>0.01 ORDER BY p.id",
                arrayOf(stationId.toString())
            ) { c -> JSONObject().put("product_id", c.getLong(0)).put("product_name", c.getString(1))
                .put("product_quantity", c.getDouble(2)).put("sum_warehouse_quantity", c.getDouble(3))
                .put("difference", c.getDouble(2) - c.getDouble(3)) }
            checks.put("product_quantity_vs_warehouse_levels", levels)
            add(issues, "product_quantity_vs_warehouse_levels", "critical",
                "كمية المنتج لا تطابق مجموع أرصدة المستودعات", levels.length(), null, levels)
        }
        if (movementsExist) {
            val broken = rows(
                "SELECT id,product_id,COALESCE(quantity_before,0),COALESCE(quantity_change,0),COALESCE(quantity_after,0) " +
                    "FROM inventory_movements WHERE station_id=? AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0 " +
                    "AND ABS(COALESCE(quantity_before,0)+COALESCE(quantity_change,0)-COALESCE(quantity_after,0))>0.01 ORDER BY id",
                arrayOf(stationId.toString())
            ) { c -> JSONObject().put("movement_id", c.getLong(0)).put("product_id", c.getLong(1))
                .put("quantity_before", c.getDouble(2)).put("quantity_change", c.getDouble(3)).put("quantity_after", c.getDouble(4)) }
            checks.put("inventory_movement_arithmetic_mismatches", broken)
            add(issues, "inventory_movement_arithmetic_mismatches", "critical",
                "حركات مخزون لا تحقق الرصيد السابق + التغير = الرصيد اللاحق؛ لا تعدل الكميات تلقائياً", broken.length(), null, broken)
        }
    }

    private fun checkFuelAndRefills(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        if (tableExists("fuel_sales") && tableExists("fuel_types")) {
            val costs = rows(
                "SELECT fs.id,COALESCE(fs.sale_id,0),COALESCE(fs.fuel_type_id,0),COALESCE(fs.quantity,0)," +
                    "COALESCE(fs.cost_per_liter,0),COALESCE(fs.cost_amount,0),COALESCE(ft.default_purchase_price,0) " +
                    "FROM fuel_sales fs LEFT JOIN fuel_types ft ON ft.id=fs.fuel_type_id WHERE fs.station_id=? " +
                    "AND fs.status='completed' AND COALESCE(fs.is_deleted,0)=0 AND (COALESCE(fs.cost_per_liter,0)<=0 OR " +
                    "COALESCE(fs.cost_amount,0)<=0 OR (COALESCE(ft.default_purchase_price,0)>0 AND fs.cost_per_liter<ft.default_purchase_price*0.5)) ORDER BY fs.id",
                arrayOf(stationId.toString())
            ) { c -> JSONObject().put("fuel_sale_id", c.getLong(0)).put("sale_id", c.getLong(1))
                .put("fuel_type_id", c.getLong(2)).put("quantity", c.getDouble(3))
                .put("recorded_cost_per_liter", c.getDouble(4)).put("recorded_cost_amount", c.getDouble(5))
                .put("current_default_purchase_price_reference_only", c.getDouble(6)) }
            checks.put("fuel_sales_cost_anomalies", costs)
            add(issues, "fuel_sales_cost_anomalies", "critical",
                "تكلفة وقود تاريخية مفقودة أو شاذة؛ لا يستخدم السعر الحالي لإعادة كتابة تكلفة تاريخية", costs.length(), null, costs)
        }
        if (!tableExists("tank_refills")) return
        val quantity = rows(
            "SELECT id,COALESCE(refill_code,''),COALESCE(delivered_quantity,0),COALESCE(actual_quantity,0)," +
                "COALESCE(tank_level_before,0),COALESCE(tank_level_after,0),COALESCE(net_amount,0) FROM tank_refills " +
                "WHERE station_id=? AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0 AND " +
                "ABS(COALESCE(actual_quantity,0)-COALESCE(delivered_quantity,0))>0.01 ORDER BY id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("refill_id", c.getLong(0)).put("refill_code", c.getString(1))
            .put("delivered_quantity", c.getDouble(2)).put("actual_quantity", c.getDouble(3))
            .put("tank_level_before", c.getDouble(4)).put("tank_level_after", c.getDouble(5)).put("net_amount", c.getDouble(6)) }
        checks.put("fuel_refill_quantity_anomalies", quantity)
        add(issues, "fuel_refill_quantity_anomalies", "critical",
            "حقل الكمية الفعلية لا يساوي الكمية المسلمة؛ قد يحتوي قراءة مستوى الخزان ولا يجوز استبداله آلياً", quantity.length(), null, quantity)

        val missing = rows(
            "SELECT r.id,COALESCE(r.refill_code,''),COALESCE(r.supplier_id,0),COALESCE(r.net_amount,0) FROM tank_refills r " +
                "WHERE r.station_id=? AND r.status='completed' AND COALESCE(r.is_deleted,0)=0 AND NOT EXISTS(" +
                "SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries j WHERE j.station_id=r.station_id AND j.reference_type='fuel_supply' " +
                "AND j.reference_id=r.id AND COALESCE(j.is_deleted,0)=0) ORDER BY r.id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("refill_id", c.getLong(0)).put("refill_code", c.getString(1))
            .put("supplier_id", c.getLong(2)).put("net_amount", c.getDouble(3))
            .put("supplier_ledger_proof_available", oneExactSupplierCredit(c.getLong(2), c.getLong(0), c.getDouble(3))) }
        checks.put("missing_fuel_supply_journals", missing)
        add(issues, "missing_fuel_supply_journals", "critical",
            "توريدات وقود مكتملة بلا قيد أستاذ عام؛ الحالات ذات الإثبات المطابق تظهر قابلة للإصلاح الآمن", missing.length(), sum(missing, "net_amount"), missing)
    }

    private fun checkPeriodsAndCurrency(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        val periodCount = if (hasColumn("fiscal_periods", "station_id")) scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fiscal_periods WHERE station_id=?", arrayOf(stationId.toString())) else 0
        val unperioded = if (hasColumn("journal_entries", "station_id") && hasColumn("journal_entries", "status") && hasColumn("journal_entries", "fiscal_year") && hasColumn("journal_entries", "fiscal_period")) scalar(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM journal_entries WHERE station_id=? AND status='posted' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0 AND (fiscal_year IS NULL OR fiscal_period IS NULL)",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) else 0
        val noSalesCurrency = if (hasColumn("sales_transactions", "station_id") && hasColumn("sales_transactions", "status") && hasColumn("sales_transactions", "currency_id") && hasColumn("sales_transactions", "amount_in_default")) scalar(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_transactions WHERE station_id=? AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0 AND (currency_id IS NULL OR amount_in_default IS NULL)",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) else 0
        val noPaymentCurrency = if (hasColumn("payments", "station_id") && hasColumn("payments", "status") && hasColumn("payments", "currency_id") && hasColumn("payments", "amount_in_default")) scalar(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE station_id=? AND status='completed' AND COALESCE(is_deleted,0)=0 AND (currency_id IS NULL OR amount_in_default IS NULL)",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) else 0
        checks.put("fiscal_period_count", periodCount).put("posted_journals_without_period", unperioded)
            .put("sales_without_currency_or_default_amount", noSalesCurrency).put("payments_without_currency_or_default_amount", noPaymentCurrency)
        if (periodCount == 0 || unperioded > 0)
            add(issues, "fiscal_period_reconciliation_missing", "high",
                "التقويم المالي مفقود أو أن قيوداً مرحلة بلا سنة/فترة مالية؛ يلزم إنشاء واعتماد التقويم من سياسة المحطة", maxOf(if (periodCount == 0) 1 else 0, unperioded), null, null)
        if (noSalesCurrency + noPaymentCurrency > 0)
            add(issues, "historical_currency_evidence_missing", "high",
                "معاملات تاريخية بلا عملة/مبلغ بالعملة الافتراضية؛ لا يجوز اختراع سعر صرف تاريخي", noSalesCurrency + noPaymentCurrency, null, null)
    }

    private fun checkOpeningBalances(stationId: Int, checks: JSONObject, issues: JSONArray) {
        if (!tableExists("accounts")) return
        val stationScope = if (hasColumn("accounts","station_id")) " AND child.station_id=? AND parent.station_id=?" else ""
        val stationArgs = if (stationScope.isNotEmpty()) arrayOf(stationId.toString(),stationId.toString()) else emptyArray()
        val overlaps = rows(
            "SELECT child.id,COALESCE(child.account_code,''),COALESCE(child.opening_balance,0),parent.id," +
                "COALESCE(parent.account_code,''),COALESCE(parent.opening_balance,0) FROM accounts child " +
                "JOIN accounts parent ON parent.id=child.parent_account_id WHERE child.is_active=1 AND parent.is_active=1 " +
                "AND COALESCE(child.is_deleted,0)=0 AND COALESCE(parent.is_deleted,0)=0" + stationScope + " " +
                "AND ABS(COALESCE(child.opening_balance,0))>0.01 AND ABS(COALESCE(parent.opening_balance,0))>0.01 ORDER BY child.id",
            stationArgs
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("child_account_id", c.getLong(0)).put("child_account_code", c.getString(1))
            .put("child_opening_balance", c.getDouble(2)).put("parent_account_id", c.getLong(3))
            .put("parent_account_code", c.getString(4)).put("parent_opening_balance", c.getDouble(5)) }
        checks.put("opening_balances_on_parent_and_child", overlaps)
        add(issues, "opening_balances_on_parent_and_child", "critical",
            "أرصدة افتتاحية مسجلة في حساب أب وتفاصيله معاً؛ لا يمكن احتساب الميزانية قبل تحديد الرصيد المعتمد", overlaps.length(), null, overlaps)
    }

    private fun oneExactSupplierCredit(supplierId: Long, refillId: Long, amount: Double): Boolean {
        if (!tableExists("supplier_ledger")) return false
        val matches = query(
            "SELECT COALESCE(debit,0),COALESCE(credit,0) FROM supplier_ledger WHERE party_id=? AND transaction_type='fuel_supply_credit' AND transaction_id=?",
            arrayOf(supplierId.toString(), refillId.toString())
        ) { c -> c.getDouble(0) to c.getDouble(1) }
        return matches.size == 1 && abs(matches[0].first) <= 0.01 && abs(matches[0].second - amount) <= 0.01
    }

    private fun add(target: JSONArray, code: String, severity: String, message: String, count: Int, amount: Double?, records: JSONArray?) {
        if (count <= 0) return
        val finding = JSONObject().put("code", code).put("severity", severity).put("message", message).put("count", count)
        if (amount != null) finding.put("amount", amount)
        if (records != null) finding.put("records", records)
        target.put(finding)
    }
    private fun sum(rows: JSONArray, key: String): Double {
        var out = 0.0
        for (i in 0 until rows.length()) out += rows.getJSONObject(i).optDouble(key, 0.0)
        return out
    }
    private fun tableExists(table: String) = scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?", arrayOf(table)) > 0
    private fun columns(table: String): Set<String> {
        if (!table.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*")) || !tableExists(table)) return emptySet()
        val result = linkedSetOf<String>()
        db.rawQuery("PRAGMA table_info(" + table + ")", null).use { c -> while (c.moveToNext()) result.add(c.getString(1)) }
        return result
    }
    private fun hasColumn(table: String, name: String): Boolean = columns(table).contains(name)
    private fun scalar(sql: String, args: Array<String>): Int {
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { c -> return if (c.moveToFirst()) c.getInt(0) else 0 }
    }
    private fun scalarDouble(sql: String, args: Array<String>): Double {
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { c -> return if (c.moveToFirst()) c.getDouble(0) else 0.0 }
    }
    private fun rows(sql: String, args: Array<String>, mapper: (Cursor) -> JSONObject): JSONArray {
        val out = JSONArray()
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { c -> while (c.moveToNext()) out.put(mapper(c)) }
        return out
    }
    private fun <T> query(sql: String, args: Array<String>, mapper: (Cursor) -> T): List<T> {
        val out = ArrayList<T>()
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { c -> while (c.moveToNext()) out.add(mapper(c)) }
        return out
    }
    private fun normalizeDate(input: String): String {
        val value = input.trim().take(10)
        if (value.matches(Regex("\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}"))) return value
        return now().take(10)
    }
    private fun now() = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.US).format(Date())
}

    private fun supplierAging(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        requireTable("parties")
        requireTable("party_types")
        requireTable("supplier_ledger")
        val asOf = parseDate(p.optString("as_of_date").ifBlank { today() })
        val rows = query(
            "SELECT p.id,COALESCE(p.legal_name,''),COALESCE(p.current_balance,0),COALESCE(p.total_due,0) " +
                "FROM parties p JOIN party_types t ON t.id=p.party_type_id " +
                "WHERE p.station_id=? AND t.type_code='SUPPLIER' AND COALESCE(p.is_deleted,0)=0 ORDER BY p.id",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c ->
            JSONObject().put("supplier_id", c.getLong(0)).put("supplier_name", c.getString(1))
                .put("party_balance", c.getDouble(2)).put("party_total_due", c.getDouble(3))
        }
        val output = JSONArray()
        var totalBalance = 0.0
        var current = 0.0
        var d1 = 0.0
        var d2 = 0.0
        var d3 = 0.0
        var d4 = 0.0
        var undated = 0.0
        var varianceTotal = 0.0
        var unknownDateRows = 0
        for (i in 0 until rows.size) {
            val party = rows[i]
            val id = party.getLong("supplier_id")
            val events = supplierLedgerEvents(id)
            val obligations = mutableListOf<OpenObligation>()
            var advances = 0.0
            var ledgerBalance = 0.0
            for (e in events) {
                val eventDate = e.eventDate
                if (eventDate.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    unknownDateRows++
                    continue
                }
                // An as-of aging report must not pull in transactions after the requested date.
                if (eventDate > asOf) continue
                val credit = e.credit.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
                val debit = e.debit.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
                ledgerBalance += credit - debit
                if (credit > 0.005) {
                    val source = sourceDates(e.type, e.transactionId, e.eventDate)
                    val obligation = OpenObligation(
                        e.id, e.transactionId, credit, source.first, source.second, e.eventDate, e.type
                    )
                    if (advances > 0.005) {
                        val used = minOf(advances, obligation.remaining)
                        obligation.remaining -= used
                        advances -= used
                    }
                    obligations.add(obligation)
                }
                if (debit > 0.005) {
                    var remaining = debit
                    val returnInvoiceId = sourceInvoiceForReturn(e.type, e.transactionId)
                    if (returnInvoiceId > 0L) {
                        for (o in obligations.filter { obligationInvoiceId(it) == returnInvoiceId && it.remaining > 0.005 }) {
                            val used = minOf(remaining, o.remaining)
                            o.remaining -= used
                            remaining -= used
                            if (remaining <= 0.005) break
                        }
                    }
                    if (remaining > 0.005) {
                        for (o in obligations.filter { it.remaining > 0.005 }.sortedWith(compareBy<OpenObligation> { it.invoiceDate ?: "9999-12-31" }.thenBy { it.id })) {
                            val used = minOf(remaining, o.remaining)
                            o.remaining -= used
                            remaining -= used
                            if (remaining <= 0.005) break
                        }
                    }
                    if (remaining > 0.005) advances += remaining
                }
            }
            val supplier = JSONObject()
                .put("supplier_id", id)
                .put("supplier_name", party.getString("supplier_name"))
                .put("party_balance", party.getDouble("party_balance"))
                .put("party_total_due", party.getDouble("party_total_due"))
            var sCurrent = 0.0
            var s1 = 0.0
            var s2 = 0.0
            var s3 = 0.0
            var s4 = 0.0
            var sUndated = 0.0
            val details = JSONArray()
            for (o in obligations) {
                if (o.remaining <= 0.005) continue
                val bucket = if (o.dueDate.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    sUndated += o.remaining
                    "undated"
                } else {
                    val overdue = daysBetween(o.dueDate!!, asOf).coerceAtLeast(0)
                    when {
                        overdue == 0 -> { sCurrent += o.remaining; "current" }
                        overdue <= 30 -> { s1 += o.remaining; "1_30" }
                        overdue <= 60 -> { s2 += o.remaining; "31_60" }
                        overdue <= 90 -> { s3 += o.remaining; "61_90" }
                        else -> { s4 += o.remaining; "over_90" }
                    }
                }
                details.put(
                    JSONObject().put("ledger_id", o.id).put("transaction_type", o.type)
                        .put("invoice_date", o.invoiceDate ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                        .put("due_date", o.dueDate ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                        .put("days_overdue", if (o.dueDate.isNullOrBlank()) JSONObject.NULL else daysBetween(o.dueDate!!, asOf).coerceAtLeast(0))
                        .put("open_amount", money(o.remaining)).put("bucket", bucket)
                )
            }
            val agingBalance = money(sCurrent + s1 + s2 + s3 + s4 + sUndated)
            val currentBalanceComparable = asOf >= today()
            val variance = if (currentBalanceComparable) money(party.getDouble("party_balance") - ledgerBalance) else JSONObject.NULL
            supplier.put("not_overdue", money(sCurrent)).put("overdue_1_30", money(s1))
                .put("overdue_31_60", money(s2)).put("overdue_61_90", money(s3))
                .put("overdue_over_90", money(s4)).put("undated_or_no_terms", money(sUndated))
                .put("unallocated_supplier_advances", money(advances)).put("aging_balance", agingBalance)
                .put("ledger_balance_as_of", money(ledgerBalance)).put("ledger_vs_current_party_balance_variance", variance)
                .put("current_party_balance_comparison_available", currentBalanceComparable)
                .put("details", details)
            output.put(supplier)
            totalBalance += party.getDouble("party_balance")
            current += sCurrent
            d1 += s1
            d2 += s2
            d3 += s3
            d4 += s4
            undated += sUndated
            if (currentBalanceComparable) varianceTotal += (variance as Double)
        }
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("as_of_date", asOf).put("station_id", stationId)
            .put("allocation_policy", "توزيع الدفعات غير المخصصة على أقدم الفواتير المفتوحة؛ تظهر السجلات ذات تاريخ/أجل مفقود في بند مستقل")
            .put("supplier_count", output.length()).put("supplier_balance_total", money(totalBalance))
            .put("not_overdue_total", money(current)).put("overdue_1_30_total", money(d1))
            .put("overdue_31_60_total", money(d2)).put("overdue_61_90_total", money(d3))
            .put("overdue_over_90_total", money(d4)).put("undated_total", money(undated))
            .put("ledger_party_variance_total", money(varianceTotal))
            .put("undated_ledger_row_count", unknownDateRows)
            .put("party_balance_variance_is_current_only", asOf >= today())
            .put("aging_complete", unknownDateRows == 0 && (asOf < today() || abs(varianceTotal) <= 0.01) && undated <= 0.01)
            .put("data", output)
    }

    private fun supplierStatement(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        requireTable("supplier_ledger")
        requireTable("parties")
        requireTable("party_types")
        val supplierId = p.optLong("supplier_id", 0L)
        require(supplierId > 0L) { "يجب تحديد المورد" }
        val supplier = query(
            "SELECT p.id,COALESCE(p.legal_name,''),COALESCE(p.current_balance,0) FROM parties p " +
                "JOIN party_types t ON t.id=p.party_type_id WHERE p.id=? AND p.station_id=? AND " +
                "t.type_code='SUPPLIER' AND COALESCE(p.is_deleted,0)=0",
            arrayOf(supplierId.toString(), stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("id", c.getLong(0)).put("name", c.getString(1)).put("balance", c.getDouble(2)) }.firstOrNull()
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("المورد غير موجود في المحطة الحالية")
        val from = p.optString("from_date").trim().takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { parseDate(it) }
        val to = p.optString("to_date").trim().takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { parseDate(it) }
        if (from != null && to != null) require(from <= to) { "نطاق التاريخ غير صحيح" }
        val events = supplierLedgerEvents(supplierId)
        var opening = 0.0
        var running = 0.0
        val visible = JSONArray()
        val undated = JSONArray()
        var complete = true
        for (e in events) {
            val signed = e.credit - e.debit
            val dt = e.eventDate
            if (dt.isNullOrBlank()) {
                complete = false
                running += signed
                undated.put(
                    JSONObject().put("ledger_id", e.id).put("transaction_type", e.type)
                        .put("transaction_id", e.transactionId).put("debit", money(e.debit))
                        .put("credit", money(e.credit)).put("date", JSONObject.NULL)
                )
                continue
            }
            if (from != null && dt < from) {
                opening += signed
                running += signed
                continue
            }
            if (to != null && dt > to) {
                running += signed
                continue
            }
            running += signed
            val source = sourceDates(e.type, e.transactionId, dt)
            visible.put(
                JSONObject().put("ledger_id", e.id).put("date", dt)
                    .put("transaction_type", e.type).put("transaction_id", e.transactionId)
                    .put("description", ledgerDescription(e.type, e.transactionId))
                    .put("invoice_date", source.first ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("due_date", source.second ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("debit", money(e.debit)).put("credit", money(e.credit))
                    .put("running_balance", money(running))
            )
        }
        val filteredRunning = opening + visibleBalance(visible) 
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("station_id", stationId)
            .put("supplier", supplier).put("from_date", from ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("to_date", to ?: JSONObject.NULL).put("opening_balance", money(opening))
            .put("closing_balance", money(if (from == null && to == null) running else filteredRunning))
            .put("supplier_current_balance", supplier.getDouble("balance"))
            .put("entries", visible).put("undated_entries", undated)
            .put("statement_complete", complete).put("undated_count", undated.length())
    }

    private fun createPurchaseInvoice(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        val supplierId = p.optLong("supplier_id", 0L)
        require(supplierId > 0L) { "يجب تحديد المورد" }
        requireSupplier(supplierId)
        val number = clean(p.optString("invoice_number"), 100)
        require(number.isNotBlank()) { "رقم فاتورة المورد مطلوب" }
        val invoiceDate = parseDate(p.optString("invoice_date"))
        val dueDate = parseDate(p.optString("due_date"))
        require(dueDate >= invoiceDate) { "تاريخ الاستحقاق لا يجوز أن يسبق تاريخ الفاتورة" }
        val lines = p.optJSONArray("lines") ?: JSONArray()
        require(lines.length() in 1..300) { "يجب إدخال بند واحد على الأقل وبحد أقصى 300 بند" }
        val currency = p.optLong("currency_id", 1L).coerceAtLeast(1L)
        val prepared = mutableListOf<PurchaseLine>()
        var subtotal = 0.0
        var vat = 0.0
        for (i in 0 until lines.length()) {
            val line = lines.optJSONObject(i) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("بيانات بند المشتريات غير صالحة")
            val description = clean(line.optString("description"), 500)
            val qty = line.optDouble("quantity", Double.NaN)
            val price = line.optDouble("unit_price", Double.NaN)
            val rate = line.optDouble("vat_rate", 0.0)
            val accountId = line.optLong("account_id", 0L)
            require(description.isNotBlank() && qty.isFinite() && qty > 0 && price.isFinite() && price >= 0) {
                "وصف البند والكمية وسعر الوحدة مطلوبة ويجب أن تكون القيم صحيحة"
            }
            require(rate.isFinite() && rate in 0.0..100.0) { "نسبة ضريبة القيمة المضافة غير صحيحة" }
            requireValidAccount(accountId, setOf("asset", "expense", "cost", "inventory"))
            val net = money(qty * price)
            val tax = money(net * rate / 100.0)
            subtotal += net
            vat += tax
            prepared.add(PurchaseLine(description, qty, price, rate, net, tax, money(net + tax), accountId))
        }
        subtotal = money(subtotal)
        vat = money(vat)
        val total = money(subtotal + vat)
        val stamp = now()
        var id = 0L
        db.beginTransaction()
        try {
            id = db.insertOrThrow("expanded_purchase_invoices", null, ContentValues().apply {
                put("station_id", stationId); put("supplier_id", supplierId); put("invoice_number", number)
                put("invoice_date", invoiceDate); put("due_date", dueDate); put("currency_id", currency)
                put("subtotal", subtotal); put("vat_amount", vat); put("total_amount", total)
                put("status", "draft"); put("notes", clean(p.optString("notes"), 2000))
                put("created_by", userId); put("created_at", stamp); put("updated_at", stamp); put("is_deleted", 0)
            })
            prepared.forEachIndexed { index, line ->
                val cv = ContentValues().apply {
                    put("station_id", stationId); put("invoice_id", id); put("line_no", index + 1)
                    put("description", line.description); put("quantity", line.quantity)
                    put("unit_price", line.unitPrice); put("vat_rate", line.vatRate)
                    put("net_amount", line.net); put("vat_amount", line.vat)
                    put("total_amount", line.total); put("account_id", line.accountId); put("created_at", stamp)
                }
                db.insertOrThrow("expanded_purchase_invoice_lines", null, cv)
            }
            db.setTransactionSuccessful()
        } finally {
            db.endTransaction()
        }
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("invoice_id", id).put("invoice_number", number)
            .put("status", "draft").put("subtotal", subtotal).put("vat_amount", vat).put("total_amount", total)
            .put("message", "تم حفظ مسودة فاتورة المشتريات في SQLite؛ لم تُرحّل محاسبياً بعد")
    }

    private fun postPurchaseInvoice(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        val invoiceId = p.optLong("invoice_id", 0L)
        require(invoiceId > 0) { "معرف فاتورة المشتريات مطلوب" }
        var invoice = purchaseInvoice(invoiceId) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("فاتورة المشتريات غير موجودة")
        val status = invoice.optString("status")
        if (status == "posted") return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("invoice_id", invoiceId).put("status", status).put("journal_entry_id", invoice.optLong("journal_entry_id"))
        var journalId = invoice.optLong("journal_entry_id", 0L)
        if (journalId <= 0L) journalId = findSourceJournal("general_purchase_invoice", invoiceId)
        if (journalId > 0L && status != "posted") {
            val payableId = p.optLong("payable_account_id", invoice.optLong("payable_account_id", 0L))
            val inputVatId = p.optLong("input_vat_account_id", invoice.optLong("input_vat_account_id", 0L))
            requireValidAccount(payableId, setOf("liability"))
            if (invoice.optDouble("vat_amount") > 0.005) requireValidAccount(inputVatId, setOf("asset"))
            db.update("expanded_purchase_invoices", ContentValues().apply {
                put("journal_entry_id", journalId); put("payable_account_id", payableId)
                if (inputVatId > 0L) put("input_vat_account_id", inputVatId)
                put("status", "posting"); put("updated_at", now())
            }, "id=? AND station_id=? AND is_deleted=0", arrayOf(invoiceId.toString(), stationId.toString()))
            invoice = purchaseInvoice(invoiceId) ?: invoice
        }
        if (journalId <= 0L) {
            val payableId = p.optLong("payable_account_id", 0L)
            requireValidAccount(payableId, setOf("liability"))
            val vatAmount = invoice.optDouble("vat_amount")
            val inputVatId = p.optLong("input_vat_account_id", 0L)
            if (vatAmount > 0.005) requireValidAccount(inputVatId, setOf("asset"))
            val lines = invoiceLines(invoiceId)
            val items = JSONArray()
            lines.forEach { line ->
                items.put(JSONObject().put("account_id", line.accountId).put("debit", line.net)
                    .put("credit", 0.0).put("description", line.description))
            }
            if (vatAmount > 0.005) items.put(JSONObject().put("account_id", inputVatId)
                .put("debit", vatAmount).put("credit", 0.0).put("description", "ضريبة مدخلات - فاتورة مشتريات"))
            items.put(JSONObject().put("account_id", payableId).put("debit", 0.0)
                .put("credit", invoice.optDouble("total_amount")).put("description", "ذمم دائنة - مورد"))
            val journal = JSONObject().put("entry_date", invoice.optString("invoice_date"))
                .put("description", "فاتورة مشتريات عامة " + invoice.optString("invoice_number"))
                .put("entry_type", "general").put("reference_type", "general_purchase_invoice")
                .put("reference_id", invoiceId).put("currency_id", invoice.optLong("currency_id", 1L))
                .put("items", items)
            journalId = helper.saveJournalEntry(journal, userId, stationId)
            val link = ContentValues().apply {
                put("journal_entry_id", journalId); put("payable_account_id", payableId)
                if (inputVatId > 0L) put("input_vat_account_id", inputVatId)
                put("status", "posting"); put("updated_at", now())
            }
            db.update("expanded_purchase_invoices", link, "id=? AND station_id=? AND status='draft'",
                arrayOf(invoiceId.toString(), stationId.toString()))
            invoice = purchaseInvoice(invoiceId) ?: invoice
        }
        val journalStatus = journalStatus(journalId)
        if (journalStatus == "posted") {
            finalizePurchaseInvoice(invoiceId)
            return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("invoice_id", invoiceId).put("status", "posted")
                .put("journal_entry_id", journalId).put("message", "الفاتورة والقيد ودفتر المورد متزامنة في SQLite")
        }
        if (journalStatus == "draft" || journalStatus == "pending") {
            helper.requestOrPostJournalEntry(journalId, userId, stationId)
        }
        val finalStatus = journalStatus(journalId)
        if (finalStatus == "posted") {
            finalizePurchaseInvoice(invoiceId)
            return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("invoice_id", invoiceId).put("status", "posted")
                .put("journal_entry_id", journalId)
        }
        db.update("expanded_purchase_invoices",
            ContentValues().apply { put("status", "pending_approval"); put("updated_at", now()) },
            "id=? AND station_id=?", arrayOf(invoiceId.toString(), stationId.toString()))
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("invoice_id", invoiceId)
            .put("status", "pending_approval").put("journal_entry_id", journalId)
            .put("message", "أُنشئ القيد عبر مسار الاعتماد؛ لم يُثبت رصيد المورد أو الضريبة قبل الترحيل النهائي")
    }

    private fun createPurchaseReturn(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        val invoiceId = p.optLong("invoice_id", 0L)
        val invoice = purchaseInvoice(invoiceId) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("فاتورة الشراء الأصلية غير موجودة")
        require(invoice.optString("status") == "posted") { "لا يمكن إرجاع مشتريات قبل ترحيل فاتورتها الأصلية" }
        val returnDate = parseDate(p.optString("return_date"))
        val reason = clean(p.optString("reason"), 1000)
        require(reason.length >= 3) { "سبب المرتجع مطلوب" }
        val requested = p.optJSONArray("lines") ?: JSONArray()
        require(requested.length() in 1..300) { "حدد بنداً واحداً على الأقل للمرتجع" }
        val prepared = mutableListOf<ReturnLine>()
        var netTotal = 0.0
        var vatTotal = 0.0
        for (i in 0 until requested.length()) {
            val item = requested.optJSONObject(i) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("بيانات بند المرتجع غير صالحة")
            val sourceLineId = item.optLong("invoice_line_id", 0L)
            val qty = item.optDouble("quantity", Double.NaN)
            require(sourceLineId > 0 && qty.isFinite() && qty > 0)
            val source = query(
                "SELECT id,quantity,unit_price,vat_rate,account_id,description FROM expanded_purchase_invoice_lines " +
                    "WHERE id=? AND invoice_id=? AND station_id=?",
                arrayOf(sourceLineId.toString(), invoiceId.toString(), stationId.toString())
            ) { c -> PurchaseLine(c.getString(5), c.getDouble(1), c.getDouble(2), c.getDouble(3), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, c.getLong(4)) to c.getLong(0) }
                .firstOrNull() ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("بند المرتجع لا ينتمي إلى الفاتورة الأصلية")
            val alreadyReturned = scalarDouble(
                "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rl.quantity),0) FROM expanded_purchase_return_lines rl " +
                    "JOIN expanded_purchase_returns r ON r.id=rl.return_id WHERE rl.invoice_line_id=? " +
                    "AND r.station_id=? AND r.status IN ('draft','posting','pending_approval','posted') AND r.is_deleted=0",
                arrayOf(sourceLineId.toString(), stationId.toString())
            )
            require(qty <= source.first.quantity - alreadyReturned + 0.000001) {
                "كمية المرتجع تتجاوز الكمية الأصلية المتاحة للمرتجع"
            }
            val net = money(qty * source.first.unitPrice)
            val tax = money(net * source.first.vatRate / 100.0)
            val total = money(net + tax)
            prepared.add(ReturnLine(sourceLineId, qty, net, tax, total, source.first.accountId))
            netTotal += net
            vatTotal += tax
        }
        netTotal = money(netTotal)
        vatTotal = money(vatTotal)
        val total = money(netTotal + vatTotal)
        val returnNumber = clean(p.optString("return_number"), 100).ifBlank {
            "PR-" + stationId + "-" + System.currentTimeMillis()
        }
        val stamp = now()
        var returnId = 0L
        db.beginTransaction()
        try {
            returnId = db.insertOrThrow("expanded_purchase_returns", null, ContentValues().apply {
                put("station_id", stationId); put("invoice_id", invoiceId)
                put("supplier_id", invoice.optLong("supplier_id")); put("return_number", returnNumber)
                put("return_date", returnDate); put("reason", reason); put("subtotal", netTotal)
                put("vat_amount", vatTotal); put("total_amount", total); put("status", "draft")
                put("created_by", userId); put("created_at", stamp); put("updated_at", stamp); put("is_deleted", 0)
            })
            prepared.forEach { item ->
                db.insertOrThrow("expanded_purchase_return_lines", null, ContentValues().apply {
                    put("station_id", stationId); put("return_id", returnId)
                    put("invoice_line_id", item.invoiceLineId); put("quantity", item.quantity)
                    put("net_amount", item.net); put("vat_amount", item.vat); put("total_amount", item.total)
                    put("account_id", item.accountId); put("created_at", stamp)
                })
            }
            db.setTransactionSuccessful()
        } finally {
            db.endTransaction()
        }
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("return_id", returnId).put("return_number", returnNumber)
            .put("status", "draft").put("subtotal", netTotal).put("vat_amount", vatTotal).put("total_amount", total)
            .put("message", "حُفظ مرتجع المشتريات كمسودة؛ لم يخفض ذمة المورد قبل الترحيل")
    }

    private fun postPurchaseReturn(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        val returnId = p.optLong("return_id", 0L)
        var record = purchaseReturn(returnId) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("مرتجع المشتريات غير موجود")
        if (record.optString("status") == "posted") return JSONObject().put("success", true)
            .put("return_id", returnId).put("status", "posted").put("journal_entry_id", record.optLong("journal_entry_id"))
        val invoice = purchaseInvoice(record.optLong("invoice_id")) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("الفاتورة الأصلية غير موجودة")
        require(invoice.optString("status") == "posted") { "يجب أن تكون الفاتورة الأصلية مرحلة" }
        var journalId = record.optLong("journal_entry_id", 0L)
        if (journalId <= 0L) journalId = findSourceJournal("general_purchase_return", returnId)
        if (journalId > 0L && record.optString("status") != "posted") {
            db.update("expanded_purchase_returns", ContentValues().apply {
                put("journal_entry_id", journalId); put("status", "posting"); put("updated_at", now())
            }, "id=? AND station_id=? AND is_deleted=0", arrayOf(returnId.toString(), stationId.toString()))
            record = purchaseReturn(returnId) ?: record
        }
        if (journalId <= 0L) {
            val payableId = invoice.optLong("payable_account_id", 0L)
            requireValidAccount(payableId, setOf("liability"))
            val lines = query(
                "SELECT invoice_line_id,quantity,net_amount,vat_amount,total_amount,account_id " +
                    "FROM expanded_purchase_return_lines WHERE return_id=? AND station_id=? ORDER BY id",
                arrayOf(returnId.toString(), stationId.toString())
            ) { c -> ReturnLine(c.getLong(0), c.getDouble(1), c.getDouble(2), c.getDouble(3), c.getDouble(4), c.getLong(5)) }
            val items = JSONArray()
            items.put(JSONObject().put("account_id", payableId).put("debit", record.optDouble("total_amount"))
                .put("credit", 0.0).put("description", "تخفيض ذمم المورد - مرتجع مشتريات"))
            lines.forEach { line ->
                items.put(JSONObject().put("account_id", line.accountId).put("debit", 0.0)
                    .put("credit", line.net).put("description", "عكس تكلفة/مصروف مشتريات"))
            }
            val vat = record.optDouble("vat_amount")
            if (vat > 0.005) {
                val vatAccount = invoice.optLong("input_vat_account_id", 0L)
                requireValidAccount(vatAccount, setOf("asset"))
                items.put(JSONObject().put("account_id", vatAccount).put("debit", 0.0)
                    .put("credit", vat).put("description", "عكس ضريبة مدخلات المشتريات"))
            }
            val journal = JSONObject().put("entry_date", record.optString("return_date"))
                .put("description", "مرتجع مشتريات " + record.optString("return_number"))
                .put("entry_type", "general").put("reference_type", "general_purchase_return")
                .put("reference_id", returnId).put("currency_id", invoice.optLong("currency_id", 1L))
                .put("items", items)
            journalId = helper.saveJournalEntry(journal, userId, stationId)
            db.update("expanded_purchase_returns", ContentValues().apply {
                put("journal_entry_id", journalId); put("status", "posting"); put("updated_at", now())
            }, "id=? AND station_id=? AND status='draft'", arrayOf(returnId.toString(), stationId.toString()))
            record = purchaseReturn(returnId) ?: record
        }
        var status = journalStatus(journalId)
        if (status == "draft" || status == "pending") {
            helper.requestOrPostJournalEntry(journalId, userId, stationId)
            status = journalStatus(journalId)
        }
        if (status == "posted") {
            finalizePurchaseReturn(returnId)
            return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("return_id", returnId).put("status", "posted")
                .put("journal_entry_id", journalId).put("message", "رُحّل المرتجع وعُكس أثره على ذمة المورد وضريبة المدخلات")
        }
        db.update("expanded_purchase_returns", ContentValues().apply {
            put("status", "pending_approval"); put("updated_at", now())
        }, "id=? AND station_id=?", arrayOf(returnId.toString(), stationId.toString()))
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("return_id", returnId)
            .put("status", "pending_approval").put("journal_entry_id", journalId)
            .put("message", "المرتجع بانتظار اعتماد القيد؛ لم يُعدّل رصيد المورد قبل الترحيل")
    }

    private fun purchaseInvoiceDetail(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        syncPostedDocuments()
        val invoiceId = p.optLong("invoice_id", 0L)
        val invoice = purchaseInvoice(invoiceId) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("فاتورة المشتريات غير موجودة في المحطة الحالية")
        val lines = JSONArray()
        invoiceLines(invoiceId).forEachIndexed { index, line ->
            val lineId = scalarLong(
                "SELECT id FROM expanded_purchase_invoice_lines WHERE invoice_id=? AND station_id=? AND line_no=?",
                arrayOf(invoiceId.toString(), stationId.toString(), (index + 1).toString())
            )
            lines.put(JSONObject().put("invoice_line_id", lineId).put("line_no", index + 1)
                .put("description", line.description).put("quantity", line.quantity)
                .put("unit_price", line.unitPrice).put("vat_rate", line.vatRate)
                .put("net_amount", line.net).put("vat_amount", line.vat)
                .put("total_amount", line.total).put("account_id", line.accountId))
        }
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("invoice", invoice).put("lines", lines)
    }

    private fun purchaseInvoiceList(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        syncPostedDocuments()
        val from = p.optString("from_date").trim().takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { parseDate(it) }
        val to = p.optString("to_date").trim().takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { parseDate(it) }
        var sql = "SELECT id,invoice_number,supplier_id,invoice_date,due_date,subtotal,vat_amount,total_amount,status,journal_entry_id,notes FROM expanded_purchase_invoices WHERE station_id=? AND is_deleted=0"
        val args = mutableListOf(stationId.toString())
        if (from != null) { sql += " AND invoice_date>=?"; args.add(from) }
        if (to != null) { sql += " AND invoice_date<=?"; args.add(to) }
        val data = query(sql + " ORDER BY invoice_date DESC,id DESC", args.toTypedArray()) { c ->
            JSONObject().put("invoice_id", c.getLong(0)).put("invoice_number", c.getString(1))
                .put("supplier_id", c.getLong(2)).put("invoice_date", c.getString(3)).put("due_date", c.getString(4))
                .put("subtotal", c.getDouble(5)).put("vat_amount", c.getDouble(6)).put("total_amount", c.getDouble(7))
                .put("status", c.getString(8)).put("journal_entry_id", if (c.isNull(9)) JSONObject.NULL else c.getLong(9))
                .put("notes", c.getString(10))
        }
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("station_id", stationId).put("data", JSONArray(data))
            .put("count", data.size)
    }

    private fun purchaseReturnList(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        syncPostedDocuments()
        val data = query(
            "SELECT id,return_number,invoice_id,supplier_id,return_date,subtotal,vat_amount,total_amount,status,journal_entry_id,reason " +
                "FROM expanded_purchase_returns WHERE station_id=? AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY return_date DESC,id DESC",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { c -> JSONObject().put("return_id", c.getLong(0)).put("return_number", c.getString(1))
            .put("invoice_id", c.getLong(2)).put("supplier_id", c.getLong(3)).put("return_date", c.getString(4))
            .put("subtotal", c.getDouble(5)).put("vat_amount", c.getDouble(6)).put("total_amount", c.getDouble(7))
            .put("status", c.getString(8)).put("journal_entry_id", if (c.isNull(9)) JSONObject.NULL else c.getLong(9))
            .put("reason", c.getString(10)) }
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("station_id", stationId).put("data", JSONArray(data))
            .put("count", data.size)
    }

    private fun syncPostedDocuments() {
        val invoices = query(
            "SELECT id FROM expanded_purchase_invoices WHERE station_id=? AND status IN ('posting','pending_approval') AND journal_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted=0",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { it.getLong(0) }
        invoices.forEach { id ->
            val inv = purchaseInvoice(id) ?: return@forEach
            if (journalStatus(inv.optLong("journal_entry_id", 0L)) == "posted") finalizePurchaseInvoice(id)
        }
        val returns = query(
            "SELECT id FROM expanded_purchase_returns WHERE station_id=? AND status IN ('posting','pending_approval') AND journal_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted=0",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString())
        ) { it.getLong(0) }
        returns.forEach { id ->
            val ret = purchaseReturn(id) ?: return@forEach
            if (journalStatus(ret.optLong("journal_entry_id", 0L)) == "posted") finalizePurchaseReturn(id)
        }
    }

    private fun finalizePurchaseInvoice(id: Long) {
        val inv = purchaseInvoice(id) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("فاتورة المشتريات غير موجودة")
        db.beginTransaction()
        try {
            val exists = scalar(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_ledger WHERE party_id=? AND transaction_type='general_purchase_invoice' AND transaction_id=?",
                arrayOf(inv.optLong("supplier_id").toString(), id.toString())
            ) > 0
            if (!exists) {
                insertSupplierLedger(inv.optLong("supplier_id"), 0.0, inv.optDouble("total_amount"),
                    "general_purchase_invoice", id, inv.optString("invoice_date"), "فاتورة مشتريات " + inv.optString("invoice_number"))
                updateSupplierTotals(inv.optLong("supplier_id"), inv.optDouble("total_amount"), inv.optDouble("total_amount"), inv.optDouble("total_amount"))
            }
            db.update("expanded_purchase_invoices", ContentValues().apply {
                put("status", "posted"); put("updated_at", now())
            }, "id=? AND station_id=?", arrayOf(id.toString(), stationId.toString()))
            db.setTransactionSuccessful()
        } finally {
            db.endTransaction()
        }
    }

    private fun finalizePurchaseReturn(id: Long) {
        val ret = purchaseReturn(id) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("مرتجع المشتريات غير موجود")
        db.beginTransaction()
        try {
            val exists = scalar(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_ledger WHERE party_id=? AND transaction_type='general_purchase_return' AND transaction_id=?",
                arrayOf(ret.optLong("supplier_id").toString(), id.toString())
            ) > 0
            if (!exists) {
                insertSupplierLedger(ret.optLong("supplier_id"), ret.optDouble("total_amount"), 0.0,
                    "general_purchase_return", id, ret.optString("return_date"), "مرتجع مشتريات " + ret.optString("return_number"))
                updateSupplierTotals(ret.optLong("supplier_id"), -ret.optDouble("total_amount"),
                    -ret.optDouble("total_amount"), -ret.optDouble("total_amount"))
            }
            db.update("expanded_purchase_returns", ContentValues().apply {
                put("status", "posted"); put("updated_at", now())
            }, "id=? AND station_id=?", arrayOf(id.toString(), stationId.toString()))
            db.setTransactionSuccessful()
        } finally {
            db.endTransaction()
        }
    }

    private fun vatReturn(p: JSONObject): JSONObject {
        val from = parseDate(p.optString("from_date"))
        val to = parseDate(p.optString("to_date"))
        require(from <= to) { "نطاق فترة الإقرار الضريبي غير صحيح" }
        val sales = findSalesVatSource(from, to)
        val purchaseVat = scalarDouble(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vat_amount),0) FROM expanded_purchase_invoices WHERE station_id=? AND status='posted' AND is_deleted=0 AND invoice_date>=? AND invoice_date<=?",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString(), from, to)
        )
        val returnVat = scalarDouble(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vat_amount),0) FROM expanded_purchase_returns WHERE station_id=? AND status='posted' AND is_deleted=0 AND return_date>=? AND return_date<=?",
            arrayOf(stationId.toString(), from, to)
        )
        val inputVatNet = money(purchaseVat - returnVat)
        val outputVat = sales.optDouble("output_vat", 0.0)
        val gaps = sales.optJSONArray("schema_gaps") ?: JSONArray()
        val missingSalesJournals = sales.optInt("completed_sales_without_posted_journal", -1)
        val hasTaxProfile = taxProfileConfigured()
        val sourceComplete = sales.optBoolean("source_available") && gaps.length() == 0 && missingSalesJournals == 0
        val readyForReview = sourceComplete && hasTaxProfile
        return JSONObject().put("success", true).put("station_id", stationId).put("from_date", from).put("to_date", to)
            .put("output_vat", money(outputVat)).put("posted_purchase_input_vat", money(purchaseVat))
            .put("posted_purchase_return_input_vat", money(returnVat)).put("net_recoverable_input_vat", inputVatNet)
            .put("net_vat_payable", money(outputVat - inputVatNet))
            .put("outbound_source", sales.optString("source", "unavailable"))
            .put("outbound_document_count", sales.optInt("document_count", 0))
            .put("completed_sales_without_posted_journal", missingSalesJournals)
            .put("tax_profile_configured", hasTaxProfile)
            .put("calculation_is_preparatory_workpaper", true)
            .put("ready_for_tax_review", readyForReview)
